candidates.label: Furqan through taqwa: fearing Allah produces criterion removing misdeeds granting forgiveness; Allah possessor of great bounty
candidates.normLabel: furqan through taqwa: fearing allah produces criterion removing misdeeds granting forgiveness; allah possessor of great bounty
candidates.definition: In 8:29: O believers if you fear Allah He will grant you a criterion and remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allah is possessor of great bounty.

candidates.label: Divine makr superiority: disbelievers plot restrain kill evict; they plan Allah plans; Allah best of planners
candidates.normLabel: divine makr superiority: disbelievers plot restrain kill evict; they plan allah plans; allah best of planners
candidates.definition: In 8:30: When those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain or kill or evict you. They plan and Allah plans and Allah is best of planners.

candidates.label: Masjid al-Haram guardianship restricted to muttaqoon: obstruction justifies punishment; Qurayshi custodianship invalidated; most do not know
candidates.normLabel: masjid al-haram guardianship restricted to muttaqoon: obstruction justifies punishment; qurayshi custodianship invalidated; most do not know
candidates.definition: In 8:34: Why should Allah not punish them while they obstruct from al-Masjid al-Haram and they were not its guardians? Its guardians are only the muttaqoon but most of them do not know.

candidates.label: Khums five-way distribution: one-fifth of booty for Allah Messenger relatives orphans needy traveler; conditioned on belief in Allah and Furqan-day revelation
candidates.normLabel: khums five-way distribution: one-fifth of booty for allah messenger relatives orphans needy traveler; conditioned on belief in allah and furqan-day revelation
candidates.definition: In 8:41: Know that whatever booty you obtain then for Allah is one-fifth and for the Messenger and near relatives and orphans and needy and traveler if you have believed in Allah and what We sent down to Our Servant on day of Furqan day two armies met. And Allah over all things is Capable.

candidates.label: Blessing-change principle: Allah does not alter favor bestowed on people until they alter what is within themselves; SameeAA Aleem
candidates.normLabel: blessing-change principle: allah does not alter favor bestowed on people until they alter what is within themselves; sameeaa aleem
candidates.definition: In 8:53: That is because Allah would not change a favor He bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed Allah is Hearing Knowing.

candidates.label: Heart unification as exclusive divine act: spent all earth could not unite hearts; Allah united them; Azeez Hakeem
candidates.normLabel: heart unification as exclusive divine act: spent all earth could not unite hearts; allah united them; azeez hakeem
candidates.definition: In 8:63: And He brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth you could not have brought their hearts together but Allah brought them together. Indeed He is Exalted Mighty Wise.

candidates.label: Combat ratio adjustment: initial 1:10 for twenty steadfast; lightened to 1:2 recognizing weakness; bi-idhni Allah; Allah with sabireen
candidates.normLabel: combat ratio adjustment: initial 1:10 for twenty steadfast; lightened to 1:2 recognizing weakness; bi-idhni allah; allah with sabireen
candidates.definition: In 8:65-66: O Prophet urge believers to battle. If twenty steadfast overcome two hundred if hundred overcome thousand of disbelievers because they do not understand. Now Allah lightened for you knowing weakness in you so hundred steadfast overcome two hundred thousand overcome two thousand by Allah's permission. Allah is with the patient.

candidates.label: Prisoner ethics: prophet should not take captives before ithkhan; worldly desire critiqued; preceding kitab prevented punishment; booty halal tayyib with taqwa
candidates.normLabel: prisoner ethics: prophet should not take captives before ithkhan; worldly desire critiqued; preceding kitab prevented punishment; booty halal tayyib with taqwa
candidates.definition: In 8:67-69: Not for a prophet to have captives until he inflicts massacre in land. You desire world commodities Allah desires Hereafter. If not for preceding book from Allah great punishment would have touched you for what you took. So consume what you obtained lawful good and fear Allah. Indeed Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Walayah-migration framework: believer solidarity defined by iman-hijrah-jihad plus shelter-aid; non-emigrants excluded until migration; religious aid obligation except treaty-partners; blood kinship priority in Kitab Allah
candidates.normLabel: walayah-migration framework: believer solidarity defined by iman-hijrah-jihad plus shelter-aid; non-emigrants excluded until migration; religious aid obligation except treaty-partners; blood kinship priority in kitab allah
candidates.definition: In 8:72-75: Those who believed emigrated fought with wealth and selves and those who sheltered aided are allies of one another. Those who believed but did not emigrate you have no walayah with them until they emigrate. If they seek help in religion you must help except against treaty-people. Disbelievers are allies of one another unless you do so fitnah and great corruption. Those who believed emigrated fought sheltered aided are truly believers with forgiveness noble provision. Those who believed after emigrated fought with you are of you. Blood relatives are more entitled in Book of Allah. Indeed Allah is Knowing of all things.

candidates.label: Satan's false protection abandoned: adorned deeds claimed invincibility and guardianship; fled at confrontation disassociated citing fear of Allah; severe penalty
candidates.normLabel: satan's false protection abandoned: adorned deeds claimed invincibility and guardianship; fled at confrontation disassociated citing fear of allah; severe penalty
candidates.definition: In 8:48: When Satan adorned their deeds and said no one overcomes you today I am your protector. When two armies sighted each other he turned on heels said I am disassociated from you I see what you do not see I fear Allah and Allah is severe in penalty.

candidates.label: Peace inclination reciprocity: if enemy inclines peace incline to it; rely on Allah; SameeAA Aleem
candidates.normLabel: peace inclination reciprocity: if enemy inclines peace incline to it; rely on allah; sameeaa aleem
candidates.definition: In 8:61: If they incline to peace then incline to it and rely upon Allah. Indeed He is the Hearing the Knowing.

candidates.label: Treaty betrayal management: chronic breakers identified as worst creatures; war dominance as deterrent dispersal; anticipated betrayal met with equal notification; Allah loves not traitors
candidates.normLabel: treaty betrayal management: chronic breakers identified as worst creatures; war dominance as deterrent dispersal; anticipated betrayal met with equal notification; allah loves not traitors
candidates.definition: In 8:55-58: Worst creatures at Allah are those who disbelieved they will not believe. Those you made treaty with then break pledge every time not fearing. If you dominate them in war disperse by them those behind perhaps they remember. If you fear betrayal throw back to them equally. Indeed Allah does not love traitors.

candidates.label: Military preparedness doctrine: prepare power and war-steeds to terrify Allah's enemy your enemy unknown others; spending fully repaid without injustice
candidates.normLabel: military preparedness doctrine: prepare power and war-steeds to terrify allah's enemy your enemy unknown others; spending fully repaid without injustice
candidates.definition: In 8:60: Prepare against them whatever power and war-steeds you can to terrify enemy of Allah and your enemy and others besides them you do not know Allah knows them. Whatever you spend in Allah's way will be fully repaid and you will not be wronged.

candidates.label: Captive rehabilitation pathway: address prisoners promising better replacement for taken wealth plus forgiveness if hearts contain good; Ghafoor Raheem
candidates.normLabel: captive rehabilitation pathway: address prisoners promising better replacement for taken wealth plus forgiveness if hearts contain good; ghafoor raheem
candidates.definition: In 8:70: O Prophet say to captives in your hands if Allah knows good in your hearts He will give you better than what was taken and forgive you. And Allah is Forgiving Merciful.

candidates.label: Pagan prayer at Kaaba characterized as whistling and hand-clapping: ritual reduced to noise-performance; taste punishment for disbelief
candidates.normLabel: pagan prayer at kaaba characterized as whistling and hand-clapping: ritual reduced to noise-performance; taste punishment for disbelief
candidates.definition: In 8:35: Their prayer at the House was nothing but whistling and hand-clapping. So taste punishment for what you disbelieved.

candidates.label: Angelic soul-taking violence: angels strike faces and backs of dying disbelievers; taste burning fire; justified by hands' deeds; Allah not unjust
candidates.normLabel: angelic soul-taking violence: angels strike faces and backs of dying disbelievers; taste burning fire; justified by hands' deeds; allah not unjust
candidates.definition: In 8:50-51: If you could see when angels take souls of disbelievers striking their faces and backs: taste punishment of burning fire. That is for what your hands sent forth and Allah is not ever unjust to servants.

candidates.label: Challenge prayer for punishment: disbelievers demanded stones from sky or painful punishment; dual immunity through Prophet presence and istighfar
candidates.normLabel: challenge prayer for punishment: disbelievers demanded stones from sky or painful punishment; dual immunity through prophet presence and istighfar
candidates.definition: In 8:32-33: When they said O Allah if this is truth from You rain stones from sky or bring painful punishment. But Allah would not punish them while you are among them nor while they seek forgiveness.

candidates.label: Bara'ah disassociation proclamation: Allah and His Messenger publicly dissolve treaty relations with polytheists through a four-month grace period announced at the greater pilgrimage
candidates.normLabel: bara'ah disassociation proclamation: allah and his messenger publicly dissolve treaty relations with polytheists through a four-month grace period announced at the greater pilgrimage
candidates.definition: In 9:1-3 a declaration of disassociation from Allah and His Messenger is issued to treaty-holding polytheists, granting four months of free travel while warning they cannot thwart Allah, and an announcement on the day of the greater pilgrimage confirms the rupture while offering repentance as the better course.

candidates.label: Treaty fidelity obligation: agreements with parties who neither breached terms nor aided enemies must be completed to their full term, grounded in Allah's love of the muttaqeen
candidates.normLabel: treaty fidelity obligation: agreements with parties who neither breached terms nor aided enemies must be completed to their full term, grounded in allah's love of the muttaqeen
candidates.definition: In 9:4 and 9:7 polytheist treaty partners who have not been deficient in anything nor supported anyone against the believers are explicitly excepted from dissolution; their treaties must be honored to the agreed term, and uprightness toward them is required as long as they remain upright.

candidates.label: Conditional combat directive with repentance exit: after the sacred months, hostilities against the treaty-breaking polytheists are commanded, but repentance with prayer and zakah immediately opens a safe path
candidates.normLabel: conditional combat directive with repentance exit: after the sacred months, hostilities against the treaty-breaking polytheists are commanded, but repentance with prayer and zakah immediately opens a safe path
candidates.definition: In 9:5, once the sacred months have passed, killing, capturing, besieging and ambushing the polytheists is commanded; yet if they repent, establish prayer and give zakah their way must be freed, for Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

candidates.label: Asylum right for the seeking polytheist: protection must be granted so he can hear Allah's word, then he must be delivered to his place of safety because his people do not know
candidates.normLabel: asylum right for the seeking polytheist: protection must be granted so he can hear allah's word, then he must be delivered to his place of safety because his people do not know
candidates.definition: In 9:6, if any polytheist seeks protection, it must be granted until he hears the speech of Allah, and he must then be conveyed to his secure place; the stated reason is that they are a people who do not know.

candidates.label: Repentance brotherhood clause: former enemies who repent, establish prayer and give zakah become brothers in religion, with the signs detailed for a people who know
candidates.normLabel: repentance brotherhood clause: former enemies who repent, establish prayer and give zakah become brothers in religion, with the signs detailed for a people who know
candidates.definition: In 9:11, if the polytheists repent, establish prayer and give zakah they are declared the believers' brothers in religion; the verse closes by noting that the signs are made distinct for a people who know.

candidates.label: Oath-breaking and religious defamation as combat triggers: fight the leaders of disbelief whose oaths are void so that they may cease
candidates.normLabel: oath-breaking and religious defamation as combat triggers: fight the leaders of disbelief whose oaths are void so that they may cease
candidates.definition: In 9:12-13, breaking oaths after a treaty combined with defaming the religion triggers fighting the leaders of disbelief because no oaths bind them; the following verse asks why one would not fight a people who broke oaths, plotted to expel the Messenger and attacked first, and rebukes fearing them instead of Allah.

candidates.label: Mosque maintenance qualification: only those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, establish prayer, give zakah and fear none but Allah may maintain Allah's mosques
candidates.normLabel: mosque maintenance qualification: only those who believe in allah and the last day, establish prayer, give zakah and fear none but allah may maintain allah's mosques
candidates.definition: In 9:17-18, polytheists witnessing disbelief against themselves are barred from maintaining Allah's mosques and their deeds are worthless; maintenance belongs only to those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, establish prayer, give zakah and fear none but Allah, who may be among the guided.

candidates.label: Rank of deeds: providing pilgrim water and maintaining the Sacred Mosque are not equal to belief and striving; believers who emigrated and strove with wealth and lives hold greater rank
candidates.normLabel: rank of deeds: providing pilgrim water and maintaining the sacred mosque are not equal to belief and striving; believers who emigrated and strove with wealth and lives hold greater rank
candidates.definition: In 9:19-22, supplying water to pilgrims and maintaining al-Masjid al-Haram are declared unequal in Allah's sight to believing in Allah and the Last Day and striving in His cause; those who believed, emigrated and strove with their wealth and lives are greater in rank and are the attainers, given tidings of mercy, approval and gardens of enduring pleasure.

candidates.label: Loyalty over kinship: fathers and brothers who prefer disbelief are not to be taken as allies, and family, wealth, commerce and dwellings must not be dearer than Allah, His Messenger and striving
candidates.normLabel: loyalty over kinship: fathers and brothers who prefer disbelief are not to be taken as allies, and family, wealth, commerce and dwellings must not be dearer than allah, his messenger and striving
candidates.definition: In 9:23-24, believers are forbidden to take fathers or brothers as allies when they prefer disbelief over belief, and are warned that if fathers, sons, brothers, wives, clan, acquired wealth, feared-declining commerce and pleasing dwellings are dearer than Allah, His Messenger and striving in His cause, they should await Allah's command.

candidates.label: Hunayn lesson and sanctuary exclusion: numbers availed nothing until divine tranquillity and unseen forces arrived; polytheists are barred from the Sacred Mosque with economic loss answered by divine enrichment
candidates.normLabel: hunayn lesson and sanctuary exclusion: numbers availed nothing until divine tranquillity and unseen forces arrived; polytheists are barred from the sacred mosque with economic loss answered by divine enrichment
candidates.definition: In 9:25-28, victory is recalled at many places and at Hunayn where great numbers pleased the believers but availed nothing and the earth narrowed despite its vastness; then Allah sent down His tranquillity upon the Messenger and believers and unseen forces; afterwards repentance is accepted for whom He wills, and the polytheists are declared najas and barred from the Sacred Mosque after that year, with fear of poverty answered by promised enrichment from His bounty.

candidates.label: Sonship claims as oral imitation: Jewish assertion about Uzayr and Christian assertion about the Messiah are spoken fabrications imitating earlier disbelievers, met with divine curse and delusion diagnosis
candidates.normLabel: sonship claims as oral imitation: jewish assertion about uzayr and christian assertion about the messiah are spoken fabrications imitating earlier disbelievers, met with divine curse and delusion diagnosis
candidates.definition: In 9:30, the Jews say Uzayr is Allah's son and the Christians say the Messiah is Allah's son; these are statements from their mouths imitating the saying of those who disbelieved before them; may Allah destroy them, how they are turned away.

candidates.label: Scholarly lordship usurpation: rabbis and monks taken as lords besides Allah while the command was to worship one God alone, followed by divine exaltation above what they associate
candidates.normLabel: scholarly lordship usurpation: rabbis and monks taken as lords besides allah while the command was to worship one god alone, followed by divine exaltation above what they associate
candidates.definition: In 9:31, they took their scholars and monks as lords besides Allah and the Messiah son of Mary, though they were commanded only to worship one God; there is no deity except Him; He is exalted above what they associate.

candidates.label: Light-extinguishing attempt and divine perfection: they want to extinguish Allah's light with their mouths but Allah refuses except to perfect His light even if disbelievers dislike it; Messenger sent with guidance and true religion to manifest over all religion
candidates.normLabel: light-extinguishing attempt and divine perfection: they want to extinguish allah's light with their mouths but allah refuses except to perfect his light even if disbelievers dislike it; messenger sent with guidance and true religion to manifest over all religion
candidates.definition: In 9:32-33, disbelievers try to extinguish Allah's light orally but Allah insists on perfecting it despite their aversion; He sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail over all religion despite polytheist aversion.

candidates.label: Clerical wealth-devouring and hoarding condemnation: many scholars and monks consume people's wealth unjustly and bar the way; gold and silver hoarders who do not spend in Allah's way face branding punishment on the Day heated in Hellfire
candidates.normLabel: clerical wealth-devouring and hoarding condemnation: many scholars and monks consume people's wealth unjustly and bar the way; gold and silver hoarders who do not spend in allah's way face branding punishment on the day heated in hellfire
candidates.definition: In 9:34-35, many ahbar and ruhban eat people's wealth falsely and obstruct Allah's way; those who hoard gold and silver without spending in Allah's cause receive tidings of painful punishment; on the Day the metal is heated in Jahannam fire their foreheads, flanks and backs are branded with 'this is what you hoarded for yourselves'.

candidates.label: Sacred calendar sovereignty: twelve months ordained since creation day, four sacred, constituting the correct religion; self-wronging prohibition during them; collective fighting reciprocity; nasi postponement condemned as kufr increase that manipulates lawful-unlawful boundaries
candidates.normLabel: sacred calendar sovereignty: twelve months ordained since creation day, four sacred, constituting the correct religion; self-wronging prohibition during them; collective fighting reciprocity; nasi postponement condemned as kufr increase that manipulates lawful-unlawful boundaries
candidates.definition: In 9:36-37, the number of months with Allah is twelve since the day He created heavens and earth, four of them sacred, which is the upright religion; believers must not wrong themselves during them and must fight polytheists collectively; the postponement (nasi) is declared an increase in disbelief by which disbelievers alternate lawful and unlawful to match Allah's prohibited count, their evil deeds made pleasing to them.

candidates.label: Mobilization heaviness and Hijrah reassurance: believers criticized for clinging to earth when called to go forth, preferring worldly life whose enjoyment is little compared to Hereafter; threat of replacement by another people; Hijrah cave narrative where Allah sent tranquillity and unseen forces making disbelievers' word lowest and Allah's highest
candidates.normLabel: mobilization heaviness and hijrah reassurance: believers criticized for clinging to earth when called to go forth, preferring worldly life whose enjoyment is little compared to hereafter; threat of replacement by another people; hijrah cave narrative where allah sent tranquillity and unseen forces making disbelievers' word lowest and allah's highest
candidates.definition: In 9:38-40, believers are rebuked for heaviness toward earth when told to mobilize, having preferred dunya over akhira whose enjoyment is little; refusal brings painful punishment and replacement; then the Prophet's expulsion is recalled: second of two in the cave telling his companion not to grieve for Allah is with us, Allah sent down sakina and supported him with unseen soldiers, making the disbelievers' word lowest and Allah's word highest.

candidates.label: Hypocrite mobilization psychology: conditional loyalty based on proximity of gain, false oaths of willingness, excuse-seeking rooted in doubt-hearts, divine prevention of their departure, fitna-seeking behavior, trial-avoidance pretext masking actual fall into trial, emotional volatility between distress at good and joy at disaster, and tawakkul response affirming divine decree
candidates.normLabel: hypocrite mobilization psychology: conditional loyalty based on proximity of gain, false oaths of willingness, excuse-seeking rooted in doubt-hearts, divine prevention of their departure, fitna-seeking behavior, trial-avoidance pretext masking actual fall into trial, emotional volatility between distress at good and joy at disaster, and tawakkul response affirming divine decree
candidates.definition: In 9:42-52, hypocrites would follow only for easy near gain but the journey seemed far so they swear falsely; only those doubting Allah and Last Day seek excuses while believers do not; Allah disliked their going and held them back; they would add confusion seeking fitna; they ask permission claiming trial-fear but have already fallen into trial; good news distresses them while disaster makes them rejoice claiming prior precaution; the response affirms nothing strikes except by Allah's decree and believers should rely on Him; both sides await outcomes but believers await one of two goods while awaiting punishment for hypocrites.

candidates.label: Expenditure rejection and wealth-as-punishment: spending from hypocrites never accepted whether willing or unwilling because they disbelieve, pray lazily and spend reluctantly; their wealth and children are not impressive but intended as worldly punishment until souls depart in disbelief; they swear belonging out of fear and would flee to any refuge
candidates.normLabel: expenditure rejection and wealth-as-punishment: spending from hypocrites never accepted whether willing or unwilling because they disbelieve, pray lazily and spend reluctantly; their wealth and children are not impressive but intended as worldly punishment until souls depart in disbelief; they swear belonging out of fear and would flee to any refuge
candidates.definition: In 9:53-57, neither willing nor unwilling spending is accepted from them because they are fasiqeen who disbelieve in Allah and His Messenger, come to prayer lazy and spend reluctantly; believers should not be impressed by their wealth or children which serve only as instruments of worldly punishment until death in disbelief; they swear membership out of fear and would flee to any shelter if found.

candidates.label: Zakah distribution framework: eight recipient categories ordained as a divine obligation, with Allah Knowing and Wise
candidates.normLabel: zakah distribution framework: eight recipient categories ordained as a divine obligation, with allah knowing and wise
candidates.definition: In 9:60, zakah expenditures are restricted to the poor, needy, those employed to collect it, those whose hearts are to be reconciled, freeing captives, debtors, Allah's cause, and the stranded traveler — an obligation from Allah who is Knowing and Wise.

candidates.label: Mockery exposure and post-belief disbelief verdict: hypocrites fear revelation exposing their hearts; when confronted they claim mere conversation and play; challenged whether they mock Allah, His verses and Messenger; told no excuse remains as disbelief occurred after professed belief; pardon for one faction, punishment for criminal faction
candidates.normLabel: mockery exposure and post-belief disbelief verdict: hypocrites fear revelation exposing their hearts; when confronted they claim mere conversation and play; challenged whether they mock allah, his verses and messenger; told no excuse remains as disbelief occurred after professed belief; pardon for one faction, punishment for criminal faction
candidates.definition: In 9:64-66, hypocrites fear a surah revealing their hearts and are told to mock freely for Allah will expose what they dread; when questioned they claim idle conversation and play, and are challenged whether they mocked Allah, His verses and His Messenger; told not to excuse themselves for they disbelieved after belief; if one group is pardoned another will be punished because they were criminals.

candidates.label: Inverted moral architecture: hypocrite men and women reinforce each other in enjoining wrong and forbidding right while closing their hands, forgotten by Allah as they forgot Him; contrasted with believing men and women allied in enjoining right, forbidding wrong, establishing prayer, giving zakah and obeying Allah and His Messenger
candidates.normLabel: inverted moral architecture: hypocrite men and women reinforce each other in enjoining wrong and forbidding right while closing their hands, forgotten by allah as they forgot him; contrasted with believing men and women allied in enjoining right, forbidding wrong, establishing prayer, giving zakah and obeying allah and his messenger
candidates.definition: In 9:67 and 9:71, the hypocrite community is described as structurally unified in inverted morality (enjoining munkar, forbidding maruf, withholding spending) resulting in reciprocal divine forgetting; the believer community mirrors this structure with correct moral orientation producing divine mercy.

candidates.label: Historical precedent chain: predecessors stronger in power and richer enjoyed their portion then engaged in vanities like those before them; news of destroyed nations (Nuh, Aad, Thamud, Ibrahim's people, Madyan, overturned towns) confirms messengers brought clear proofs and self-wronging caused destruction
candidates.normLabel: historical precedent chain: predecessors stronger in power and richer enjoyed their portion then engaged in vanities like those before them; news of destroyed nations (nuh, aad, thamud, ibrahim's people, madyan, overturned towns) confirms messengers brought clear proofs and self-wronging caused destruction
candidates.definition: In 9:69-70, contemporary disbelievers are compared to predecessors who were stronger and wealthier yet perished after enjoying their portion and engaging in vanities; the catalog of destroyed peoples confirms messengers came with clear proofs and destruction resulted from self-inflicted wrong, not divine injustice.

candidates.label: Prophetic harshness command and false-oath exposure: Prophet commanded to strive against disbelievers and hypocrites with harshness; hypocrites swear they said nothing while having spoken the word of disbelief after professing Islam, resenting only the enrichment Allah gave them; repentance offered but turning away brings punishment with no earthly protector
candidates.normLabel: prophetic harshness command and false-oath exposure: prophet commanded to strive against disbelievers and hypocrites with harshness; hypocrites swear they said nothing while having spoken the word of disbelief after professing islam, resenting only the enrichment allah gave them; repentance offered but turning away brings punishment with no earthly protector
candidates.definition: In 9:73-74, the Prophet receives a dual command to strive against kuffar and munafiqeen with harshness; the following verse exposes hypocrites who swear they did not speak while having uttered disbelief-words after Islam, harboring resentment only because Allah enriched them, with repentance available but rejection bringing worldly-otherworldly punishment.

candidates.label: Broken covenant producing permanent nifaq: those who covenanted with Allah that if given bounty they would spend and be righteous became stingy upon receiving it and turned away; penalized with hypocrisy implanted in hearts until Judgment Day for breaking promise and habitual lying
candidates.normLabel: broken covenant producing permanent nifaq: those who covenanted with allah that if given bounty they would spend and be righteous became stingy upon receiving it and turned away; penalized with hypocrisy implanted in hearts until judgment day for breaking promise and habitual lying
candidates.definition: In 9:75-77, individuals made conditional covenants promising charity and righteousness if enriched by Allah's bounty; upon receiving it they became stingy and turned away refusing; Allah penalized them by implanting nifaq in their hearts permanently until meeting Him, because they broke their promise and habitually lied.

candidates.label: Intercession limit and contributor-mockery: seventy-times forgiveness seeking cannot benefit those who disbelieve in Allah and His Messenger; those who criticize voluntary contributors and effort-only givers face divine ridicule reciprocation and painful punishment
candidates.normLabel: intercession limit and contributor-mockery: seventy-times forgiveness seeking cannot benefit those who disbelieve in allah and his messenger; those who criticize voluntary contributors and effort-only givers face divine ridicule reciprocation and painful punishment
candidates.definition: In 9:79-80, those who mock believers contributing voluntarily to charity and those who find nothing except their effort are warned that Allah ridicules them and they face painful punishment; asking forgiveness for them seventy times will never result in Allah forgiving them because they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger.

candidates.label: Expedition abandonment consequences: remaining behind rejoicing in sitting produces permanent exclusion from future campaigns; funeral prayer prohibition and grave-standing ban for deceased hypocrites; wealth and children reframed as worldly punishment instruments rather than blessings
candidates.normLabel: expedition abandonment consequences: remaining behind rejoicing in sitting produces permanent exclusion from future campaigns; funeral prayer prohibition and grave-standing ban for deceased hypocrites; wealth and children reframed as worldly punishment instruments rather than blessings
candidates.definition: In 9:81-85, those who remained behind rejoiced in their sitting and disliked striving with wealth and lives in heat are told Hell-fire is hotter; commanded to laugh little and weep much as recompense; upon return told they will never go out again or fight enemies, ordered to sit with remainders; forbidden to pray over their dead or stand at graves; reminded wealth and children are intended as punishment until death in disbelief.

candidates.label: Bedouin sincerity spectrum: some consider spending as loss awaiting misfortune while others believe in Allah and Last Day treating spending as nearness and seeking prophetic invocation; Bedouins generally stronger in kufr and nifaq less likely to know revealed limits
candidates.normLabel: bedouin sincerity spectrum: some consider spending as loss awaiting misfortune while others believe in allah and last day treating spending as nearness and seeking prophetic invocation; bedouins generally stronger in kufr and nifaq less likely to know revealed limits
candidates.definition: In 9:97-99, Bedouins are assessed as stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and less likely to know revealed limits; among them some treat spending as maghram (loss/fine) and await misfortunes for believers while others believe in Allah and Last Day considering spending as qurbat (nearness) seeking the Messenger's prayers which become genuine nearness for them.

candidates.label: Tearful volunteers and wealthy evaders: those who came seeking mounts finding none returned with eyes overflowing tears from grief at inability to spend; blame falls only on rich excuse-seekers satisfied with remaining behind whose hearts Allah sealed
candidates.normLabel: tearful volunteers and wealthy evaders: those who came seeking mounts finding none returned with eyes overflowing tears from grief at inability to spend; blame falls only on rich excuse-seekers satisfied with remaining behind whose hearts allah sealed
candidates.definition: In 9:92-93, those who came requesting transport and were told nothing was available turned away with eyes overflowing tears from grief at inability to contribute; the path of blame is only upon those who ask permission while being wealthy, satisfied to remain with those who stay behind, whose hearts Allah sealed so they do not know.

candidates.label: Return-excuse rejection and divine observation: returning hypocrites make excuses but are told never to excuse for Allah has already informed of their news; Allah and Messenger will observe their deeds; returned to Knower of unseen and witnessed who will inform them of what they did; they swear to be left alone but are rijs destined for Jahannam
candidates.normLabel: return-excuse rejection and divine observation: returning hypocrites make excuses but are told never to excuse for allah has already informed of their news; allah and messenger will observe their deeds; returned to knower of unseen and witnessed who will inform them of what they did; they swear to be left alone but are rijs destined for jahannam
candidates.definition: In 9:94-96, upon return hypocrites offer excuses but are told not to bother for Allah has already informed of their affairs; Allah and Messenger will observe their actions; they will be returned to the Knower of unseen and witnessed who will report their deeds; they swear oaths to be left alone but are declared filth with Hell as refuge; their attempts to satisfy believers fail because Allah is not satisfied with fasiqeen.

candidates.label: Reciprocal divine forgetting and heart-sealing: those who forgot Allah are forgotten by Him in return; those satisfied with remaining behind have their hearts sealed preventing comprehension; laughing little and weeping much as earned eschatological reversal
candidates.normLabel: reciprocal divine forgetting and heart-sealing: those who forgot allah are forgotten by him in return; those satisfied with remaining behind have their hearts sealed preventing comprehension; laughing little and weeping much as earned eschatological reversal
candidates.definition: In 9:67 and 9:82-87, the hypocrite condition is diagnosed through reciprocal forgetting (they forgot Allah so He forgot them) and heart-sealing (those satisfied with sitting had hearts sealed so they do not understand); the eschatological consequence reverses their worldly comfort into little laughter and much weeping as earned recompense.

candidates.label: Bedouin sincerity spectrum and forerunner reward: Bedouins range from treating spending as loss awaiting misfortune to believing and seeking nearness through prophetic invocation; forerunners among Muhajireen and Ansar and their ihsan-followers attain mutual divine pleasure and eternal gardens
candidates.normLabel: bedouin sincerity spectrum and forerunner reward: bedouins range from treating spending as loss awaiting misfortune to believing and seeking nearness through prophetic invocation; forerunners among muhajireen and ansar and their ihsan-followers attain mutual divine pleasure and eternal gardens
candidates.definition: In 9:97-100, Bedouins are assessed as stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy yet containing sincere believers who treat spending as nearness; then the forerunners (sabiqoon awwaloon) among Muhajireen and Ansar and those who followed them with excellence receive Allah's pleasure and their pleasure in Him, with prepared gardens of eternal rivers as the great attainment.

candidates.label: Graded repentance pathways: entrenched hypocrites unknown to Prophet but known to Allah punished twice; confessors of mixed deeds may receive divine turning; deferred cases await Allah's command; sadaqah taken purifies and grows with prophetic invocation providing reassurance; Allah alone accepts tawbah and receives charities
candidates.normLabel: graded repentance pathways: entrenched hypocrites unknown to prophet but known to allah punished twice; confessors of mixed deeds may receive divine turning; deferred cases await allah's command; sadaqah taken purifies and grows with prophetic invocation providing reassurance; allah alone accepts tawbah and receives charities
candidates.definition: In 9:101-106, three categories of post-expedition individuals emerge: hardened hypocrites around Madinah unknown to the Prophet but known to Allah facing double punishment then great punishment; others who confessed sins having mixed righteous and bad deeds hoping for Allah's turning; and deferred cases left to Allah's command whether to punish or forgive. Between these, the sadaqah mechanism is prescribed: take from their wealth charity that purifies and causes growth, invoke blessings upon them for prophetic salah provides reassurance, knowing Allah alone accepts repentance and receives charities as al-Tawwab al-Raheem.

candidates.label: Masjid dirar exposure versus taqwa-founded mosque: building erected for harm, disbelief, division and ambush-station exposed despite false good-intention oaths; commanded never to stand in it; contrasted with mosque founded on taqwa from first day whose men love purification; foundation parable of secure taqwa versus collapsing bank edge falling into Jahannam; doubt remains until hearts stop
candidates.normLabel: masjid dirar exposure versus taqwa-founded mosque: building erected for harm, disbelief, division and ambush-station exposed despite false good-intention oaths; commanded never to stand in it; contrasted with mosque founded on taqwa from first day whose men love purification; foundation parable of secure taqwa versus collapsing bank edge falling into jahannam; doubt remains until hearts stop
candidates.definition: In 9:107-110, those who built a mosque for harm, disbelief, dividing believers and as station for one who warred against Allah and Messenger are exposed; they swear they intended only good but Allah testifies they are liars; the Prophet is forbidden to ever stand in it; a mosque founded on taqwa from the first day is declared worthier, containing men who love purification whom Allah loves; a parable contrasts one founding on taqwa and ridwan with one founding on crumbling bank edge collapsing into Hellfire; the dirar building remains doubt in their hearts until hearts are torn apart.

candidates.label: Divine purchase covenant: Allah bought believers' selves and wealth in exchange for Paradise; they fight kill and are killed; binding promise confirmed across Torah Injeel and Quran; none fulfills covenant better than Allah; commanded to rejoice in the transaction as the great attainment
candidates.normLabel: divine purchase covenant: allah bought believers' selves and wealth in exchange for paradise; they fight kill and are killed; binding promise confirmed across torah injeel and quran; none fulfills covenant better than allah; commanded to rejoice in the transaction as the great attainment
candidates.definition: In 9:111, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and properties in exchange for Paradise; they fight in His cause killing and being killed; this is a binding promise upon Him in the Torah, Gospel and Quran; no one fulfills covenant better than Allah; believers are commanded to rejoice in the transaction they contracted, which is the great attainment.

candidates.label: Nine attributes of covenant believers: repentant, worshipping, praising, journeying, bowing, prostrating, enjoining right, forbidding wrong, guarding Allah's limits — given glad tidings
candidates.normLabel: nine attributes of covenant believers: repentant, worshipping, praising, journeying, bowing, prostrating, enjoining right, forbidding wrong, guarding allah's limits — given glad tidings
candidates.definition: In 9:112, the participants in the divine purchase covenant are characterized by nine active participles: the repentant, worshippers, praisers, travelers/journeyers, those who bow, those who prostrate, those who enjoin right, those who forbid wrong, and those who guard Allah's limits; the Prophet is commanded to give glad tidings to the believers.

candidates.label: Istighfar prohibition for polytheists and Ibrahim precedent: Prophet and believers barred from seeking forgiveness for polytheists even relatives once Hellfire status is clear; Ibrahim's istighfar for his father was only due to a prior promise; when enmity to Allah became apparent he disassociated; Ibrahim described as compassionate and forbearing
candidates.normLabel: istighfar prohibition for polytheists and ibrahim precedent: prophet and believers barred from seeking forgiveness for polytheists even relatives once hellfire status is clear; ibrahim's istighfar for his father was only due to a prior promise; when enmity to allah became apparent he disassociated; ibrahim described as compassionate and forbearing
candidates.definition: In 9:113-114, it is not for the Prophet or believers to seek forgiveness for polytheists even if relatives after it becomes clear they are companions of Hellfire; Ibrahim's istighfar for his father was only because of a promise he made to him; when it became clear his father was an enemy to Allah he disassociated himself; Ibrahim is described as awwah (compassionate/supplicating) and haleem (forbearing/patient).

candidates.label: Guidance clarification principle and absolute dominion: Allah does not misguide a people after guiding them until He clarifies what they should avoid; Allah possesses dominion of heavens and earth, gives life and causes death, and no protector or helper exists besides Him
candidates.normLabel: guidance clarification principle and absolute dominion: allah does not misguide a people after guiding them until he clarifies what they should avoid; allah possesses dominion of heavens and earth, gives life and causes death, and no protector or helper exists besides him
candidates.definition: In 9:115-116, a theological principle is established that Allah would not let a people stray after guidance until He makes clear what they must guard against, for He knows all things; then absolute divine dominion is declared over heavens and earth with power over life and death, leaving no protector or helper besides Allah.

candidates.label: Hour-of-difficulty forgiveness and the three left behind: Allah turned in forgiveness to the Prophet, Muhajireen and Ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after hearts nearly swerved; also forgave three left behind whose earth narrowed despite vastness and souls confined until certain no refuge from Allah except in Him, then He turned so they could repent
candidates.normLabel: hour-of-difficulty forgiveness and the three left behind: allah turned in forgiveness to the prophet, muhajireen and ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after hearts nearly swerved; also forgave three left behind whose earth narrowed despite vastness and souls confined until certain no refuge from allah except in him, then he turned so they could repent
candidates.definition: In 9:117-118, Allah's forgiveness extends to the Prophet and the emigrant-helper community who accompanied him during extreme hardship after some hearts almost deviated; then specifically to three individuals left behind who experienced such intense constriction that earth felt narrow despite its vastness and their own souls pressed upon them until they realized there is no refuge from Allah except toward Him, at which point He turned to them so they could repent.

candidates.label: Truthfulness companionship and comprehensive deed-registration: believers commanded to fear Allah and be with the truthful; Madinah people and surrounding Bedouins must not remain behind the Messenger or prefer themselves over him; every thirst, fatigue, hunger, ground-treading that enrages disbelievers, enemy-infliction, and expenditure small or large registered as righteous deed; Allah does not waste muhsineen reward
candidates.normLabel: truthfulness companionship and comprehensive deed-registration: believers commanded to fear allah and be with the truthful; madinah people and surrounding bedouins must not remain behind the messenger or prefer themselves over him; every thirst, fatigue, hunger, ground-treading that enrages disbelievers, enemy-infliction, and expenditure small or large registered as righteous deed; allah does not waste muhsineen reward
candidates.definition: In 9:119-121, after the repentance narratives, believers are commanded to maintain taqwa and keep company with the truthful; the community around Madinah is told not to stay behind the Messenger or value themselves above him; then an exhaustive registration system is described where every hardship endured and expenditure made in Allah's cause is recorded as righteous deed, for Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.

candidates.label: Knowledge-mobilization balance and divergent revelation effects: believers need not mobilize entirely; a group from each division must remain for deep religious understanding to warn returning people; adjacent disbelievers fought with visible harshness; each revealed surah increases believers in faith with rejoicing while adding filth to diseased hearts who die disbelieving; annual trials unmet by repentance or remembrance; hypocrites glance for observers then slip away with hearts turned; Messenger from among yourselves grieved by your suffering concerned for you kind merciful to believers; closing tawakkul confession
candidates.normLabel: knowledge-mobilization balance and divergent revelation effects: believers need not mobilize entirely; a group from each division must remain for deep religious understanding to warn returning people; adjacent disbelievers fought with visible harshness; each revealed surah increases believers in faith with rejoicing while adding filth to diseased hearts who die disbelieving; annual trials unmet by repentance or remembrance; hypocrites glance for observers then slip away with hearts turned; messenger from among yourselves grieved by your suffering concerned for you kind merciful to believers; closing tawakkul confession
candidates.definition: In 9:122-129, the surah transitions from total mobilization to balanced knowledge preservation: a group from each division stays for tafaqqah fi al-din to warn their people on return; adjacent disbelievers are to be fought with visible harshness; the effect of revelation is shown to bifurcate communities: believers gain faith and rejoice while diseased hearts gain filth upon filth dying in disbelief; hypocrites face annual trials without repentance, glancing for observers before slipping away with divinely-turned hearts; the surah closes with the Prophet's characterization as one from among them for whom their suffering is grievous, concerned over them, kind and merciful to believers; final verse teaches the tawakkul confession when they turn away.

candidates.label: Quran as wise Book establishing divine authorship
candidates.normLabel: quran as wise book establishing divine authorship
candidates.definition: In 10:1: Alif Lam Ra — these are the verses of the wise Book establishing the Quran's divine origin and structural coherence.

candidates.label: Creation signs in celestial bodies and temporal cycles
candidates.normLabel: creation signs in celestial bodies and temporal cycles
candidates.definition: In 10:5: Sun as shining light, moon as derived light with determined phases enabling knowledge of years and calculation.

candidates.label: Two categories of humanity based on divine meeting expectation
candidates.normLabel: two categories of humanity based on divine meeting expectation
candidates.definition: In 10:7-8: Those not expecting meeting with Allah satisfied with worldly life versus believers expecting divine encounter.

candidates.label: Believer reward in gardens with peace greeting
candidates.normLabel: believer reward in gardens with peace greeting
candidates.definition: In 10:9-10: Believers doing righteous deeds guided by faith to gardens with rivers, calling Exalted are You O Allah with peace greeting.

candidates.label: Human inconsistency in supplication during adversity versus prosperity
candidates.normLabel: human inconsistency in supplication during adversity versus prosperity
candidates.definition: In 10:12: When affliction touches man he calls upon Us lying sitting standing but when We remove affliction he continues as if never called.

candidates.label: Historical precedent of destroyed communities receiving clear evidence
candidates.normLabel: historical precedent of destroyed communities receiving clear evidence
candidates.definition: In 10:13: We destroyed generations before you when they wronged despite messengers coming with clear proofs.

candidates.label: Succession principle enabling observation of human conduct
candidates.normLabel: succession principle enabling observation of human conduct
candidates.definition: In 10:14: We made you successors in the land after them so that We may observe how you will do.

candidates.label: Demand for different Quran or altered revelation rejected
candidates.normLabel: demand for different quran or altered revelation rejected
candidates.definition: In 10:15: Those not expecting meeting say bring different Quran or change it — prophet responds cannot change what is revealed.

candidates.label: Fabricating lies against Allah as ultimate injustice
candidates.normLabel: fabricating lies against allah as ultimate injustice
candidates.definition: In 10:17: Who is more unjust than one who invents lie about Allah or denies His signs — criminals will not succeed.

candidates.label: Intercessors beside Allah cannot harm or benefit
candidates.normLabel: intercessors beside allah cannot harm or benefit
candidates.definition: In 10:18: They worship besides Allah what neither harms nor benefits claiming these are intercessors — Allah sufficient witness.

candidates.label: Maritime peril revealing sincere supplication under duress
candidates.normLabel: maritime peril revealing sincere supplication under duress
candidates.definition: In 10:22: When stormy wind and waves surround ships passengers call upon Allah sincerely promising gratitude if saved.

candidates.label: Immediate return to injustice after divine rescue
candidates.normLabel: immediate return to injustice after divine rescue
candidates.definition: In 10:23: When He saves them at once they commit injustice upon earth without right — addressed directly to mankind.

candidates.label: Worldly life parable as temporary vegetation
candidates.normLabel: worldly life parable as temporary vegetation
candidates.definition: In 10:24: Example of worldly life like rain producing plants that grow and adorn until earth takes ornamentation then command comes stripping bare.

candidates.label: Dual invitation to Home of Peace and straight path
candidates.normLabel: dual invitation to home of peace and straight path
candidates.definition: In 10:25: Allah invites to Dar al-Salam and guides whom He wills to straight path.

candidates.label: Asymmetric recompense for good versus evil deeds
candidates.normLabel: asymmetric recompense for good versus evil deeds
candidates.definition: In 10:26-27: Good-doers receive best reward plus extra with no darkness; evil-doers receive equivalent recompense with humiliation and dark faces.

candidates.label: Universal messenger principle with fair judgment
candidates.normLabel: universal messenger principle with fair judgment
candidates.definition: In 10:47: Every nation has a messenger; when messenger comes judgment is made between them fairly and they are not wronged.

candidates.label: Quranic inimitability challenge requiring ten comparable surahs
candidates.normLabel: quranic inimitability challenge requiring ten comparable surahs
candidates.definition: In 10:38: Say bring ten surahs like it invented and call upon whomever you can besides Allah if you are truthful.

candidates.label: Divine witness sufficiency between prophet and rejecters
candidates.normLabel: divine witness sufficiency between prophet and rejecters
candidates.definition: In 10:46: Say sufficient is Allah as witness between me and you and whoever has knowledge of the Scripture.

candidates.label: Human conspiracy against divine signs after receiving mercy
candidates.normLabel: human conspiracy against divine signs after receiving mercy
candidates.definition: In 10:21: When We give people taste of mercy after adversity they conspire against Our verses.

candidates.label: Travel safety as divine sign enabling recognition of providence
candidates.normLabel: travel safety as divine sign enabling recognition of providence
candidates.definition: In 10:22: He enables travel on land and sea until ships sail with good wind and passengers rejoice.

candidates.label: Divine patience with delayed punishment enabling repentance
candidates.normLabel: divine patience with delayed punishment enabling repentance
candidates.definition: In 10:49: Say if I possessed for myself harm or benefit except what Allah wills — every nation has a term that cannot be delayed.

candidates.label: Linguistic miracle challenge proving Quranic divine origin
candidates.normLabel: linguistic miracle challenge proving quranic divine origin
candidates.definition: In 10:37-38: This Quran could not be produced by other than Allah; bring ten surahs like it if truthful.

candidates.label: Prayer-zakah-sincere-worship triad as religious foundation
candidates.normLabel: prayer-zakah-sincere-worship triad as religious foundation
candidates.definition: In 10:87: Establish prayer give zakah and worship Allah with sincere religion.

candidates.label: Straight path command with prohibition of scattering alternatives
candidates.normLabel: straight path command with prohibition of scattering alternatives
candidates.definition: In 10:93: Follow the straight path and do not follow other paths that scatter you from His way.

candidates.label: Divine guidance-misguidance sovereignty linked to wisdom
candidates.normLabel: divine guidance-misguidance sovereignty linked to wisdom
candidates.definition: In 10:52: Allah misleads whom He wills and guides whom He wills — He is the Wise the Knowing.

candidates.label: Conditional faith pattern correlated with circumstances
candidates.normLabel: conditional faith pattern correlated with circumstances
candidates.definition: In 10:48-49: They say when is this promise if truthful — belief emerges only when harm touches then disappears with relief.

candidates.label: Every soul tested individually on Day of Return
candidates.normLabel: every soul tested individually on day of return
candidates.definition: In 10:30: There every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously and returned to Allah their true master.

candidates.label: Dispute concerning Quran resolved only by prior belief
candidates.normLabel: dispute concerning quran resolved only by prior belief
candidates.definition: In 10:39: They dispute concerning it but none believe in it except those who submitted before its revelation.

candidates.label: Ethical decalogue embedded within theological argument
candidates.normLabel: ethical decalogue embedded within theological argument
candidates.definition: In 10:93: Do not approach orphan property except best way; give full measure weight with justice; speak justly even toward relative; fulfill covenant of Allah.

candidates.label: Brief worldly enjoyment as deceptive prelude to punishment
candidates.normLabel: brief worldly enjoyment as deceptive prelude to punishment
candidates.definition: In 10:52: Enjoyment of worldly life is brief then to Us is their return and We make them taste severe punishment.

candidates.label: Nuh tawakkul declaration as model of prophetic trust
candidates.normLabel: nuh tawakkul declaration as model of prophetic trust
candidates.definition: In 10:71: Upon Allah I trust and to Him I turn in repentance — Nuh's declaration before his people.

candidates.label: Flood as divine sign and salvation mechanism
candidates.normLabel: flood as divine sign and salvation mechanism
candidates.definition: In 10:73: They denied him so We saved him and those with him in the ark and made them successors and drowned deniers.

candidates.label: Musa-Firawn confrontation with clear signs and magician conversion
candidates.normLabel: musa-firawn confrontation with clear signs and magician conversion
candidates.definition: In 10:75-81: Musa and Harun sent to Firawn with clear authority; magicians believed after seeing truth; Firawn accused sorcery.

candidates.label: Delayed belief after witnessing punishment provides no benefit
candidates.normLabel: delayed belief after witnessing punishment provides no benefit
candidates.definition: In 10:96-97: Those against whom word proved due did not believe even when seeing punishment — faith must precede consequence.

candidates.label: Yunus exception proving timely belief efficacy
candidates.normLabel: yunus exception proving timely belief efficacy
candidates.definition: In 10:98: No town believed and benefited from faith except people of Yunus — when they believed We removed disgrace and granted enjoyment.

candidates.label: Divine compulsion impossibility preserving human agency
candidates.normLabel: divine compulsion impossibility preserving human agency
candidates.definition: In 10:99: If your Lord had willed all on earth would have believed together — would you compel people to be believers?

candidates.label: No soul believes except by Allah's permission
candidates.normLabel: no soul believes except by allah's permission
candidates.definition: In 10:100: No soul can believe except by Allah's permission and He places wrath upon those who do not reason.

candidates.label: Final tawakkul command with patience awaiting divine judgment
candidates.normLabel: final tawakkul command with patience awaiting divine judgment
candidates.definition: In 10:109: Follow what has been revealed to you and be patient until Allah judges — He is the best of judges.

candidates.label: Individual responsibility principle in guidance and misguidance
candidates.normLabel: individual responsibility principle in guidance and misguidance
candidates.definition: In 10:108: Whoever is guided is guided for himself and whoever goes astray goes astray against himself — I am not guardian over you.

candidates.label: Creation signs in heavens and earth as universal evidence
candidates.normLabel: creation signs in heavens and earth as universal evidence
candidates.definition: In 10:101: Say look at what is in heavens and earth — signs and warners do not benefit people who refuse to believe.

candidates.label: Perfected-detailed Book: Quran described as uhkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat from Hakeem Khabeer establishing dual quality of precision and elaboration
candidates.normLabel: perfected-detailed book: quran described as uhkimat ayatuhu thumma fussilat from hakeem khabeer establishing dual quality of precision and elaboration
candidates.definition: In 11:1: Alif Lam Ra. A Book whose verses are perfected then detailed from One Wise Acquainted.

candidates.label: Istighfar-provision linkage: seeking forgiveness and repentance yields good temporal provision and favor distribution connecting spiritual practice to material well-being
candidates.normLabel: istighfar-provision linkage: seeking forgiveness and repentance yields good temporal provision and favor distribution connecting spiritual practice to material well-being
candidates.definition: In 11:3: Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him. He will let you enjoy good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor.

candidates.label: Human psychological volatility: mercy withdrawal produces despair-ingratitude while favor after hardship produces boastful exultation revealing fortune-dependent faith instability
candidates.normLabel: human psychological volatility: mercy withdrawal produces despair-ingratitude while favor after hardship produces boastful exultation revealing fortune-dependent faith instability
candidates.definition: In 11:9-10: If We give man mercy then withdraw it he is despairing ungrateful. If We give favor after hardship he says bad times left me indeed he is exultant boastful.

candidates.label: Ten-surah challenge: falsification criterion demanding production of ten invented surahs calling upon anyone besides Allah proving Quran's divine origin through non-response
candidates.normLabel: ten-surah challenge: falsification criterion demanding production of ten invented surahs calling upon anyone besides allah proving quran's divine origin through non-response
candidates.definition: In 11:13-14: Say bring ten surahs like it invented and call whomever you can besides Allah if truthful. If they do not respond know it was revealed with Allah's knowledge.

candidates.label: Worldly-desire seekers fully repaid here: those wanting dunya life and adornment receive complete compensation without deprivation but Fire alone in Hereafter with worthless deeds
candidates.normLabel: worldly-desire seekers fully repaid here: those wanting dunya life and adornment receive complete compensation without deprivation but fire alone in hereafter with worthless deeds
candidates.definition: In 11:15-16: Whoever desires worldly life We fully repay their deeds therein not deprived. Those have only Fire in Hereafter; lost what they made worthless what they did.

candidates.label: Clear-evidence believer with divine witness: person on bayyinah from Lord with shahid minhu and Musa's Book as imam-mercy believes in Quran establishing multi-source verification
candidates.normLabel: clear-evidence believer with divine witness: person on bayyinah from lord with shahid minhu and musa's book as imam-mercy believes in quran establishing multi-source verification
candidates.definition: In 11:17: Is one on clear evidence from Lord followed by witness from Him and before it Musa's Book as leader and mercy? Those believe in it.

candidates.label: Supreme injustice of fabricating lies against Allah: inventing falsehood about God as worst wrongdoing with public exposure before Lord and witness testimony confirming lying
candidates.normLabel: supreme injustice of fabricating lies against allah: inventing falsehood about god as worst wrongdoing with public exposure before lord and witness testimony confirming lying
candidates.definition: In 11:18: Who is more unjust than one who invents lie about Allah? Those presented before Lord witnesses say these lied against Lord. Curse of Allah on wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Two-party parable: blind-deaf versus seeing-hearing as fundamental epistemological divide illustrating irreducible inequality between disbelief and faith
candidates.normLabel: two-party parable: blind-deaf versus seeing-hearing as fundamental epistemological divide illustrating irreducible inequality between disbelief and faith
candidates.definition: In 11:24: Example of two parties like blind-deaf and seeing-hearing. Are they equal? Will you not remember?

candidates.label: Universal creature provision doctrine: every dabbah on earth has rizq guaranteed by Allah who knows mustaqarr and mustawda' all recorded in kitab mubeen
candidates.normLabel: universal creature provision doctrine: every dabbah on earth has rizq guaranteed by allah who knows mustaqarr and mustawda' all recorded in kitab mubeen
candidates.definition: In 11:6: No creature on earth but upon Allah is its provision. He knows its dwelling and storage. All in clear register.

candidates.label: Creation as test of best conduct: six-day creation with Throne on water explicitly purposed to test which person is best in deed establishing existence as examination
candidates.normLabel: creation as test of best conduct: six-day creation with throne on water explicitly purposed to test which person is best in deed establishing existence as examination
candidates.definition: In 11:7: He created heavens earth in six days His Throne on water to test you which is best in deed.

candidates.label: Elite social-status rejection: dismissing prophet as mere man followed by lowest social class (arathiluna badiya al-rrayi) revealing class-based epistemological barrier
candidates.normLabel: elite social-status rejection: dismissing prophet as mere man followed by lowest social class (arathiluna badiya al-rrayi) revealing class-based epistemological barrier
candidates.definition: In 11:27: Eminent disbelievers said we see you only as man like us followed only by lowest among us at first suggestion. We see no merit in you; we think you liars.

candidates.label: Prophetic disavowal template: Nuh denies possessing treasuries unseen-knowledge or angelhood affirming pure messenger function limited to conveyed revelation
candidates.normLabel: prophetic disavowal template: nuh denies possessing treasuries unseen-knowledge or angelhood affirming pure messenger function limited to conveyed revelation
candidates.definition: In 11:31: I do not say I have Allah's treasuries or know unseen or am angel. Allah knows best what is in their souls.

candidates.label: Believer protection principle: refusing to expel low-status believers because they will meet their Lord establishing divine accountability as social-equality guarantor
candidates.normLabel: believer protection principle: refusing to expel low-status believers because they will meet their lord establishing divine accountability as social-equality guarantor
candidates.definition: In 11:29-30: I am not driving away believers; they will meet their Lord. Who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away?

candidates.label: Ship construction under divine observation: building bi-a'yunina wawahyina establishing continuous supervision and inspiration during obedient labor amid ridicule
candidates.normLabel: ship construction under divine observation: building bi-a'yunina wawahyina establishing continuous supervision and inspiration during obedient labor amid ridicule
candidates.definition: In 11:37: Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration. Do not address Me concerning wrongdoers; they are drowned.

candidates.label: Father-son separation by faith: Nuh's son refuses boarding seeking mountain refuge; waves separate them; divine correction redefines family by righteousness not blood
candidates.normLabel: father-son separation by faith: nuh's son refuses boarding seeking mountain refuge; waves separate them; divine correction redefines family by righteousness not blood
candidates.definition: In 11:42-46: Son says I will take refuge on mountain. Nuh says no protector today except mercy. Waves separated them. Nuh appeals son is family. Allah says not of family; unrighteous work; do not ask without knowledge.

candidates.label: Disembarkation blessing with future warning: salam-barakat upon Nuh and nations from those with him; other nations enjoy then face painful punishment
candidates.normLabel: disembarkation blessing with future warning: salam-barakat upon nuh and nations from those with him; other nations enjoy then face painful punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:48: Disembark in peace from Us and blessings upon you and nations from those with you. Other nations We grant enjoyment then painful punishment touches them.

candidates.label: Hud's istighfar-rain-strength promise: seek forgiveness repent yields rain showers and added strength linking spiritual renewal to environmental and physical empowerment
candidates.normLabel: hud's istighfar-rain-strength promise: seek forgiveness repent yields rain showers and added strength linking spiritual renewal to environmental and physical empowerment
candidates.definition: In 11:52: O my people seek forgiveness of your Lord then repent. He will send sky rain in showers and increase you strength added to your strength.

candidates.label: Tawakkul with forelock-holding imagery: Hud declares reliance on Allah who holds every creature's forelock establishing total divine control metaphor
candidates.normLabel: tawakkul with forelock-holding imagery: hud declares reliance on allah who holds every creature's forelock establishing total divine control metaphor
candidates.definition: In 11:56: I have relied upon Allah my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but He holds its forelock. My Lord is on straight path.

candidates.label: Ad's obstinate tyranny pattern: rejected signs disobeyed messengers followed every jabbar aneed establishing leadership-following as destruction mechanism
candidates.normLabel: ad's obstinate tyranny pattern: rejected signs disobeyed messengers followed every jabbar aneed establishing leadership-following as destruction mechanism
candidates.definition: In 11:59: That was Ad who rejected Lord's signs disobeyed His messengers followed command of every obstinate tyrant.

candidates.label: Double-world curse: Ad followed by curse in this world and Resurrection Day establishing comprehensive consequences extending beyond temporal punishment
candidates.normLabel: double-world curse: ad followed by curse in this world and resurrection day establishing comprehensive consequences extending beyond temporal punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:60: They were followed in this world with curse and on Resurrection Day. Indeed Ad denied their Lord; away with Ad people of Hud.

candidates.label: She-camel as divine sign with harm prohibition: naqat Allah designated as ayah with feeding permission and touching-harm prohibition triggering timed punishment
candidates.normLabel: she-camel as divine sign with harm prohibition: naqat allah designated as ayah with feeding permission and touching-harm prohibition triggering timed punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:64-65: This she-camel of Allah is sign for you. Let her feed on Allah's earth. Do not touch with harm or impending punishment takes you. They hamstrung her.

candidates.label: Sayhah destruction pattern: shriek seizes wrongdoers leaving them prone in homes as if never prospered establishing sudden-total annihilation signature
candidates.normLabel: sayhah destruction pattern: shriek seizes wrongdoers leaving them prone in homes as if never prospered establishing sudden-total annihilation signature
candidates.definition: In 11:67-68: Shriek seized wrongdoers; they became prone in homes. As if never prospered. Thamud denied Lord; away with Thamud.

candidates.label: Ibrahim's hospitality model: immediate salam exchange roasted calf offering establishing prophetic hospitality standard with guest honor priority
candidates.normLabel: ibrahim's hospitality model: immediate salam exchange roasted calf offering establishing prophetic hospitality standard with guest honor priority
candidates.definition: In 11:69: Messengers came to Ibrahim with glad tidings. They said peace. He said peace. Did not delay bringing roasted calf.

candidates.label: Sarah's amazed laughter at old-age birth: human limitation confronted by divine creative power producing astonished joy mixed with incredulity
candidates.normLabel: sarah's amazed laughter at old-age birth: human limitation confronted by divine creative power producing astonished joy mixed with incredulity
candidates.definition: In 11:71-72: Wife standing smiled. Given glad tidings of Ishaq and Yaqub. She said woe to me shall I bear when old and husband old? Amazing thing!

candidates.label: Intercession boundary: Ibrahim's pleading for Lot halted by angels declaring Lord's command arrived punishment irrevocable establishing prophetic-intercession limits
candidates.normLabel: intercession boundary: ibrahim's pleading for lot halted by angels declaring lord's command arrived punishment irrevocable establishing prophetic-intercession limits
candidates.definition: In 11:74-76: After fright left and glad tidings came he argued concerning Lot. Angels said give up; Lord's command come; punishment cannot be repelled.

candidates.label: Lot's protective anguish for guests: host distress at community intentions offering daughters as purer alternative revealing extreme hospitality obligation
candidates.normLabel: lot's protective anguish for guests: host distress at community intentions offering daughters as purer alternative revealing extreme hospitality obligation
candidates.definition: In 11:77-79: Lot anguished felt discomfort said trying day. People hastening doing evil. He said these my daughters purer for you fear Allah do not disgrace me in guests.

candidates.label: City inversion and sijjeel stone rain: high-made-low with marked stones from Lord establishing distinctive punishment signature for Lut's people
candidates.normLabel: city inversion and sijjeel stone rain: high-made-low with marked stones from lord establishing distinctive punishment signature for lut's people
candidates.definition: In 11:82-83: When command came We made high low rained stones of layered hard clay marked from your Lord not far from wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Economic justice as prophetic mission: Shu'ayb combines tawheed with measure-weight fairness prohibiting deprivation and earth-corruption linking commerce to faith
candidates.normLabel: economic justice as prophetic mission: shu'ayb combines tawheed with measure-weight fairness prohibiting deprivation and earth-corruption linking commerce to faith
candidates.definition: In 11:84-85: Worship Allah no deity other Him. Do not decrease measure scale. Give full measure weight in justice. Do not deprive people things. Do not abuse earth corrupting.

candidates.label: Baqiyyat Allah concept: what remains lawful from Allah is best for believers linking honest remainder to faith condition as economic-spiritual principle
candidates.normLabel: baqiyyat allah concept: what remains lawful from allah is best for believers linking honest remainder to faith condition as economic-spiritual principle
candidates.definition: In 11:86: What remains from Allah is best for you if you are believers. I am not guardian over you.

candidates.label: Reform-intent declaration: Shu'ayb states only intending islaha as able with success only through Allah establishing prophetic methodology combining effort with tawakkul
candidates.normLabel: reform-intent declaration: shu'ayb states only intending islaha as able with success only through allah establishing prophetic methodology combining effort with tawakkul
candidates.definition: In 11:88: I only intend reform as much as I am able. My success is only through Allah. Upon Him I rely and to Him I return.

candidates.label: Leadership-to-Fire pattern: Firawn leads people into Fire on Resurrection demonstrating that following non-rashid leadership produces collective damnation
candidates.normLabel: leadership-to-fire pattern: firawn leads people into fire on resurrection demonstrating that following non-rashid leadership produces collective damnation
candidates.definition: In 11:97-98: They followed Firawn's command; not rashid. He precedes people on Resurrection leads them into Fire; wretched destination.

candidates.label: Self-wronging principle: Allah did not wrong destroyed communities; they wronged themselves; false gods availed nothing establishing divine justice in punishment
candidates.normLabel: self-wronging principle: allah did not wrong destroyed communities; they wronged themselves; false gods availed nothing establishing divine justice in punishment
candidates.definition: In 11:101: We did not wrong them but they wronged themselves. Their gods invoked besides Allah availed nothing when Lord's command came.

candidates.label: Shaqiyy-sa'eed duality with conditional eternity: wretched in Fire prosperous in Paradise both abiding while heavens earth endure except what Lord wills preserving divine sovereignty
candidates.normLabel: shaqiyy-sa'eed duality with conditional eternity: wretched in fire prosperous in paradise both abiding while heavens earth endure except what lord wills preserving divine sovereignty
candidates.definition: In 11:107-108: Wretched in Fire with exhaling inhaling abiding while heavens earth endure except Lord wills; Lord is Effecter of what He intends. Prosperous in Paradise abiding similarly; uninterrupted bestowal.

candidates.label: Istiqamah command: remain steadfast as commanded with those who turned with you; do not transgress; He is Seeing establishing perseverance-community-vigilance triad
candidates.normLabel: istiqamah command: remain steadfast as commanded with those who turned with you; do not transgress; he is seeing establishing perseverance-community-vigilance triad
candidates.definition: In 11:112: Remain steadfast as commanded, you and those who turned with you. Do not transgress. Indeed He is Seeing of what you do.

candidates.label: Anti-inclination to wrongdoers: do not lean toward oppressors lest Fire touch you; no protectors besides Allah; no help available establishing association-danger principle
candidates.normLabel: anti-inclination to wrongdoers: do not lean toward oppressors lest fire touch you; no protectors besides allah; no help available establishing association-danger principle
