candidates.definition: In 11:113: Do not incline toward wrongdoers lest Fire touch you. You have no protectors besides Allah; then you would not be helped.

candidates.label: Hasanat remove sayyi'at: good deeds actively eliminate misdeeds establishing practical spiritual purification mechanism tied to prayer timing
candidates.normLabel: hasanat remove sayyi'at: good deeds actively eliminate misdeeds establishing practical spiritual purification mechanism tied to prayer timing
candidates.definition: In 11:114: Establish prayer at two ends of day and night approach. Indeed good deeds remove misdeeds. That is reminder for rememberers.

candidates.label: Uloo baqiyyah diagnosis: why no generations with enduring discrimination forbidding corruption? Few saved; wrongdoers pursued luxury were criminals identifying civilizational-collapse mechanism
candidates.normLabel: uloo baqiyyah diagnosis: why no generations with enduring discrimination forbidding corruption? few saved; wrongdoers pursued luxury were criminals identifying civilizational-collapse mechanism
candidates.definition: In 11:116: Why were there not among generations before those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption except few We saved? Wrongdoers pursued luxury therein and were criminals.

candidates.label: Divine justice constraint: Lord would not destroy cities unjustly while people are reformers establishing muslihoona as divine-punishment safeguard
candidates.normLabel: divine justice constraint: lord would not destroy cities unjustly while people are reformers establishing muslihoona as divine-punishment safeguard
candidates.definition: In 11:117: Your Lord would not destroy cities unjustly while their people are reformers.

candidates.label: Difference as divine will: if Lord willed could make mankind one community but they continue differing; mercy-exception as creation purpose
candidates.normLabel: difference as divine will: if lord willed could make mankind one community but they continue differing; mercy-exception as creation purpose
candidates.definition: In 11:118-119: If Lord willed He could make mankind one community but they differ. Except whom Lord mercied; for that He created them.

candidates.label: Closing tawheed-tawakkul synthesis: Allah owns unseen heavens earth; all matter returns to Him; worship and rely on Him; Lord not unaware of deeds
candidates.normLabel: closing tawheed-tawakkul synthesis: allah owns unseen heavens earth; all matter returns to him; worship and rely on him; lord not unaware of deeds
candidates.definition: In 11:123: To Allah belongs unseen of heavens earth. To Him returns all matter. Worship Him and rely on Him. Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.

candidates.label: Quran as ahsan al-qasas establishing prophetic storytelling paradigm
candidates.normLabel: quran as ahsan al-qasas establishing prophetic storytelling paradigm
candidates.definition: In 12:3: We relate to you the best of narratives through Our revelation of this Quran.

candidates.label: Cosmic dream foreshadowing future familial authority
candidates.normLabel: cosmic dream foreshadowing future familial authority
candidates.definition: In 12:4: Yusuf saw eleven stars and sun and moon prostrating to him.

candidates.label: Paternal warning against sibling jealousy and shaytan exploitation
candidates.normLabel: paternal warning against sibling jealousy and shaytan exploitation
candidates.definition: In 12:5: Do not relate your vision to your brothers lest they devise a plan against you — shaytan is an open enemy.

candidates.label: Fratricidal conspiracy driven by perceived paternal favoritism
candidates.normLabel: fratricidal conspiracy driven by perceived paternal favoritism
candidates.definition: In 12:8-9: Brothers say Yusuf and his brother more beloved to father than us though we are stronger group — kill Yusuf or exile him.

candidates.label: Well-as-transition motif from family to foreign providence
candidates.normLabel: well-as-transition motif from family to foreign providence
candidates.definition: In 12:10: Cast him into bottom of well — some travelers will pick him up. Well functions as liminal space between abandonment and divine rescue.

candidates.label: Divine providence through commercial transaction
candidates.normLabel: divine providence through commercial transaction
candidates.definition: In 12:19-20: Caravan water-scout finds Yusuf at well; sold for few dirhams counted out — divine plan operating through mundane commerce.

candidates.label: Sexual temptation resisted through isti'adha (divine refuge)
candidates.normLabel: sexual temptation resisted through isti'adha (divine refuge)
candidates.definition: In 12:23: She said come to me; he said ma'adh Allah — my lord has made my residence good. Seeking refuge in Allah from sin.

candidates.label: Garment-tearing as forensic evidence of innocence
candidates.normLabel: garment-tearing as forensic evidence of innocence
candidates.definition: In 12:25-28: Garment torn from behind proves Yusuf fled rather than pursued; witness from her family testifies to directional evidence.

candidates.label: Collective female recognition of Yusuf's extraordinary nature
candidates.normLabel: collective female recognition of yusuf's extraordinary nature
candidates.definition: In 12:31: Women of city invited, given knives, amazed at Yusuf's beauty cutting their hands saying hash lil-lah this is no human but noble angel.

candidates.label: Voluntary imprisonment chosen over moral compromise
candidates.normLabel: voluntary imprisonment chosen over moral compromise
candidates.definition: In 12:33: Yusuf says Lord prison is dearer to me than what they invite me to — choosing confinement over sin.

candidates.label: Dream interpretation preceded by tawheed instruction
candidates.normLabel: dream interpretation preceded by tawheed instruction
candidates.definition: In 12:37-40: Before interpreting dreams Yusuf teaches monotheism rejecting multiple lords affirming judgment belongs to Allah alone.

candidates.label: Dual prisoner dreams demonstrating interpretive accuracy
candidates.normLabel: dual prisoner dreams demonstrating interpretive accuracy
candidates.definition: In 12:36-41: Wine-presser will serve king again; baker will be crucified and birds eat from head — both fulfilled exactly.

candidates.label: Royal dream crisis enabling emergence from obscurity
candidates.normLabel: royal dream crisis enabling emergence from obscurity
candidates.definition: In 12:43-49: King dreams seven fat cows eaten by seven lean seven green ears dry; nobles confused; released prisoner remembers Yusuf.

candidates.label: Delayed remembrance as divine timing mechanism
candidates.normLabel: delayed remembrance as divine timing mechanism
candidates.definition: In 12:42: Shaytan made him forget mentioning Yusuf to his lord — so Yusuf remained in prison several more years.

candidates.label: Conditional release requiring prior public exoneration
candidates.normLabel: conditional release requiring prior public exoneration
candidates.definition: In 12:50-51: King says bring him; Yusuf says return to your lord ask about women who cut hands — refuses freedom without cleared name.

candidates.label: Institutional appointment based on proven trustworthiness and knowledge
candidates.normLabel: institutional appointment based on proven trustworthiness and knowledge
candidates.definition: In 12:55: Yusuf says appoint me over storehouses inni hafizun aleem — I am a knowing guardian.

candidates.label: Forensic testimony establishing innocence through garment direction
candidates.normLabel: forensic testimony establishing innocence through garment direction
candidates.definition: In 12:26-28: Witness from her family testifies if torn from front she truthful if from behind he truthful — garment torn from behind confirms Yusuf.

candidates.label: Public female confession confirming Yusuf's virtue
candidates.normLabel: public female confession confirming yusuf's virtue
candidates.definition: In 12:51: King asks women what was your affair when you seduced Yusuf; they say hash lil-lah we know no evil of him.

candidates.label: Aziz wife's admission of guilt completing exoneration
candidates.normLabel: aziz wife's admission of guilt completing exoneration
candidates.definition: In 12:51: Aziz's wife says now truth has become manifest — I seduced him and he is among the truthful.

candidates.label: Seven-year agricultural cycle as divine sign and administrative framework
candidates.normLabel: seven-year agricultural cycle as divine sign and administrative framework
candidates.definition: In 12:47-49: Seven years of abundance followed by seven years of drought consuming stored grain except little preserved.

candidates.label: Administrative foresight in agricultural surplus management
candidates.normLabel: administrative foresight in agricultural surplus management
candidates.definition: In 12:47-48: Yusuf instructs storing harvest during abundant years leaving only what is eaten preparing for seven drought years.

candidates.label: Unrecognized encounter enabling character testing
candidates.normLabel: unrecognized encounter enabling character testing
candidates.definition: In 12:58: Brothers came entered upon Yusuf he recognized them but they did not recognize him.

candidates.label: Returned silver demonstrating integrity despite power
candidates.normLabel: returned silver demonstrating integrity despite power
candidates.definition: In 12:62: Yusuf tells servants put their merchandise back in their sacks so they recognize it when returning to family.

candidates.label: Jacob's protective reluctance rooted in unresolved trauma
candidates.normLabel: jacob's protective reluctance rooted in unresolved trauma
candidates.definition: In 12:64: Shall I entrust you with him as I entrusted you with his brother before? Allah is best guardian most merciful.

candidates.label: Judah's guarantee marking moral growth from original conspirator
candidates.normLabel: judah's guarantee marking moral growth from original conspirator
candidates.definition: In 12:66: Judah says I will not send him until you give firm covenant before Allah that you will bring him back.

candidates.label: Cup-test revealing brothers' willingness to sacrifice for sibling
candidates.normLabel: cup-test revealing brothers' willingness to sacrifice for sibling
candidates.definition: In 12:70-76: Cup placed in Benjamin's sack; brothers accused of theft; they respond whoever took it should be held — offering themselves.

candidates.label: Judah's eloquent plea demonstrating complete character reformation
candidates.normLabel: judah's eloquent plea demonstrating complete character reformation
candidates.definition: In 12:78-85: Judah appeals citing father's grief previous loss of Yusuf offers himself as substitute showing transformation from original plotter.

candidates.label: Emotional disclosure as narrative climax
candidates.normLabel: emotional disclosure as narrative climax
candidates.definition: In 12:90: I am Yusuf and this is my brother — Allah has truly favored us. Identity revelation resolves dramatic tension.

candidates.label: Famine as catalyst for family reunion and dream fulfillment
candidates.normLabel: famine as catalyst for family reunion and dream fulfillment
candidates.definition: In 12:58: Famine drives brothers to Egypt where Yusuf governs — adversity becomes vehicle of divine plan.

candidates.label: Simeon detention as leverage ensuring Benjamin's return
candidates.normLabel: simeon detention as leverage ensuring benjamin's return
candidates.definition: In 12:69: Yusuf keeps one brother (Simeon) as hostage demanding younger brother as proof of honesty.

candidates.label: Unconditional forgiveness mirroring divine mercy
candidates.normLabel: unconditional forgiveness mirroring divine mercy
candidates.definition: In 12:92: No blame upon you today — may Allah forgive you and He is most merciful of the merciful.

candidates.label: Brothers' acknowledgment of Yusuf's election and their culpability
candidates.normLabel: brothers' acknowledgment of yusuf's election and their culpability
candidates.definition: In 12:91: By Allah certainly has Allah preferred you over us and we were indeed sinners.

candidates.label: Shirt-as-healing-motif connecting physical and relational restoration
candidates.normLabel: shirt-as-healing-motif connecting physical and relational restoration
candidates.definition: In 12:93-96: Go with this shirt cast it on father's face he will regain sight; shirt arrives scent detected before arrival sight restored.

candidates.label: Throne-prostration fulfilling cosmic dream completing narrative arc
candidates.normLabel: throne-prostration fulfilling cosmic dream completing narrative arc
candidates.definition: In 12:100: He raised his parents upon the throne and they fell prostrate before him; he said this is the interpretation of my vision of old.

candidates.label: Divine subtlety (lutf) recognized retrospectively across suffering
candidates.normLabel: divine subtlety (lutf) recognized retrospectively across suffering
candidates.definition: In 12:100: Indeed my Lord is Subtle (Latif) in what He wills — He is Knowing Wise. Recognition of hidden divine plan.

candidates.label: Closing dua integrating personal gratitude with universal submission
candidates.normLabel: closing dua integrating personal gratitude with universal submission
candidates.definition: In 12:101: Lord You have given me sovereignty and taught interpretation — cause me to die as Muslim join me with righteous.

candidates.label: Meta-narrative framing as Quranic confirmation of prior revelation
candidates.normLabel: meta-narrative framing as quranic confirmation of prior revelation
candidates.definition: In 12:111: This is not fabricated hadith but confirmation of what came before and detailed explanation of everything.

candidates.label: Yusuf narrative as guidance and mercy for believing community

candidates.normLabel: oath by sad and the reminder-bearing quran establishing the surah's authority
candidates.definition: In 38:1: Sad. By the Quran containing reminder.

candidates.label: Pride and dissension as the standing condition of disbelief
candidates.normLabel: pride and dissension as the standing condition of disbelief
candidates.definition: In 38:2: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

candidates.label: Outcry raised after the time of escape has already passed
candidates.normLabel: outcry raised after the time of escape has already passed
candidates.definition: In 38:3: How many a generation We destroyed before them; they called out, but it was not a time for escape.

candidates.label: Elite defence of ancestral gods against the reduction of deity to One
candidates.normLabel: elite defence of ancestral gods against the reduction of deity to one
candidates.definition: In 38:5-7: Has he made the gods one God? The eminent went forth saying continue and be patient over your gods; we have not heard of this in the latest religion; this is fabrication.

candidates.label: Catalogue of denying companies whose rejection justified the penalty
candidates.normLabel: catalogue of denying companies whose rejection justified the penalty
candidates.definition: In 38:12-14: The people of Noah denied, and Aad and Pharaoh owner of stakes, and Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket; each denied the messengers so My penalty was justified.

candidates.label: Impatient demand for punishment set against the single undelayed blast
candidates.normLabel: impatient demand for punishment set against the single undelayed blast
candidates.definition: In 38:15-16: These await not but one blast with no delay; and they say our Lord hasten for us our share before the Day of Account.

candidates.label: Patience over hostile speech paired with remembrance of the returning servant
candidates.normLabel: patience over hostile speech paired with remembrance of the returning servant
candidates.definition: In 38:17: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant David, possessor of strength; indeed he repeatedly turned back.

candidates.label: Mountains and birds joined in timed glorification with the prophet
candidates.normLabel: mountains and birds joined in timed glorification with the prophet
candidates.definition: In 38:18-19: We subjected the mountains to exalt with him in the late afternoon and after sunrise; and the birds assembled, all repeating with him.

candidates.label: Litigant intrusion testing judicial impartiality through the ewe dispute
candidates.normLabel: litigant intrusion testing judicial impartiality through the ewe dispute
candidates.definition: In 38:21-23: The adversaries climbed the wall of his prayer chamber; fear not, two adversaries, one has wronged the other, so judge with truth; this my brother has ninety-nine ewes and I have one, and he overpowered me in speech.

candidates.label: Associate oppression as the norm with the believing doers of good as the few exceptions
candidates.normLabel: associate oppression as the norm with the believing doers of good as the few exceptions
candidates.definition: In 38:24: Many associates oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and few are they; and David became certain We had tried him, sought forgiveness, fell bowing and turned.

candidates.label: Successorship on earth carrying the charge of truthful judgement and refusal of desire
candidates.normLabel: successorship on earth carrying the charge of truthful judgement and refusal of desire
candidates.definition: In 38:26: O David, We made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between people in truth and do not follow desire, as it will lead you astray; severe punishment for forgetting the Day of Account.

candidates.label: Purposeful creation asserted against the disbelievers' aimlessness assumption
candidates.normLabel: purposeful creation asserted against the disbelievers' aimlessness assumption
candidates.definition: In 38:27: We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them aimlessly; that is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to them from the Fire.

candidates.label: Blessed Book revealed for reflection and reminder to those of understanding
candidates.normLabel: blessed book revealed for reflection and reminder to those of understanding
candidates.definition: In 38:29: A blessed Book We revealed to you that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

candidates.label: Preference for good things over remembrance until sunset as a prophetic trial
candidates.normLabel: preference for good things over remembrance until sunset as a prophetic trial
candidates.definition: In 38:31-32: There were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised racehorses; and he said I gave preference to the love of good things over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain.

candidates.label: Throne-body trial followed by returning to Allah
candidates.normLabel: throne-body trial followed by returning to allah
candidates.definition: In 38:34: We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

candidates.label: Supplication for forgiveness and an unrepeatable kingdom
candidates.normLabel: supplication for forgiveness and an unrepeatable kingdom
candidates.definition: In 38:35: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me; indeed You are the Bestower.

candidates.label: Wind and jinn labour subjected with licence to grant or withhold without account
candidates.normLabel: wind and jinn labour subjected with licence to grant or withhold without account
candidates.definition: In 38:36-39: We subjected the wind blowing gently by his command wherever he directed, and the devils, every builder and diver, and others bound in shackles; this is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account.

candidates.label: Affliction voiced as Satan's touch answered by a healing spring
candidates.normLabel: affliction voiced as satan's touch answered by a healing spring
candidates.definition: In 38:41-42: Remember Our servant Job when he called to his Lord, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment; strike with your foot, this is a cool bath and drink.

candidates.label: Family restoration doubled as mercy and reminder for those of understanding
candidates.normLabel: family restoration doubled as mercy and reminder for those of understanding
candidates.definition: In 38:43: We granted him his family and a like number with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

candidates.label: Oath preserved through a concessive remedy while patience is affirmed
candidates.normLabel: oath preserved through a concessive remedy while patience is affirmed
candidates.definition: In 38:44: Take in your hand a bunch of grass and strike with it and do not break your oath; We found him patient, an excellent servant, repeatedly turning back.

candidates.label: Gardens of perpetual residence with opened doors and inexhaustible provision
candidates.normLabel: gardens of perpetual residence with opened doors and inexhaustible provision
candidates.definition: In 38:49-51: This is a reminder, and for the righteous a good return; gardens of perpetual residence whose doors are opened to them; reclining within, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

candidates.label: Glance-restricted companions of equal age within the promised reward
candidates.normLabel: glance-restricted companions of equal age within the promised reward
candidates.definition: In 38:52-53: With them women limiting their glances and of equal age; this is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

candidates.label: Transgressors' evil return with scalding water and purulence
candidates.normLabel: transgressors' evil return with scalding water and purulence
candidates.definition: In 38:55-58: For the transgressors is an evil return; Hell they will burn in, wretched is the resting place; scalding water and purulence, so let them taste it, and other punishments of its type.

candidates.label: Recrimination between followers and leaders with a plea for doubled punishment
candidates.normLabel: recrimination between followers and leaders with a plea for doubled punishment
candidates.definition: In 38:59-61: This is a company bursting in with you, no welcome for them; nor you, you brought this upon us; our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, increase for him double punishment in the Fire.

candidates.label: Search for the mocked believers and the truth of the Fire-dwellers' quarrel
candidates.normLabel: search for the mocked believers and the truth of the fire-dwellers' quarrel
candidates.definition: In 38:62-64: Why do we not see men we used to count among the worst; did we take them in ridicule or has our vision turned away; indeed that is truth, the quarrelling of the people of the Fire.

candidates.label: Warner-only self-definition paired with the confession of the One Prevailing God
candidates.normLabel: warner-only self-definition paired with the confession of the one prevailing god
candidates.definition: In 38:65-66: Say I am only a warner, and there is no deity except Allah the One the Prevailing, Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

candidates.label: Prophetic knowledge restricted to revelation, disclaiming access to the angelic assembly
candidates.normLabel: prophetic knowledge restricted to revelation, disclaiming access to the angelic assembly
candidates.definition: In 38:69-70: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly when they were disputing; it has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner.

candidates.label: Creation from clay with proportioning and in-breathing preceding the prostration command
candidates.normLabel: creation from clay with proportioning and in-breathing preceding the prostration command
candidates.definition: In 38:71-73: Your Lord said to the angels, I am going to create a human being from clay; when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My soul, fall down to him in prostration; so the angels prostrated, all of them entirely.

candidates.label: Fire-over-clay superiority claim producing expulsion and curse
candidates.normLabel: fire-over-clay superiority claim producing expulsion and curse
candidates.definition: In 38:74-78: Except Iblees, he was arrogant and became of the disbelievers; what prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My hands; I am better than him, You created me from fire and him from clay; then get out of Paradise, you are expelled; upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense.

candidates.label: Bounded reprieve and the misguidance oath answered by the divine truth-oath
candidates.normLabel: bounded reprieve and the misguidance oath answered by the divine truth-oath
candidates.definition: In 38:79-85: My Lord, reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected; you are of those reprieved until the Day of the time well-known; by Your might I will mislead them all except Your chosen servants; the truth is My oath, I will fill Hell with you and those who follow you all together.

candidates.label: Sincerity in religion as the condition of the worship command
candidates.normLabel: sincerity in religion as the condition of the worship command
candidates.definition: In 39:2-3: We sent down the Book in truth, so worship Allah being sincere to Him in religion; unquestionably for Allah is the pure religion.

candidates.label: Intermediary worship pleaded as seeking nearness, reserved for divine judgement
candidates.normLabel: intermediary worship pleaded as seeking nearness, reserved for divine judgement
candidates.definition: In 39:3: Those who take protectors besides Him say we only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position; Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ.

candidates.label: Divine sonship refuted through freedom of choice, affirming Oneness and Prevailing power
candidates.normLabel: divine sonship refuted through freedom of choice, affirming oneness and prevailing power
candidates.definition: In 39:4: If Allah had intended to take a son He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed; exalted is He, He is Allah the One the Prevailing.

candidates.label: Staged creation in the wombs within three darknesses
candidates.normLabel: staged creation in the wombs within three darknesses
candidates.definition: In 39:6: He created you from one soul then made from it its mate, and produced eight mates of grazing livestock; He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.

candidates.label: Divine independence of belief with approval of gratitude and individual burden-bearing
candidates.normLabel: divine independence of belief with approval of gratitude and individual burden-bearing
candidates.definition: In 39:7: If you disbelieve, Allah is Free from need of you, and He does not approve disbelief for His servants; if you are grateful He approves it; no bearer of burdens bears another's burden.

candidates.label: Night devotion contrasted with heedlessness and knowledge with ignorance
candidates.normLabel: night devotion contrasted with heedlessness and knowledge with ignorance
candidates.definition: In 39:9: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, like one who does not? Say, are those who know equal to those who do not know?

candidates.label: Commissioned sincerity and precedence in submission with fear of the tremendous Day
candidates.normLabel: commissioned sincerity and precedence in submission with fear of the tremendous day
candidates.definition: In 39:11-13: I have been commanded to worship Allah sincere in religion and to be the first of the Muslims; say I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.

candidates.label: Loss defined as forfeiting oneself and one's family at resurrection
candidates.normLabel: loss defined as forfeiting oneself and one's family at resurrection
candidates.definition: In 39:15: Indeed the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection; that is the manifest loss.

candidates.label: Avoidance of Taghut and return to Allah earning glad tidings
candidates.normLabel: avoidance of taghut and return to allah earning glad tidings
candidates.definition: In 39:17: Those who have avoided Taghut lest they worship it and turned back to Allah, for them are good tidings; so give good tidings to My servants.

candidates.label: Hearing speech and following its best as the criterion of guidance
candidates.normLabel: hearing speech and following its best as the criterion of guidance
candidates.definition: In 39:18: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it; those are the ones Allah has guided and those are people of understanding.

candidates.label: The agricultural cycle from rain to withered debris as reminder
candidates.normLabel: the agricultural cycle from rain to withered debris as reminder
candidates.definition: In 39:21: Allah sends down rain and makes it flow as springs in the earth, then produces crops of varying colors, then they dry and turn yellow, then He makes them scattered debris; indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.

candidates.label: The expanded breast upon divine light against hearts hardened to remembrance
candidates.normLabel: the expanded breast upon divine light against hearts hardened to remembrance
candidates.definition: In 39:22: Is one whose breast Allah has expanded to accept Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord like one whose heart rejects it? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah.

candidates.label: The best statement as a reiterated Book affecting skin and heart
candidates.normLabel: the best statement as a reiterated book affecting skin and heart
candidates.definition: In 39:23: Allah has sent down the best statement, a consistent Book wherein is reiteration; the skins shiver of those who fear their Lord, then their skins and hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah.

candidates.label: Comprehensive parables in an unambiguous Arabic Quran aimed at remembrance and taqwa
candidates.normLabel: comprehensive parables in an unambiguous arabic quran aimed at remembrance and taqwa
candidates.definition: In 39:27-28: We have presented for the people in this Quran every kind of example that they might remember; an Arabic Quran without any deviance that they might become righteous.

candidates.label: Ownership parable contrasting divided and exclusive mastership
candidates.normLabel: ownership parable contrasting divided and exclusive mastership
candidates.definition: In 39:29: Allah presents an example, a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man; are they equal in comparison?

candidates.label: Universal mortality followed by dispute before the Lord
candidates.normLabel: universal mortality followed by dispute before the lord
candidates.definition: In 39:30-31: Indeed you are to die and indeed they are to die; then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord will dispute.

candidates.label: Removal of the worst deeds and recompense according to the best
candidates.normLabel: removal of the worst deeds and recompense according to the best
candidates.definition: In 39:34-35: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord, that is the reward of the doers of good, that Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them for the best of what they used to do.

candidates.label: Divine sufficiency against threats, with exclusive reliance after the harm-and-mercy challenge
candidates.normLabel: divine sufficiency against threats, with exclusive reliance after the harm-and-mercy challenge
candidates.definition: In 39:36-38: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm, or if He intended mercy, are they withholders of His mercy? Say, sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him alone rely the reliers.

candidates.label: Guidance and straying returning to the soul with no prophetic managership
candidates.normLabel: guidance and straying returning to the soul with no prophetic managership
candidates.definition: In 39:41: We sent down the Book for the people in truth; whoever is guided, it is for the benefit of his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment; and you are not a manager over them.

candidates.label: Souls taken at death and in sleep with retention or release to a term
candidates.normLabel: souls taken at death and in sleep with retention or release to a term
candidates.definition: In 39:42: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die during their sleep; then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term.

candidates.label: Intercession reserved wholly to Allah against powerless intercessors
candidates.normLabel: intercession reserved wholly to allah against powerless intercessors
candidates.definition: In 39:43-44: Have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, even though they do not possess anything nor do they reason? Say, to Allah belongs intercession entirely.

candidates.label: Aversion at the mention of Allah alone against joy at rivals
candidates.normLabel: aversion at the mention of allah alone against joy at rivals
candidates.definition: In 39:45: When Allah is mentioned alone the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those worshipped other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

candidates.label: Prosperity misread as knowledge-based entitlement rather than trial
candidates.normLabel: prosperity misread as knowledge-based entitlement rather than trial
candidates.definition: In 39:49: When adversity touches man he calls upon Us; then when We bestow a favor he says I have only been given it because of my knowledge; rather it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

candidates.label: Prohibition of despair for self-transgressing servants because all sins are forgiven
candidates.normLabel: prohibition of despair for self-transgressing servants because all sins are forgiven
candidates.definition: In 39:53: Say, O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah; indeed Allah forgives all sins; indeed it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

candidates.label: Repentance and following the best revelation urged before sudden punishment
candidates.normLabel: repentance and following the best revelation urged before sudden punishment
candidates.definition: In 39:54-55: Return in repentance to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; and follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes suddenly while you do not perceive.

candidates.label: Threefold regret answered by the arrival of denied verses
candidates.normLabel: threefold regret answered by the arrival of denied verses
candidates.definition: In 39:56-59: Lest a soul say oh my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah; or if only Allah had guided me; or if only I had another turn; but yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant.

candidates.label: Shirk voiding all work, answered by the command to worship and be grateful
candidates.normLabel: shirk voiding all work, answered by the command to worship and be grateful
candidates.definition: In 39:65-66: It was revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate anything with Allah your work would surely become worthless; rather worship only Allah and be among the grateful.

candidates.label: Inadequate appraisal corrected by the earth in His grip and heavens folded in His right hand
candidates.normLabel: inadequate appraisal corrected by the earth in his grip and heavens folded in his right hand
candidates.definition: In 39:67: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be within His grip on the Day of Resurrection and the heavens will be folded in His right hand.

candidates.label: The double blast, illuminated earth, placed record and assembled witnesses
candidates.normLabel: the double blast, illuminated earth, placed record and assembled witnesses
candidates.definition: In 39:68-70: The Horn will be blown and all will fall dead except whom Allah wills, then blown again and they stand looking on; the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, the record placed, the prophets and witnesses brought, judged in truth without wrong; every soul fully compensated.

candidates.label: Grouped drivings to Hell and Paradise with their keepers' words
candidates.normLabel: grouped drivings to hell and paradise with their keepers' words
candidates.definition: In 39:71-75: Those who disbelieved driven to Hell in groups whose keepers ask about the messengers; those who feared their Lord driven to Paradise in groups greeted with peace and purity; and you will see the angels surrounding the Throne exalting with praise, and it will be said praise to Allah Lord of the worlds.

candidates.label: Forgiveness and acceptance of repentance joined to severity and abundance
candidates.normLabel: forgiveness and acceptance of repentance joined to severity and abundance
candidates.definition: In 40:3: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance; there is no deity except Him and to Him is the destination.

candidates.label: Freedom of movement in the land named as a deceptive appearance
candidates.normLabel: freedom of movement in the land named as a deceptive appearance
candidates.definition: In 40:4: No one disputes concerning the signs except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their uninhibited movement throughout the land.

candidates.label: Throne-bearing angels interceding for believers and their righteous kin
candidates.normLabel: throne-bearing angels interceding for believers and their righteous kin
candidates.definition: In 40:7-9: Those who carry the Throne and those around it exalt with praise, believe in Him and ask forgiveness for believers; our Lord, forgive those who repented and followed Your way, admit them to promised gardens with righteous fathers, spouses and offspring, and protect them from evil consequences, which is mercy and the great attainment.

candidates.label: Divine hatred exceeding self-hatred at the refused invitation to faith
candidates.normLabel: divine hatred exceeding self-hatred at the refused invitation to faith
candidates.definition: In 40:10: Those who disbelieve will be addressed that the hatred of Allah for them was greater than their hatred of themselves when they were invited to faith but refused.

candidates.label: Two deaths and two lives confessed with the plea for an exit refused
candidates.normLabel: two deaths and two lives confessed with the plea for an exit refused
candidates.definition: In 40:11-12: They say our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice and we confess our sins, so is there any way to an exit; that is because when Allah alone was invoked you disbelieved, and judgement is with Allah the Most High Grand.

candidates.label: The Day of Meeting with exposed sovereignty and exact recompense
candidates.normLabel: the day of meeting with exposed sovereignty and exact recompense
candidates.definition: In 40:15-17: He places inspiration to warn of the Day of Meeting, the Day they come forth with nothing concealed; to whom belongs sovereignty this Day? To Allah the One the Prevailing; this Day every soul is recompensed for what it earned, no injustice today.

candidates.label: State violence against believing sons while women are spared
candidates.normLabel: state violence against believing sons while women are spared
candidates.definition: In 40:25: When he brought them the truth they said kill the sons of those who believed with him and keep their women alive, but the plan of the disbelievers is only in error.

candidates.label: Refuge sought in the shared Lord against arrogance denying the Day of Account
candidates.normLabel: refuge sought in the shared lord against arrogance denying the day of account
candidates.definition: In 40:27: Moses said I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.

candidates.label: Concealed faith defending the messenger through evidentiary fairness
candidates.normLabel: concealed faith defending the messenger through evidentiary fairness
candidates.definition: In 40:28: A believing man of Pharaoh's family who concealed his faith said do you kill a man because he says my Lord is Allah while bringing clear proofs; if he lies his lie is upon him, and if truthful some of what he promises will strike you.

candidates.label: Present political dominance unable to shield from divine punishment
candidates.normLabel: present political dominance unable to shield from divine punishment
candidates.definition: In 40:29: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, dominant in the land, but who would protect us from the punishment of Allah if it came? Pharaoh said I show you only what I see and guide you only to right conduct.

candidates.label: Doubt persisting after Yusuf's proofs and the claim that no messenger would follow
candidates.normLabel: doubt persisting after yusuf's proofs and the claim that no messenger would follow
candidates.definition: In 40:34: Joseph had come before with clear proofs but you remained in doubt until he died, then said never will Allah send a messenger after him; thus Allah leaves astray the transgressor and skeptic.

candidates.label: Tower construction to inspect the deity, its evil made attractive and plan ruined
candidates.normLabel: tower construction to inspect the deity, its evil made attractive and plan ruined
candidates.definition: In 40:36-37: O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways into the heavens so I may look at the deity of Moses, though I think he is a liar; thus the evil of his deed was made attractive and he was averted from the way, and his plan was only in ruin.

candidates.label: Worldly enjoyment against the Hereafter as the home of settlement
candidates.normLabel: worldly enjoyment against the hereafter as the home of settlement
candidates.definition: In 40:39: O my people, this worldly life is only temporary enjoyment, and indeed the Hereafter is the home of permanent settlement.

candidates.label: Exact recompense for evil with unaccounted provision for believing men and women
candidates.normLabel: exact recompense for evil with unaccounted provision for believing men and women
candidates.definition: In 40:40: Whoever does an evil deed is recompensed only by its like, but whoever does righteousness, male or female, while a believer, enters Paradise given provision without account.

candidates.label: Mutual invitations contrasted between salvation and the Fire
candidates.normLabel: mutual invitations contrasted between salvation and the fire
candidates.definition: In 40:41-42: How is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire? You invite me to disbelieve and associate without knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

candidates.label: Invoked objects answering no supplication in either realm
candidates.normLabel: invoked objects answering no supplication in either realm
candidates.definition: In 40:43: Assuredly that to which you invite me has no response to supplication in this world or the Hereafter, and our return is to Allah, and the transgressors are companions of the Fire.

candidates.label: Entrustment of the affair to Allah answered by protection from plotted evils
candidates.normLabel: entrustment of the affair to allah answered by protection from plotted evils
candidates.definition: In 40:44-45: You will remember what I say to you and I entrust my affair to Allah, indeed Allah is Seeing of His servants; so Allah protected him from the evils they plotted and Pharaoh's people were enveloped by the worst punishment.

candidates.label: Morning-and-evening exposure to the Fire before the severest entry
candidates.normLabel: morning-and-evening exposure to the fire before the severest entry
candidates.definition: In 40:46: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening, and the Day the Hour appears it will be said make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment.

candidates.label: Support guaranteed to messengers and believers in both realms
candidates.normLabel: support guaranteed to messengers and believers in both realms
candidates.definition: In 40:51: Indeed We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand.

candidates.label: Patience joined to forgiveness-seeking and timed praise
candidates.normLabel: patience joined to forgiveness-seeking and timed praise
candidates.definition: In 40:55: So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, and ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.

candidates.label: Disputation traced to unreachable pride answered by refuge
candidates.normLabel: disputation traced to unreachable pride answered by refuge
candidates.definition: In 40:56: Those who dispute concerning the signs without authority have within their breasts only pride the extent of which they cannot reach, so seek refuge in Allah, indeed He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

candidates.label: Cosmic creation greater than human creation as a resurrection argument
candidates.normLabel: cosmic creation greater than human creation as a resurrection argument
candidates.definition: In 40:57: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.

candidates.label: Invocation answered by promise with contempt for those disdaining worship
candidates.normLabel: invocation answered by promise with contempt for those disdaining worship
candidates.definition: In 40:60: And your Lord says call upon Me, I will respond to you; indeed those who disdain My worship will enter Hell rendered contemptible.

candidates.label: Staged human creation to an appointed term inviting reasoning
candidates.normLabel: staged human creation to an appointed term inviting reasoning
candidates.definition: In 40:67: It is He who created you from dust, then a sperm-drop, then a clinging clot, then brings you out as a child, then to maturity, then to old age, and among you is he taken before that, so that you reach a specified term and perhaps use reason.

candidates.label: Dragging in shackles through boiling water into the Fire
candidates.normLabel: dragging in shackles through boiling water into the fire
candidates.definition: In 40:71-72: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains they will be dragged, in boiling water, then in the Fire they will be filled with flame.

candidates.label: Vanished associates and the admission of having invoked nothing
candidates.normLabel: vanished associates and the admission of having invoked nothing
candidates.definition: In 40:73-74: Then it will be said where is that which you used to associate other than Allah; they say they have departed from us, rather we did not used to invoke previously anything; thus Allah puts astray the disbelievers.

candidates.label: Patience held whether punishment is witnessed or death intervenes
candidates.normLabel: patience held whether punishment is witnessed or death intervenes
candidates.definition: In 40:77: So be patient, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, and whether We show you some of what We promised them or take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.

candidates.label: Signs brought only by permission with truthful conclusion at the command
candidates.normLabel: signs brought only by permission with truthful conclusion at the command
candidates.definition: In 40:78: We sent messengers before you, some related and some not; it was not for any messenger to bring a sign except by permission of Allah, so when His command comes it is concluded in truth and the falsifiers lose.

candidates.label: Livestock and ships as combined carriage with further benefits
candidates.normLabel: livestock and ships as combined carriage with further benefits
candidates.definition: In 40:79-80: It is Allah who made for you grazing animals upon which you ride and some you eat, and for you therein are other benefits and that you may realise upon them a need in your breasts, and upon them and upon ships you are carried.

candidates.label: Faith professed at the sight of punishment declared ineffective
candidates.normLabel: faith professed at the sight of punishment declared ineffective
candidates.definition: In 40:84-85: When they saw Our punishment they said we believe in Allah alone and disbelieve in what we associated; but never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment, the established way of Allah among His servants, and the disbelievers lost.

candidates.label: Detailed Arabic Quran addressed to a people who know
candidates.normLabel: detailed arabic quran addressed to a people who know
candidates.definition: In 41:3: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Quran for a people who know.

candidates.label: Claimed heart-coverings and partition answered by human likeness and revealed oneness
candidates.normLabel: claimed heart-coverings and partition answered by human likeness and revealed oneness
candidates.definition: In 41:5-6: They say our hearts are within coverings and in our ears is deafness and between us and you is a partition; say I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God, so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness.

candidates.label: Withholding zakah paired with Hereafter-disbelief as the associators' profile
candidates.normLabel: withholding zakah paired with hereafter-disbelief as the associators' profile
candidates.definition: In 41:7: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

candidates.label: Staged cosmic creation with willing compliance of heaven and earth
candidates.normLabel: staged cosmic creation with willing compliance of heaven and earth
candidates.definition: In 41:9-12: Do you disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days; He placed mountains and determined sustenance in four days; then directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said come willingly or by compulsion, they said we come willingly; and completed them as seven heavens in two days inspiring each its command.

candidates.label: Strength-boast answered by the Creator's greater strength
candidates.normLabel: strength-boast answered by the creator's greater strength
candidates.definition: In 41:15: As for Aad they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said who is greater than us in strength; did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength?

candidates.label: Preferring blindness over guidance after guidance was given
candidates.normLabel: preferring blindness over guidance after guidance was given
candidates.definition: In 41:17: And as for Thamud We guided them but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

candidates.label: Bodily faculties testifying against their owners at the Fire
candidates.normLabel: bodily faculties testifying against their owners at the fire
candidates.definition: In 41:20-21: When they reach it their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them; and they say to their skins why have you testified against us, they say we were made to speak by Allah who made everything speak.

candidates.label: Assumption of limited divine knowledge named as the cause of ruin
candidates.normLabel: assumption of limited divine knowledge named as the cause of ruin
candidates.definition: In 41:22-23: You were not covering yourselves lest your hearing or sight or skins testify against you, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do; and that was your assumption about your Lord, it has brought you to ruin.

candidates.label: Noisy disruption during recitation as an organised suppression tactic
candidates.normLabel: noisy disruption during recitation as an organised suppression tactic
candidates.definition: In 41:26: And those who disbelieve say do not listen to this Quran and speak noisily during it that perhaps you may overcome.

candidates.label: Steadfastness after declaring Allah as Lord earning angelic descent and Paradise tidings
candidates.normLabel: steadfastness after declaring allah as lord earning angelic descent and paradise tidings
candidates.definition: In 41:30-32: Indeed those who have said our Lord is Allah and then remained on a right course, the angels descend upon them saying do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise; we were your allies in worldly life and the Hereafter; as accommodation from a Forgiving and Merciful Lord.

candidates.label: Best speech defined as invitation to Allah with righteousness and declared submission
candidates.normLabel: best speech defined as invitation to allah with righteousness and declared submission
candidates.definition: In 41:33: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says indeed I am of the Muslims.

candidates.label: Repelling evil with better transforming enmity into devoted friendship
candidates.normLabel: repelling evil with better transforming enmity into devoted friendship
candidates.definition: In 41:34-35: Not equal are the good deed and the bad; repel by that which is better and thereupon the one between whom and you is enmity becomes as a devoted friend; but none is granted it except those who are patient and one having a great portion of good.

candidates.label: Prostration reserved to the Creator rather than the celestial signs
candidates.normLabel: prostration reserved to the creator rather than the celestial signs
candidates.definition: In 41:37: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon; do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon but prostrate to Allah who created them.

candidates.label: Earth revived by rain as proof of giving life to the dead
candidates.normLabel: earth revived by rain as proof of giving life to the dead
candidates.definition: In 41:39: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled but when We send down rain upon it it quivers and grows; indeed He who gave it life is the Giver of Life to the dead.

candidates.label: Mighty Book inaccessible to falsehood from before or behind
candidates.normLabel: mighty book inaccessible to falsehood from before or behind
candidates.definition: In 41:41-42: Indeed it is a mighty Book; falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it, a revelation from a Wise and Praiseworthy Lord.

candidates.label: Quran as guidance and cure for believers against deafness and blindness for others
candidates.normLabel: quran as guidance and cure for believers against deafness and blindness for others
candidates.definition: In 41:44: Say it is for those who believe a guidance and cure; and those who do not believe, in their ears is deafness and it is upon them blindness, those are being called from a distant place.

candidates.label: Hour-knowledge and hidden natural processes reserved to Allah alone
candidates.normLabel: hour-knowledge and hidden natural processes reserved to allah alone
candidates.definition: In 41:47: To Him alone is attributed knowledge of the Hour; and fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge.

candidates.label: Tireless supplication for good turned to despair when evil touches
candidates.normLabel: tireless supplication for good turned to despair when evil touches
candidates.definition: In 41:49: Man is not weary of supplication for good things, but if evil touches him he is hopeless and despairing.

candidates.label: Mercy after adversity misread as entitlement with denial of the Hour
candidates.normLabel: mercy after adversity misread as entitlement with denial of the hour
candidates.definition: In 41:50: And if We let him taste mercy after adversity he will surely say this is due to me and I do not think the Hour will occur, and even if I am returned to my Lord indeed for me there will be the best.

candidates.label: Signs in the horizons and within themselves until truth becomes clear
candidates.normLabel: signs in the horizons and within themselves until truth becomes clear
candidates.definition: In 41:53: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth; but is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is over all things a Witness?

candidates.label: One revelation-mode shared by Muhammad and the messengers before him
candidates.normLabel: one revelation-mode shared by muhammad and the messengers before him
candidates.definition: In 42:3: Thus has He revealed to you and to those before you, Allah the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

candidates.label: Angelic praise and forgiveness-seeking for earth-dwellers beneath straining heavens
candidates.normLabel: angelic praise and forgiveness-seeking for earth-dwellers beneath straining heavens
candidates.definition: In 42:5: The heavens almost break from above them and the angels exalt with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth; unquestionably it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

candidates.label: Warning addressed to the Mother of Cities and its surroundings
candidates.normLabel: warning addressed to the mother of cities and its surroundings
candidates.definition: In 42:7: Thus We revealed to you an Arabic Quran that you may warn the Mother of Cities and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly about which there is no doubt; a party in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

candidates.label: Referral of every disputed matter to divine ruling with reliance and return
candidates.normLabel: referral of every disputed matter to divine ruling with reliance and return
candidates.definition: In 42:10: And in anything over which you disagree its ruling is to be referred to Allah; that is Allah my Lord, upon Him I have relied and to Him I turn back.

candidates.label: Negation of any likeness to Him following the making of mates
candidates.normLabel: negation of any likeness to him following the making of mates
candidates.definition: In 42:11: Creator of the heavens and the earth; He made for you from yourselves mates and among the cattle mates, multiplying you thereby; there is nothing like unto Him and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

candidates.label: One religion ordained across five named prophets with the charge to establish and not divide
candidates.normLabel: one religion ordained across five named prophets with the charge to establish and not divide
candidates.definition: In 42:13: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and what We revealed to you and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus, to establish the religion and not be divided therein; difficult for the associators is that to which you invite them; Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back.

candidates.label: Division arising after knowledge out of jealous animosity
candidates.normLabel: division arising after knowledge out of jealous animosity
candidates.definition: In 42:14: They did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them, out of jealous animosity between themselves; and if not for a word that preceded from your Lord until a specified time it would have been concluded between them.

candidates.label: Commanded straight course with justice, shared lordship and separated deeds
candidates.normLabel: commanded straight course with justice, shared lordship and separated deeds
candidates.definition: In 42:15: So to that invite and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say I have believed in what Allah revealed and I have been commanded to do justice among you; Allah is our Lord and your Lord, for us our deeds and for you your deeds, there is no argument between us and you, Allah will bring us together and to Him is the destination.

candidates.label: The Book sent in truth together with the balance
candidates.normLabel: the book sent in truth together with the balance
candidates.definition: In 42:17: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and also the balance; and what will make you perceive, perhaps the Hour is near.

candidates.label: Two harvests contrasted with increase reserved for the Hereafter-seeker
candidates.normLabel: two harvests contrasted with increase reserved for the hereafter-seeker
candidates.definition: In 42:20: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter, We increase for him in his harvest; and whoever desires the harvest of this world, We give him thereof but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

candidates.label: Repentance accepted and misdeeds pardoned with answered supplication and added bounty
candidates.normLabel: repentance accepted and misdeeds pardoned with answered supplication and added bounty
candidates.definition: In 42:25-26: It is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds and knows what you do; and He answers those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases for them from His bounty.

candidates.label: Provision measured because excess would produce tyranny across the earth
candidates.normLabel: provision measured because excess would produce tyranny across the earth
candidates.definition: In 42:27: And if Allah had extended provision excessively for His servants they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth, but He sends it down in an amount which He wills; indeed He is of His servants Acquainted and Seeing.

candidates.label: Rain arriving after despair as the spreading of mercy
candidates.normLabel: rain arriving after despair as the spreading of mercy
candidates.definition: In 42:28: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy, and He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

candidates.label: Disaster traced to earned deeds while much is pardoned
candidates.normLabel: disaster traced to earned deeds while much is pardoned
candidates.definition: In 42:30: And whatever strikes you of disaster, it is for what your hands have earned, but He pardons much.

candidates.label: Mountain-like ships and stillable wind as signs for the patient and grateful
candidates.normLabel: mountain-like ships and stillable wind as signs for the patient and grateful
candidates.definition: In 42:32-33: And of His signs are the ships in the sea like mountains; if He willed He could still the wind and they would remain motionless on its surface; indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

candidates.label: Lasting divine portion set against temporary worldly enjoyment
candidates.normLabel: lasting divine portion set against temporary worldly enjoyment
candidates.definition: In 42:36: So whatever thing you have been given, it is but enjoyment of the worldly life, but what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely.

candidates.label: Consultation as the community's decision method alongside prayer and spending
candidates.normLabel: consultation as the community's decision method alongside prayer and spending
candidates.definition: In 42:38: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is determined by consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them they spend.

candidates.label: Proportionate retribution permitted while pardon and reconciliation carry divine reward
candidates.normLabel: proportionate retribution permitted while pardon and reconciliation carry divine reward
candidates.definition: In 42:40: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation, his reward is due from Allah; indeed He does not like wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Blame confined to those who wrong people and tyrannise without right
candidates.normLabel: blame confined to those who wrong people and tyrannise without right
candidates.definition: In 42:41-42: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged, those have not upon them any cause for blame; the cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannise upon the earth without right.

candidates.label: Three exclusive modes of divine address to a human being
candidates.normLabel: three exclusive modes of divine address to a human being
candidates.definition: In 42:51: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal by His permission what He wills; indeed He is Most High and Wise.

candidates.label: Arabic Quran grounded in the Mother of the Book as exalted and wise
candidates.normLabel: arabic quran grounded in the mother of the book as exalted and wise
candidates.definition: In 43:2-4: By the clear Book; indeed We made it an Arabic Quran that you might understand; and indeed it is in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

candidates.label: Universal ridicule of every prophet sent to former peoples
candidates.normLabel: universal ridicule of every prophet sent to former peoples
candidates.definition: In 43:6-7: How many a prophet We sent among the former peoples, but there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

candidates.label: Creator-question conceded while daughter-attribution persists
candidates.normLabel: creator-question conceded while daughter-attribution persists
candidates.definition: In 43:9-16: If you ask who created heavens and earth they say the Mighty Knowing; yet they attribute to Him from His servants a portion; indeed man is clearly ungrateful; or has He taken daughters from what He created and chosen you for sons?

candidates.label: Mounts prompting glorification of the Subduer and acknowledgment of return
candidates.normLabel: mounts prompting glorification of the subduer and acknowledgment of return
candidates.definition: In 43:12-14: Who created the species and made ships and animals you mount, that you may settle on their backs and remember the favour of your Lord when settled and say exalted is He who subjected this to us and we could not have subdued it, and indeed to our Lord we will return.

candidates.label: Angels named female without witnessed creation, testimony deferred
candidates.normLabel: angels named female without witnessed creation, testimony deferred
candidates.definition: In 43:19: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females; did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.

candidates.label: Ancestral religion invoked to reject better guidance from every warner
candidates.normLabel: ancestral religion invoked to reject better guidance from every warner
candidates.definition: In 43:22-24: Rather they say we found our fathers upon a religion and we follow their footsteps; similarly We sent no warner to a city except its affluent said we found our fathers upon a religion; even if I brought you better guidance? They said we disbelieve in what you were sent with.

candidates.label: Ibrahim's lasting word among descendants for their return
candidates.normLabel: ibrahim's lasting word among descendants for their return
candidates.definition: In 43:26-28: Ibrahim said I am disassociated from what you worship except He who created me; and he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return.

candidates.label: Demand for revelation to descend upon a socially prominent figure
candidates.normLabel: demand for revelation to descend upon a socially prominent figure
candidates.definition: In 43:31: And they said why was this Quran not sent down upon a great man from one of the two cities?

candidates.label: Differentiated livelihoods enabling mutual service, mercy exceeding accumulation
candidates.normLabel: differentiated livelihoods enabling mutual service, mercy exceeding accumulation
candidates.definition: In 43:32: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who apportioned their livelihood and raised some above others in degrees that they may use one another for service; but the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

candidates.label: Material wealth withheld to prevent unified disbelief
candidates.normLabel: material wealth withheld to prevent unified disbelief
candidates.definition: In 43:33-35: If it were not that people would become one community of disbelievers We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Rahman ceilings and stairways of silver, doors and couches of silver, and gold ornament; but all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life, and the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

candidates.label: Blindness to the Rahman's remembrance earning a devil-companion
candidates.normLabel: blindness to the rahman's remembrance earning a devil-companion
candidates.definition: In 43:36-37: Whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful, We appoint for him a devil and he is to him a companion; and indeed the devils avert them from the way while they think they are rightly guided.

candidates.label: East-west regret toward the companion upon meeting the Lord
candidates.normLabel: east-west regret toward the companion upon meeting the lord
candidates.definition: In 43:38-39: Until when he comes to Us he says oh I wish there was between me and you the distance between east and west, how wretched a companion; and never will it benefit you that Day when you have wronged that you are sharing in the punishment.

candidates.label: Each sign greater than its sister with affliction applied for return
candidates.normLabel: each sign greater than its sister with affliction applied for return
candidates.definition: In 43:48: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return to faith.

candidates.label: Promise of guidance given then immediately broken upon relief
candidates.normLabel: promise of guidance given then immediately broken upon relief
candidates.definition: In 43:49-50: They said O magician invoke for us your Lord by what He promised you, indeed we will be guided; but when We removed the affliction from them, at once they broke their word.

candidates.label: Pharaoh's boast of kingdom and rivers dismissing Musa as insignificant
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh's boast of kingdom and rivers dismissing musa as insignificant
candidates.definition: In 43:51-52: Pharaoh called out among his people saying does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me and these rivers flowing beneath me, do you not see? Or am I not better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

candidates.label: Gold bracelets and angelic escort demanded as prophetic credentials
candidates.normLabel: gold bracelets and angelic escort demanded as prophetic credentials
candidates.definition: In 43:53: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?

candidates.label: People bluffed into obedience while already defiantly disobedient
candidates.normLabel: people bluffed into obedience while already defiantly disobedient
candidates.definition: In 43:54: So he bluffed his people and they obeyed him; indeed they were themselves a people defiantly disobedient of Allah.

candidates.label: Isa as servant granted favour and example, not object of dispute
candidates.normLabel: isa as servant granted favour and example, not object of dispute
candidates.definition: In 43:57-59: When the son of Mary was presented as an example your people laughed aloud and said are your gods better or is he? They presented the comparison only for argument, they are a people prone to dispute; Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favour and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

candidates.label: Paradise inherited through deeds with gold vessels and fulfilled desires
candidates.normLabel: paradise inherited through deeds with gold vessels and fulfilled desires
candidates.definition: In 43:71-73: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold, and therein is whatever the souls desire and what delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally; and that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do; for you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.

candidates.label: Plea to Malik for termination refused with the command to remain
candidates.normLabel: plea to malik for termination refused with the command to remain
candidates.definition: In 43:77: And they will call O Malik let your Lord put an end to us; he will say indeed you will remain.

candidates.label: Secrets and private conversations heard and recorded despite assumptions
candidates.normLabel: secrets and private conversations heard and recorded despite assumptions
candidates.definition: In 43:80: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, and Our messengers are with them recording.

candidates.label: Hypothetical sonship negated by transcendence above description
candidates.normLabel: hypothetical sonship negated by transcendence above description
candidates.definition: In 43:81-82: Say if the Most Merciful had a son then I would be the first of his worshippers; exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

candidates.label: Intercession denied to invoked rivals, restricted to truthful witnesses
candidates.normLabel: intercession denied to invoked rivals, restricted to truthful witnesses
candidates.definition: In 43:86: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess power of intercession; but only those who testify to the truth can benefit, and they know.

candidates.label: Turn aside with peace while they will come to know
candidates.normLabel: turn aside with peace while they will come to know
candidates.definition: In 43:89: So turn aside from them and say Peace; but they are going to know.

candidates.label: Blessed-night descent of the clear Book as warning and mercy
candidates.normLabel: blessed-night descent of the clear book as warning and mercy
candidates.definition: In 44:2-6: By the clear Book; indeed We sent it down during a blessed night, indeed We were to warn; on that night every precise matter is made distinct as a command from Us as mercy from your Lord, the Hearing, the Knowing.

candidates.label: Visible smoke covering people as a painful torment
candidates.normLabel: visible smoke covering people as a painful torment
candidates.definition: In 44:10-11: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke covering the people; this is a painful torment.

candidates.label: Belated plea for torment removal after dismissing the clear Messenger
candidates.normLabel: belated plea for torment removal after dismissing the clear messenger
candidates.definition: In 44:12-14: Our Lord remove from us the torment, indeed we are believers; how will there be for them a reminder when a clear Messenger had come to them, then they turned away and said taught and mad.

candidates.label: Greatest-assault Day as the occasion of retribution
candidates.normLabel: greatest-assault day as the occasion of retribution
candidates.definition: In 44:16: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed We will take retribution.

candidates.label: Noble messenger demanding release of Allah's servants with clear authority
candidates.normLabel: noble messenger demanding release of allah's servants with clear authority
candidates.definition: In 44:18-19: Render to me the servants of Allah, indeed I am to you a trustworthy messenger; be not haughty with Allah, indeed I have come to you with clear authority.

candidates.label: Night departure with pursuit and sea left in stillness for drowning
candidates.normLabel: night departure with pursuit and sea left in stillness for drowning
candidates.definition: In 44:23-24: Then set out with My servants by night, indeed you are to be pursued; and leave the sea in stillness, indeed they are an army to be drowned.

candidates.label: Abandoned wealth and comfort inherited by another people without cosmic mourning
candidates.normLabel: abandoned wealth and comfort inherited by another people without cosmic mourning
candidates.definition: In 44:25-29: How much they left behind of gardens and springs and crops and noble sites and comfort wherein they were amused; thus We caused another people to inherit it; and the heaven and earth wept not for them nor were they reprieved.

candidates.label: Israel chosen by knowledge above the worlds with signs of clear trial
candidates.normLabel: israel chosen by knowledge above the worlds with signs of clear trial
candidates.definition: In 44:32-33: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over all the worlds; and We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

candidates.label: Denial of resurrection challenged to produce forefathers
candidates.normLabel: denial of resurrection challenged to produce forefathers
candidates.definition: In 44:34-36: Indeed these are saying there is not but our first death and we will not be resurrected; then bring our forefathers if you should be truthful.

candidates.label: Creation affirmed as purposeful truth against the assumption of play
candidates.normLabel: creation affirmed as purposeful truth against the assumption of play
candidates.definition: In 44:38-39: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play; We did not create them except in truth but most of them do not know.

candidates.label: Kinship useless on Judgement Day with mercy as sole exception
candidates.normLabel: kinship useless on judgement day with mercy as sole exception
candidates.definition: In 44:41-42: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all nor will they be helped; except those on whom Allah has mercy, indeed He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

candidates.label: Zaqqum as sinner's food boiling like murky oil
candidates.normLabel: zaqqum as sinner's food boiling like murky oil
candidates.definition: In 44:43-46: Indeed the tree of Zaqqum is food for the sinful; like murky oil it boils within bellies like the boiling of scalding water.

candidates.label: Righteous in security with silk, brocade, fair spouses and every fruit
candidates.normLabel: righteous in security with silk, brocade, fair spouses and every fruit
candidates.definition: In 44:51-55: Indeed the righteous will be in a secure place within gardens and springs wearing fine silk and brocade facing each other; thus We will marry them to fair women with large beautiful eyes; they will call therein for every fruit safe and secure.

candidates.label: Protection from second death and Hellfire as bounty and great attainment
candidates.normLabel: protection from second death and hellfire as bounty and great attainment
