candidates.definition: In 44:56-57: They will not taste death therein except the first death and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire as bounty from your Lord; that is the great attainment.

candidates.label: Quran eased on the Prophet's tongue for remembrance amid mutual watching
candidates.normLabel: quran eased on the prophet's tongue for remembrance amid mutual watching
candidates.definition: In 44:58-59: And indeed We have eased the Quran in your tongue that they might be reminded; so watch O Muhammad, indeed they are watching.

candidates.label: Five categories of signs addressed to believers, the certain and those who reason
candidates.normLabel: five categories of signs addressed to believers, the certain and those who reason
candidates.definition: In 45:3-5: Indeed within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers; and in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain; and in the alternation of night and day and what Allah sends down from the sky of provision giving life to the earth and directing the winds are signs for a people who reason.

candidates.label: Challenge of what post-divine statement they would believe
candidates.normLabel: challenge of what post-divine statement they would believe
candidates.definition: In 45:6: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth; then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?

candidates.label: Arrogant persistence and ridicule upon hearing divine verses
candidates.normLabel: arrogant persistence and ridicule upon hearing divine verses
candidates.definition: In 45:8-9: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them; and when he knows anything of Our verses he takes them in ridicule; those will have a humiliating punishment.

candidates.label: Earnings and allies failing to avail against Hell
candidates.normLabel: earnings and allies failing to avail against hell
candidates.definition: In 45:10: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies, and they will have a great punishment.

candidates.label: Believers commanded to forgive those expecting no divine days
candidates.normLabel: believers commanded to forgive those expecting no divine days
candidates.definition: In 45:14: Say to those who have believed that they should forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.

candidates.label: Individual deeds returning upon the doer before the Lord
candidates.normLabel: individual deeds returning upon the doer before the lord
candidates.definition: In 45:15: Whoever does a good deed it is for himself and whoever does evil it is against the self; then to your Lord you will be returned.

candidates.label: Israel's endowment and division through jealous animosity after knowledge
candidates.normLabel: israel's endowment and division through jealous animosity after knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:16-17: We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood and provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds, and gave them clear proofs; and they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them out of jealous animosity between themselves.

candidates.label: Ordained way commanded against ignorant inclinations
candidates.normLabel: ordained way commanded against ignorant inclinations
candidates.definition: In 45:18: Then We put you on an ordained way concerning the matter; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

candidates.label: Quran as enlightenment, guidance and mercy for the certain
candidates.normLabel: quran as enlightenment, guidance and mercy for the certain
candidates.definition: In 45:20: This is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain in faith.

candidates.label: Evildoers' equality assumption condemned as evil judgement
candidates.normLabel: evildoers' equality assumption condemned as evil judgement
candidates.definition: In 45:21: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds, equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.

candidates.label: Desire taken as deity producing sealed faculties by divine knowledge
candidates.normLabel: desire taken as deity producing sealed faculties by divine knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:23: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his own desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil?

candidates.label: Materialist worldview exposed as assumption without knowledge
candidates.normLabel: materialist worldview exposed as assumption without knowledge
candidates.definition: In 45:24: And they say there is not but our worldly life, we die and live and nothing destroys us except time; and they have of that no knowledge, they are only assuming.

candidates.label: Forefather-production demand answered by divine life-death-resurrection control
candidates.normLabel: forefather-production demand answered by divine life-death-resurrection control
candidates.definition: In 45:25-26: When Our verses are recited as clear evidences their argument is only bring back our forefathers if you are truthful; say Allah causes you to live then causes you to die then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt.

candidates.label: Every nation kneeling before its transcribed record
candidates.normLabel: every nation kneeling before its transcribed record
candidates.definition: In 45:28-29: You will see every nation kneeling; every nation will be called to its record, today you will be recompensed for what you used to do; this Our record speaks about you in truth, indeed We were having transcribed whatever you used to do.

candidates.label: Reciprocal forgetting: abandoning the meeting earns abandonment to Fire
candidates.normLabel: reciprocal forgetting: abandoning the meeting earns abandonment to fire
candidates.definition: In 45:34-35: It will be said today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire and for you there are no helpers; that is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule and worldly life deluded you, so that Day they will not be removed nor asked to appease.

candidates.label: Closing praise and grandeur belonging exclusively to Allah
candidates.normLabel: closing praise and grandeur belonging exclusively to allah
candidates.definition: In 45:36-37: Then to Allah belongs all praise, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds; and to Him belongs all grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

candidates.label: Purposeful creation for a specified term while the warned turn away
candidates.normLabel: purposeful creation for a specified term while the warned turn away
candidates.definition: In 46:3: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term; but those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

candidates.label: Challenge to produce rival creation or prior scripture as evidence
candidates.normLabel: challenge to produce rival creation or prior scripture as evidence
candidates.definition: In 46:4: Say have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth or did they have partnership in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this or a remaining trace of knowledge if you should be truthful.

candidates.label: Invoked entities unaware of worship becoming enemies at the gathering
candidates.normLabel: invoked entities unaware of worship becoming enemies at the gathering
candidates.definition: In 46:5-6: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection and they of their invocation are unaware; and when the people are gathered they will be enemies to them and deniers of their worship.

candidates.label: Israelite witness confirming the Quran while disbelievers remain arrogant
candidates.normLabel: israelite witness confirming the quran while disbelievers remain arrogant
candidates.definition: In 46:10: Say have you considered if the Quran was from Allah and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant? Indeed Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

candidates.label: Musa's Scripture as guidance and mercy confirmed by this Arabic Book
candidates.normLabel: musa's scripture as guidance and mercy confirmed by this arabic book
candidates.definition: In 46:12: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy; and this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

candidates.label: Steadfastness after declaring Allah as Lord removing fear and grief
candidates.normLabel: steadfastness after declaring allah as lord removing fear and grief
candidates.definition: In 46:13-14: Indeed those who have said our Lord is Allah and then remained on a right course, there will be no fear concerning them nor will they grieve; those are the companions of Paradise abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

candidates.label: Parental good-treatment enjoined with biological timeline and maturity supplication
candidates.normLabel: parental good-treatment enjoined with biological timeline and maturity supplication
candidates.definition: In 46:15: And We have enjoined upon man to his parents good treatment; his mother carried him with hardship and gave birth with hardship, and his gestation and weaning is thirty months; until when he reaches maturity and forty years he says my Lord enable me to be grateful for Your favour upon me and my parents and to work righteousness You approve and make righteous my offspring; indeed I have repented and am of the Muslims.

candidates.label: Contemptuous rejection of resurrection by a child against pleading parents
candidates.normLabel: contemptuous rejection of resurrection by a child against pleading parents
candidates.definition: In 46:17: But one who says to his parents uff to you, do you promise me I will be brought forth when generations before me have passed on, while they call to Allah for help and say woe to you believe, indeed the promise of Allah is truth; but he says this is not but legends of the former people.

candidates.label: Word taking effect among prior nations of jinn and men as losers
candidates.normLabel: word taking effect among prior nations of jinn and men as losers
candidates.definition: In 46:18: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men; indeed they all were losers.

candidates.label: Pleasure exhaustion in worldly life answered by humiliating punishment
candidates.normLabel: pleasure exhaustion in worldly life answered by humiliating punishment
candidates.definition: In 46:20: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire it will be said you exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of extreme humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and defiantly disobedient.

candidates.label: Brother of Aad warning in al-Ahqaf amid prior and subsequent warners
candidates.normLabel: brother of aad warning in al-ahqaf amid prior and subsequent warners
candidates.definition: In 46:21-23: And mention the brother of Aad when he warned his people in al-Ahqaf, and warners had passed before him and after him, saying do not worship except Allah, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day; they said have you come to delude us from our gods, bring what you promise if truthful; he said knowledge is only with Allah and I convey what I was sent with but I see you behaving ignorantly.

candidates.label: Approaching cloud mistaken for rain revealed as destructive wind
candidates.normLabel: approaching cloud mistaken for rain revealed as destructive wind
candidates.definition: In 46:24-25: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys they said this is a cloud bringing us rain; rather it is that for which you were impatient, a wind within it a painful punishment, destroying everything by command of its Lord; and they became so that nothing was seen except their dwellings; thus do We recompense the criminal people.

candidates.label: Faculties availing nothing when signs are persistently rejected
candidates.normLabel: faculties availing nothing when signs are persistently rejected
candidates.definition: In 46:26: And We had established them in such as We have not established you and made for them hearing and vision and hearts, but their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything when they were rejecting the signs of Allah, and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

candidates.label: Jinn directed to listen to the Quran and returning as warners
candidates.normLabel: jinn directed to listen to the quran and returning as warners
candidates.definition: In 46:29-31: And when We directed to you a few of the jinn listening to the Quran, when they attended it they said listen quietly, and when concluded they went back to their people as warners; they said O our people we have heard a Book revealed after Musa confirming what was before it guiding to truth and a straight path; O our people respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him, He will forgive your sins and protect you from painful punishment.

candidates.label: Cosmic creation proving ability to revive the dead
candidates.normLabel: cosmic creation proving ability to revive the dead
candidates.definition: In 46:33: Do they not see that Allah who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation is able to give life to the dead? Yes indeed He is over all things competent.

candidates.label: Patience modelled on determined messengers with the Day compressing time
candidates.normLabel: patience modelled on determined messengers with the day compressing time
candidates.definition: In 46:35: So be patient as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them; it will be on the Day they see what they are promised as though they had not remained except an hour of a day; this is notification, and will any be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

candidates.label: Misdeeds removed and condition amended for believers in Muhammad's revelation
candidates.normLabel: misdeeds removed and condition amended for believers in muhammad's revelation
candidates.definition: In 47:2: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad, and it is the truth from their Lord, He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

candidates.label: Combat instructions with favour-or-ransom until war ends
candidates.normLabel: combat instructions with favour-or-ransom until war ends
candidates.definition: In 47:4: So when you meet those who disbelieve in battle strike their necks until when you have inflicted slaughter upon them then secure their bonds and either confer favour afterwards or ransom them until the war lays down its burdens.

candidates.label: Divine testing through mutual conflict as alternative to direct vengeance
candidates.normLabel: divine testing through mutual conflict as alternative to direct vengeance
candidates.definition: In 47:4: And if Allah had willed He could have taken vengeance upon them Himself but He ordered armed struggle to test some of you by means of others; and those killed in the cause of Allah, never will He waste their deeds.

candidates.label: Believers supporting Allah receiving support and firm footing
candidates.normLabel: believers supporting allah receiving support and firm footing
candidates.definition: In 47:7: O you who have believed, if you support Allah He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

candidates.label: Travel showing destroyed predecessors with comparable fate for disbelievers
candidates.normLabel: travel showing destroyed predecessors with comparable fate for disbelievers
candidates.definition: In 47:10: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed everything over them and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

candidates.label: Paradise with four unchanging rivers against intestine-severing Fire
candidates.normLabel: paradise with four unchanging rivers against intestine-severing fire
candidates.definition: In 47:15: Is the description of Paradise which the righteous are promised wherein are rivers of water unaltered, milk unchanged, wine delicious and purified honey with all fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like those abiding eternally in Fire given scalding water severing intestines?

candidates.label: Sealed hearts following desires exposed through post-departure questioning
candidates.normLabel: sealed hearts following desires exposed through post-departure questioning
candidates.definition: In 47:16: And among them are those who listen to you until when they depart from you they say to those given knowledge what has he said just now; those are the ones Allah has sealed over their hearts and who follow their desires.

candidates.label: Guidance increased and righteousness granted to the guided
candidates.normLabel: guidance increased and righteousness granted to the guided
candidates.definition: In 47:17: And those who are guided, He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

candidates.label: Tawheed knowledge and istighfar commanded under divine awareness
candidates.normLabel: tawheed knowledge and istighfar commanded under divine awareness
candidates.definition: In 47:19: So know O Muhammad that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for believing men and women; and Allah knows of your movement and resting place.

candidates.label: Hypocrites death-stricken at fighting mention despite requesting a surah
candidates.normLabel: hypocrites death-stricken at fighting mention despite requesting a surah
candidates.definition: In 47:20-21: Those who believe say why has a surah not been sent down; but when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death; more appropriate for them would have been obedience and good words.

candidates.label: Turning away producing corruption and severed kinship earning divine curse
candidates.normLabel: turning away producing corruption and severed kinship earning divine curse
candidates.definition: In 47:22-23: So would you perhaps if you turned away cause corruption on earth and sever your ties of relationship; those are the ones Allah has cursed so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

candidates.label: Heart-locks preventing Quran reflection
candidates.normLabel: heart-locks preventing quran reflection
candidates.definition: In 47:24: Then do they not reflect upon the Quran or are there locks upon their hearts?

candidates.label: Satan enticing reverters with prolonged hope after clarity
candidates.normLabel: satan enticing reverters with prolonged hope after clarity
candidates.definition: In 47:25: Indeed those who reverted back after guidance had become clear to them, Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

candidates.label: Obedience to Allah and Messenger commanded without deed invalidation
candidates.normLabel: obedience to allah and messenger commanded without deed invalidation
candidates.definition: In 47:33: O you who have believed obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

candidates.label: Withholding spending as self-harm against Allah's freedom from need
candidates.normLabel: withholding spending as self-harm against allah's freedom from need
candidates.definition: In 47:38: Here you are invited to spend in the cause of Allah but among you are those who withhold out of greed; whoever withholds only withholds from himself; Allah is Free of need while you are needy; if you turn away He will replace you with another people unlike you.

candidates.label: Clear conquest granted with forgiveness, favour completion and guidance
candidates.normLabel: clear conquest granted with forgiveness, favour completion and guidance
candidates.definition: In 48:1-2: Indeed We have given you a clear conquest that Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favour upon you and guide you to a straight path.

candidates.label: Tranquillity increasing faith alongside existing faith
candidates.normLabel: tranquillity increasing faith alongside existing faith
candidates.definition: In 48:4: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their present faith; and to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth.

candidates.label: Evil assumption about Allah earning anger, curse and Hell
candidates.normLabel: evil assumption about allah earning anger, curse and hell
candidates.definition: In 48:6: And that He may punish the hypocrite men and women and polytheist men and women who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature; upon them is misfortune of evil nature and Allah has become angry with them and cursed them and prepared Hell.

candidates.label: Pledge to the Prophet identified as pledge to Allah with His hand over theirs
candidates.normLabel: pledge to the prophet identified as pledge to allah with his hand over theirs
candidates.definition: In 48:10: Indeed those who pledge allegiance to you are actually pledging allegiance to Allah; the hand of Allah is over their hands; so he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself, and he who fulfills what he promised Allah, He will give him a great reward.

candidates.label: Bedouin excuses masking inner disbelief exposed by divine acquaintance
candidates.normLabel: bedouin excuses masking inner disbelief exposed by divine acquaintance
candidates.definition: In 48:11-12: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say our properties and families occupied us so ask forgiveness for us; they say with their tongues what is not within their hearts; but you thought the Messenger and believers would never return and assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined.

candidates.label: Battle exemptions for the blind, lame and ill with obedience-reward framework
candidates.normLabel: battle exemptions for the blind, lame and ill with obedience-reward framework
candidates.definition: In 48:17: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt for remaining behind; and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow.

candidates.label: Allah's pleasure with the pledge under the tree confirmed by heart-knowledge
candidates.normLabel: allah's pleasure with the pledge under the tree confirmed by heart-knowledge
candidates.definition: In 48:18: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree and He knew what was in their hearts so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest.

candidates.label: Unchanging established way of Allah across history
candidates.normLabel: unchanging established way of allah across history
candidates.definition: In 48:23: This is the established way of Allah which has occurred before; and never will you find in the way of Allah any change.

candidates.label: Restraint at Makkah protecting unknown believers from trampling-dishonour
candidates.normLabel: restraint at makkah protecting unknown believers from trampling-dishonour
candidates.definition: In 48:25: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice; and if not for believing men and women whom you did not know that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without knowledge, you would have been permitted to enter.

candidates.label: Jahiliyya chauvinism against tranquillity and the word of righteousness
candidates.normLabel: jahiliyya chauvinism against tranquillity and the word of righteousness
candidates.definition: In 48:26: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism, the chauvinism of the time of ignorance; but Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it.

candidates.label: Vision of safe Masjid entry confirmed with near conquest arranged
candidates.normLabel: vision of safe masjid entry confirmed with near conquest arranged
candidates.definition: In 48:27: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth; you will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram if Allah wills in safety with your heads shaved and hair shortened not fearing anyone; He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near at hand.

candidates.label: Religion of truth sent to prevail over all religions with Allah as Witness
candidates.normLabel: religion of truth sent to prevail over all religions with allah as witness
candidates.definition: In 48:28: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion; and sufficient is Allah as Witness.

candidates.label: Companions described in Torah and Gospel as strengthening plant delighting sowers
candidates.normLabel: companions described in torah and gospel as strengthening plant delighting sowers
candidates.definition: In 48:29: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers merciful among themselves; you see them bowing and prostrating seeking bounty from Allah and His pleasure; their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration; that is their description in the Torah and their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks delighting the sowers so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers; Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

candidates.label: Prohibition against preceding Allah and His Messenger with fear commanded
candidates.normLabel: prohibition against preceding allah and his messenger with fear commanded
candidates.definition: In 49:1: O you who have believed do not put yourselves before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah; indeed Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

candidates.label: Voice-lowering before the Prophet as heart-testing for righteousness
candidates.normLabel: voice-lowering before the prophet as heart-testing for righteousness
candidates.definition: In 49:2-3: Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not; indeed those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness.

candidates.label: Fasiq information requiring investigation to prevent ignorant harm
candidates.normLabel: fasiq information requiring investigation to prevent ignorant harm
candidates.definition: In 49:6: O you who have believed if there comes to you a disobedient one with information investigate lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become over what you have done regretful.

candidates.label: Faith endeared and disbelief rendered hateful as divine bounty
candidates.normLabel: faith endeared and disbelief rendered hateful as divine bounty
candidates.definition: In 49:7-8: But Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief defiance and disobedience; those are the guided as bounty from Allah and favour.

candidates.label: Inter-believer conflict resolution with just settlement and oppressor-fighting
candidates.normLabel: inter-believer conflict resolution with just settlement and oppressor-fighting
candidates.definition: In 49:9: And if two factions among the believers should fight then make settlement between the two; but if one oppresses the other then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah; and if it returns then make settlement between them in justice and act justly.

candidates.label: Believers declared brothers requiring mutual settlement and taqwa
candidates.normLabel: believers declared brothers requiring mutual settlement and taqwa
candidates.definition: In 49:10: The believers are but brothers so make settlement between your brothers and fear Allah that you may receive mercy.

candidates.label: Ridicule, insult and offensive nicknames prohibited among believers
candidates.normLabel: ridicule, insult and offensive nicknames prohibited among believers
candidates.definition: In 49:11: O you who have believed let not a people ridicule another people perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule other women; do not insult one another and do not call each other by offensive nicknames; wretched is the name of disobedience after faith.

candidates.label: Negative assumption, spying and backbiting prohibited with dead-flesh analogy
candidates.normLabel: negative assumption, spying and backbiting prohibited with dead-flesh analogy
candidates.definition: In 49:12: O you who have believed avoid much negative assumption indeed some assumption is sin; and do not spy or backbite each other; would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it.

candidates.label: Peoples and tribes created for mutual recognition with nobility by righteousness
candidates.normLabel: peoples and tribes created for mutual recognition with nobility by righteousness
candidates.definition: In 49:13: O mankind indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another; indeed the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.

candidates.label: Bedouin iman corrected to submission since faith has not entered hearts
candidates.normLabel: bedouin iman corrected to submission since faith has not entered hearts
candidates.definition: In 49:14: The bedouins say we have believed; say you have not yet believed but say instead we have submitted for faith has not yet entered your hearts; and if you obey Allah and His Messenger He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything.

candidates.label: True believers defined by absence of doubt and striving with wealth and life
candidates.normLabel: true believers defined by absence of doubt and striving with wealth and life
candidates.definition: In 49:15: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah; it is those who are the truthful.

candidates.label: Islam as Allah's favour of guidance not a human favour to the Prophet
candidates.normLabel: islam as allah's favour of guidance not a human favour to the prophet
candidates.definition: In 49:17: They consider it a favour to you that they have accepted Islam; say do not consider your Islam a favour to me; rather Allah has conferred favour upon you that He has guided you to the faith if you should be truthful.

candidates.label: Oath by the honoured Quran framing the surah
candidates.normLabel: oath by the honoured quran framing the surah
candidates.definition: In 50:1: Qaf; by the honoured Quran.

candidates.label: Resurrection denied as distant despite divine retaining record
candidates.normLabel: resurrection denied as distant despite divine retaining record
candidates.definition: In 50:3-4: When we have died and have become dust we will return to life? That is a distant return; We know what the earth diminishes of them and with Us is a retaining record.

candidates.label: Cosmic signs of structured heaven and productive earth as insight and reminder
candidates.normLabel: cosmic signs of structured heaven and productive earth as insight and reminder
candidates.definition: In 50:6-8: Have they not looked at the heaven above them how We structured it and adorned it and it has no rifts; and the earth We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein of every beautiful kind giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns.

candidates.label: Blessed rain reviving dead land as resurrection parallel
candidates.normLabel: blessed rain reviving dead land as resurrection parallel
candidates.definition: In 50:9-11: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest and lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers as provision for the servants and We have given life thereby to a dead land; thus is the resurrection.

candidates.label: Nine prior communities named as deniers with justly fulfilled threat
candidates.normLabel: nine prior communities named as deniers with justly fulfilled threat
candidates.definition: In 50:12-14: The people of Noah denied before them and the companions of the well and Thamud and Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot and the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'; all denied the messengers so My threat was justly fulfilled.

candidates.label: Divine proximity closer than the jugular vein with soul-whispering known
candidates.normLabel: divine proximity closer than the jugular vein with soul-whispering known
candidates.definition: In 50:16: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

candidates.label: Dual recording angels capturing every uttered word
candidates.normLabel: dual recording angels capturing every uttered word
candidates.definition: In 50:17-18: When the two receivers receive seated on the right and on the left; man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared.

candidates.label: Cover removed and sight sharpened on the Day of threat
candidates.normLabel: cover removed and sight sharpened on the day of threat
candidates.definition: In 50:22: You were certainly in unmindfulness of this and We have removed from you your cover so your sight this Day is sharp.

candidates.label: Hell asking for more while Paradise brought near to the righteous
candidates.normLabel: hell asking for more while paradise brought near to the righteous
candidates.definition: In 50:30-31: On the Day We will say to Hell have you been filled and it will say are there some more; and Paradise will be brought near to the righteous not far.

candidates.label: Creation in six days without weariness affirming divine capacity
candidates.normLabel: creation in six days without weariness affirming divine capacity
candidates.definition: In 50:38: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days and there touched Us no weariness.

candidates.label: Timed praise commanded alongside patience over their words
candidates.normLabel: timed praise commanded alongside patience over their words
candidates.definition: In 50:39-40: So be patient over what they say and exalt with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting and in part of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

candidates.label: Reminder by Quran limited to whoever fears the divine threat
candidates.normLabel: reminder by quran limited to whoever fears the divine threat
candidates.definition: In 50:45: We are most knowing of what they say and you are not over them a tyrant; but remind by the Quran whoever fears My threat.

candidates.label: Four oaths grounding the certainty of promised recompense
candidates.normLabel: four oaths grounding the certainty of promised recompense
candidates.definition: In 51:1-6: By those winds scattering and those clouds carrying a load and those ships sailing with ease and those angels apportioning each matter; indeed what you are promised is true and indeed the recompense is to occur.

candidates.label: Righteous profile: little sleep, pre-dawn istighfar, giving the needy their due
candidates.normLabel: righteous profile: little sleep, pre-dawn istighfar, giving the needy their due
candidates.definition: In 51:17-19: They used to sleep but little of the night and in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness and from their properties was given the right of the petitioner and the deprived.

candidates.label: Signs on earth and in selves for the certain with provision in heaven
candidates.normLabel: signs on earth and in selves for the certain with provision in heaven
candidates.definition: In 51:20-22: And on the earth are signs for the certain in faith and in yourselves then will you not see; and in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

candidates.label: Lord-of-heaven-and-earth oath affirming truth equal to speech-certainty
candidates.normLabel: lord-of-heaven-and-earth oath affirming truth equal to speech-certainty
candidates.definition: In 51:23: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth indeed it is truth just as sure as it is that you are speaking.

candidates.label: Abraham's hospitality and the guests' glad tidings of a learned son
candidates.normLabel: abraham's hospitality and the guests' glad tidings of a learned son
candidates.definition: In 51:24-30: Has there reached you the story of the honoured guests of Abraham when they entered and said peace; he went to his family and came with a fat roasted calf placed near them; he felt apprehension, they said fear not and gave glad tidings of a learned boy; his wife approached with a cry striking her face saying barren old woman; they said thus has said your Lord indeed He is the Wise the Knowing.

candidates.label: Marked clay stones rained upon transgressors after believers extracted
candidates.normLabel: marked clay stones rained upon transgressors after believers extracted
candidates.definition: In 51:33-37: To send down upon them stones of clay marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors; so We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers and found not within them other than a single house of Muslims and We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

candidates.label: Five destroyed communities catalogued as warning signs
candidates.normLabel: five destroyed communities catalogued as warning signs
candidates.definition: In 51:38-46: Moses sent to Pharaoh with clear authority but dismissed as magician or madman, taken with soldiers cast into sea; Aad struck by barren wind leaving disintegrated ruins; Thamud told to enjoy then insolent, seized by thunderbolt; Noah's people destroyed as defiantly disobedient.

candidates.label: Heaven constructed with strength and expanded, earth spread by excellent preparer
candidates.normLabel: heaven constructed with strength and expanded, earth spread by excellent preparer
candidates.definition: In 51:47-48: And the heaven We constructed with strength and indeed We are its expander; and the earth We have spread out and excellent is the preparer.

candidates.label: All things created in pairs inviting remembrance
candidates.normLabel: all things created in pairs inviting remembrance
candidates.definition: In 51:49: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

candidates.label: Flight to Allah urged with clear-warner commission
candidates.normLabel: flight to allah urged with clear-warner commission
candidates.definition: In 51:50-51: So flee to Allah; indeed I am to you from Him a clear warner; and do not make with Allah another deity; indeed I am to you from Him a clear warner.

candidates.label: Jinn and mankind created solely for worship with Allah needing nothing
candidates.normLabel: jinn and mankind created solely for worship with allah needing nothing
candidates.definition: In 51:56-58: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me; I do not want from them any provision nor do I want them to feed Me; indeed Allah is the continual Provider the firm possessor of strength.

candidates.label: Woe to disbelievers from their promised Day
candidates.normLabel: woe to disbelievers from their promised day
candidates.definition: In 51:60: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

candidates.label: Six oaths grounding the inevitability of divine punishment
candidates.normLabel: six oaths grounding the inevitability of divine punishment
candidates.definition: In 52:1-8: By the mount and a Book inscribed in parchment spread open and the frequented House and the ceiling raised high and the sea set on fire; indeed the punishment of your Lord will occur; of it there is no preventer.

candidates.label: Cosmic upheaval on the Day: heaven swaying and mountains departing
candidates.normLabel: cosmic upheaval on the day: heaven swaying and mountains departing
candidates.definition: In 52:9-10: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion and the mountains will pass on departing.

candidates.label: Violent shoving toward Hell with angels declaring the denied Fire
candidates.normLabel: violent shoving toward hell with angels declaring the denied fire
candidates.definition: In 52:13-14: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a violent shove; this is the Fire which you used to deny.

candidates.label: Patience and impatience equal in Hell — only recompense for deeds
candidates.normLabel: patience and impatience equal in hell — only recompense for deeds
candidates.definition: In 52:16: Enter to burn therein; then be patient or impatient it is all the same for you; you are only being recompensed for what you used to do.

candidates.label: Righteous reward: gardens, joy, protection, food, drink, spouses and servants
candidates.normLabel: righteous reward: gardens, joy, protection, food, drink, spouses and servants
candidates.definition: In 52:17-24: Indeed the righteous will be among gardens and happiness rejoicing in what their Lord has given them and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire; eat and drink in satisfaction; reclining on arranged couches married to fair women with large beautiful eyes; provided with fruit and meat; exchanging cups with no ill speech or sin; servant boys circulating like protected pearls.

candidates.label: Believing families reunited in Paradise without deed-deprivation
candidates.normLabel: believing families reunited in paradise without deed-deprivation
candidates.definition: In 52:21: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith We will join with them their descendants and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds; every person for what he earned is retained.

candidates.label: Former fear and supplication acknowledged as cause of divine favour
candidates.normLabel: former fear and supplication acknowledged as cause of divine favour
candidates.definition: In 52:26-28: They will say indeed we were previously among our people fearful of displeasing Allah; so Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire; indeed we used to supplicate Him before; indeed He is the Beneficent the Merciful.

candidates.label: Reminder commissioned; Prophet neither soothsayer nor madman
candidates.normLabel: reminder commissioned; prophet neither soothsayer nor madman
candidates.definition: In 52:29: So remind by the grace of your Lord you are not a soothsayer or a madman.

candidates.label: Five rhetorical questions exposing denial's incoherence
candidates.normLabel: five rhetorical questions exposing denial's incoherence
candidates.definition: In 52:35-39: Or were they created by nothing or were they the creators of themselves? Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather they are not certain. Or have they the depositories of your Lord or are they in control? Or have they a stairway upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority. Or has He daughters while you have sons?

candidates.label: Sky-fragment dismissed as clouds illustrating obstinate denial
candidates.normLabel: sky-fragment dismissed as clouds illustrating obstinate denial
candidates.definition: In 52:44: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling they would say it is merely clouds brought in layers.

candidates.label: Timed praise commanded alongside patience under divine sight
candidates.normLabel: timed praise commanded alongside patience under divine sight
candidates.definition: In 52:48-49: And be patient for the decision of your Lord for indeed you are in Our eyes; and exalt with praise of your Lord when you arise and in a part of the night exalt Him and after the setting of the stars.

candidates.label: Revelation affirmed against inclination; taught by one intense in strength
candidates.normLabel: revelation affirmed against inclination; taught by one intense in strength
candidates.definition: In 53:3-5: Nor does he speak from his own inclination; it is not but a revelation revealed, taught to him by one intense in strength.

candidates.label: Two descents and the Lote Tree vision confirming greatest signs
candidates.normLabel: two descents and the lote tree vision confirming greatest signs
candidates.definition: In 53:13-18: And he certainly saw him in another descent at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary near which is the Garden of Refuge; when there covered the Lote Tree that which covered it; the sight did not swerve nor transgress its limit; he certainly saw the greatest signs of his Lord.

candidates.label: Idol-names as baseless invention without divine authority
candidates.normLabel: idol-names as baseless invention without divine authority
candidates.definition: In 53:23: They are not but names you have named them, you and your forefathers, for which Allah has sent down no authority; they follow not except assumption and what their souls desire.

candidates.label: Angelic intercession restricted to divine permission and approval
candidates.normLabel: angelic intercession restricted to divine permission and approval
candidates.definition: In 53:26: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except only after Allah has permitted it to whom He wills and approves.

candidates.label: Avoiders of major sins granted vast forgiveness; self-purification claims rejected
candidates.normLabel: avoiders of major sins granted vast forgiveness; self-purification claims rejected
candidates.definition: In 53:32: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only committing slight ones; indeed your Lord is vast in forgiveness; He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers; so do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

candidates.label: No bearer of burdens bearing another's; man has only what he strives for
candidates.normLabel: no bearer of burdens bearing another's; man has only what he strives for
candidates.definition: In 53:38-39: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another; and that there is not for man except that for which he strives.

candidates.label: Effort seen and fully recompensed with finality to the Lord
candidates.normLabel: effort seen and fully recompensed with finality to the lord
candidates.definition: In 53:40-42: And that his effort is going to be seen; then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense; and that to your Lord is the finality.

candidates.label: Divine attributes chain: laugh-weep, death-life, pairs, creation, provision, Sirius
candidates.normLabel: divine attributes chain: laugh-weep, death-life, pairs, creation, provision, sirius
candidates.definition: In 53:43-49: And that it is He who makes one laugh and weep and causes death and gives life and creates the two mates male and female from a sperm-drop when emitted and that incumbent upon Him is the next creation and that it is He who enriches and suffices and that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

candidates.label: Five destroyed communities recalled as undeniable favors-signs
candidates.normLabel: five destroyed communities recalled as undeniable favors-signs
candidates.definition: In 53:50-55: And that He destroyed the first Aad and Thamud and did not spare them and the people of Noah before, indeed they were more unjust and oppressing; and the overturned towns He hurled down and covered them by that which He covered; then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

candidates.label: Approaching Day imminent with no remover besides Allah
candidates.normLabel: approaching day imminent with no remover besides allah
candidates.definition: In 53:57-58: The Approaching Day has approached; of it from those besides Allah there is no remover.

candidates.label: Closing prostration command after condemning laughter and proud sportiveness
candidates.normLabel: closing prostration command after condemning laughter and proud sportiveness
candidates.definition: In 53:59-62: Then at this statement do you wonder and you laugh and do not weep while you are proudly sporting; so prostrate to Allah and worship Him.

candidates.label: Moon-splitting as sign of the Hour's nearness
candidates.normLabel: moon-splitting as sign of the hour's nearness
candidates.definition: In 54:1: The Hour has come near and the moon has split.

candidates.label: Miracles dismissed as magic while denial follows inclination
candidates.normLabel: miracles dismissed as magic while denial follows inclination
candidates.definition: In 54:2-3: And if they see a miracle they turn away and say passing magic; and they denied and followed their inclinations but for every matter is a time of settlement.

candidates.label: Resurrection emergence like spreading locusts racing to the Caller
candidates.normLabel: resurrection emergence like spreading locusts racing to the caller
candidates.definition: In 54:7-8: Their eyes humbled they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading racing ahead toward the Caller; the disbelievers will say this is a difficult Day.

candidates.label: Noah's flood as predestined sign with ark sailing under observation
candidates.normLabel: noah's flood as predestined sign with ark sailing under observation
candidates.definition: In 54:9-15: People of Noah denied Our servant called madman repelled; he invoked I am overpowered so help; We opened heaven's gates with rain and earth burst with springs; carried on planks and nails sailing under Our observation as reward for the denied; left as a sign.

candidates.label: Aad destroyed by screaming wind extracting like uprooted palms
candidates.normLabel: aad destroyed by screaming wind extracting like uprooted palms
candidates.definition: In 54:18-21: Aad denied; We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

candidates.label: Thamud's she-camel trial and hamstringing answered by one blast
candidates.normLabel: thamud's she-camel trial and hamstringing answered by one blast
candidates.definition: In 54:23-31: Thamud denied the warning saying is it one human among us; We sent the she-camel as trial; they hamstrung her; We sent one blast from the sky and they became like dry twig fragments.

candidates.label: Lot's people struck by stone-storm with family saved before dawn
candidates.normLabel: lot's people struck by stone-storm with family saved before dawn
candidates.definition: In 54:33-39: People of Lot denied warning; We sent storm of stones except family saved before dawn as favour; they disputed warning and demanded guests; We obliterated their eyes; morning brought abiding punishment.

candidates.label: Pharaoh's people seized by the Exalted Mighty Perfect in Ability
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh's people seized by the exalted mighty perfect in ability
candidates.definition: In 54:41-42: There certainly came to Pharaoh's people warning; they denied Our signs all of them so We seized them with a seizure of One Exalted in Might Perfect in Ability.

candidates.label: All things created with predestination; command in a single glance
candidates.normLabel: all things created with predestination; command in a single glance
candidates.definition: In 54:49-50: Indeed all things We created with predestination; and Our command is but one like a glance of the eye.

candidates.label: Every deed inscribed in written records, small and great
candidates.normLabel: every deed inscribed in written records, small and great
candidates.definition: In 54:52-53: And everything they did is in written records; and every small and great thing is inscribed.

candidates.label: Righteous in gardens and rivers at seat of honour near the Sovereign
candidates.normLabel: righteous in gardens and rivers at seat of honour near the sovereign
candidates.definition: In 54:54-55: Indeed the righteous will be among gardens and rivers in a seat of honour near a Sovereign Perfect in Ability.

candidates.label: The Most Merciful as teacher of Quran and giver of eloquence
candidates.normLabel: the most merciful as teacher of quran and giver of eloquence
candidates.definition: In 55:1-4: The Most Merciful taught the Quran, created man and taught him eloquence.

candidates.label: Balance imposed with prohibition of transgression and command of just weight
candidates.normLabel: balance imposed with prohibition of transgression and command of just weight
candidates.definition: In 55:7-9: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance, that you not transgress within the balance, and establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

candidates.label: Distinct creation materials for man and jinn
candidates.normLabel: distinct creation materials for man and jinn
candidates.definition: In 55:14-15: He created man from clay like that of pottery and He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

candidates.label: Two seas meeting behind an untransgressed barrier yielding pearl and coral
candidates.normLabel: two seas meeting behind an untransgressed barrier yielding pearl and coral
candidates.definition: In 55:19-22: He released the two seas meeting side by side, between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses; from both of them emerge pearl and coral.

candidates.label: Universal perishing against the remaining Face of Majesty and Honour
candidates.normLabel: universal perishing against the remaining face of majesty and honour
candidates.definition: In 55:26-27: Everyone upon the earth will perish and there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

candidates.label: Continuous dependence of all beings on daily divine disposal
candidates.normLabel: continuous dependence of all beings on daily divine disposal
candidates.definition: In 55:29: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.

candidates.label: Escape beyond cosmic regions impossible without authority
candidates.normLabel: escape beyond cosmic regions impossible without authority
candidates.definition: In 55:33: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth then pass; you will not pass except by authority.

candidates.label: Criminals known by marks and seized without questioning
candidates.normLabel: criminals known by marks and seized without questioning
candidates.definition: In 55:39-41: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn; the criminals will be known by their marks and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

candidates.label: Circulation between the denied Hell and utmost-heated scalding water
candidates.normLabel: circulation between the denied hell and utmost-heated scalding water
candidates.definition: In 55:43-44: This is Hell which the criminals deny; they will go around between it and scalding water heated to the utmost degree.

candidates.label: Two gardens for whoever feared standing before his Lord
candidates.normLabel: two gardens for whoever feared standing before his lord
candidates.definition: In 55:46-52: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens having spreading branches; in both of them are two springs flowing; in both of them are of every fruit two kinds.

candidates.label: Reward for good declared to be nothing but good
candidates.normLabel: reward for good declared to be nothing but good
candidates.definition: In 55:60: Is the reward for good anything but good?

candidates.label: Second garden pair with spouting springs and reserved companions
candidates.normLabel: second garden pair with spouting springs and reserved companions
candidates.definition: In 55:62-76: And below them both in excellence are two other gardens, dark green in color; in both are two springs spouting; in both are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates; in them are good and beautiful women, fair ones reserved in pavilions untouched before them by man or jinni; reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

candidates.label: Closing blessing on the name of the Lord of Majesty and Honour
candidates.normLabel: closing blessing on the name of the lord of majesty and honour
candidates.definition: In 55:78: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

candidates.label: The Occurrence levelling and elevating while cosmos dissolves
candidates.normLabel: the occurrence levelling and elevating while cosmos dissolves
candidates.definition: In 56:1-6: When the Occurrence occurs there is at its occurrence no denial; it will bring down some and raise up others; when the earth is shaken with convulsion and the mountains are broken down crumbling and become dust dispersing.

candidates.label: Threefold division of humanity with forerunners brought near
candidates.normLabel: threefold division of humanity with forerunners brought near
candidates.definition: In 56:7-12: And you become of three kinds; then the companions of the right, what are the companions of the right; and the companions of the left, what are the companions of the left; and the forerunners, the forerunners, those are the ones brought near in the Gardens of Pleasure.

candidates.label: Forerunners' reward: thrones, eternal servants, pure drink and peace-only speech
candidates.normLabel: forerunners' reward: thrones, eternal servants, pure drink and peace-only speech
candidates.definition: In 56:15-26: On thrones woven reclining facing each other; there circulate among them young boys made eternal with vessels pitchers and a cup from a flowing spring, no headache nor intoxication; fruit of what they select and meat of fowl; fair women like protected pearls as reward for what they used to do; they will not hear ill speech or sin, only a saying peace peace.

candidates.label: Companions of the right amid thornless trees, shade and unrestricted fruit
candidates.normLabel: companions of the right amid thornless trees, shade and unrestricted fruit
candidates.definition: In 56:28-34: Among lote trees with thorns removed and trees layered with fruit and shade extended and water poured out and fruit abundant neither limited to season nor forbidden and upon beds raised high.

candidates.label: Affluence-indulgence and great violation cited as causes of the left's punishment
candidates.normLabel: affluence-indulgence and great violation cited as causes of the left's punishment
candidates.definition: In 56:42-46: In scorching fire and scalding water and a shade of black smoke neither cool nor beneficial; indeed they were before that indulging in affluence and they used to persist in the great violation.

candidates.label: Former and later peoples gathered for a known Day's appointment
candidates.normLabel: former and later peoples gathered for a known day's appointment
candidates.definition: In 56:49-50: Say indeed the former and the later peoples are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day.

candidates.label: Zaqqum diet and camel-like drinking as the deniers' accommodation
candidates.normLabel: zaqqum diet and camel-like drinking as the deniers' accommodation
candidates.definition: In 56:52-56: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum and filling with it your bellies and drinking on top of it from scalding water and will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels; that is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

candidates.label: Emitted seed and decreed death as creation-and-replacement evidence
candidates.normLabel: emitted seed and decreed death as creation-and-replacement evidence
candidates.definition: In 56:58-62: Have you seen that which you emit; is it you who creates it or are We the Creator; We have decreed death among you and We are not to be outdone in that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that form which you do not know; and you have already known the first creation so will you not remember.

candidates.label: Sown seed, cloud-water and fire-tree as four providential challenges
candidates.normLabel: sown seed, cloud-water and fire-tree as four providential challenges
candidates.definition: In 56:63-73: Have you seen that seed which you sow, is it you who makes it grow or are We the grower; have you seen the water that you drink, is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We; if We willed We could make it bitter so why are you not grateful; and have you seen the fire that you ignite, is it you who produced its tree or are We the producer; We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers.

candidates.label: Star-setting oath grounding a noble Quran in a protected Register
candidates.normLabel: star-setting oath grounding a noble quran in a protected register
candidates.definition: In 56:75-80: Then I swear by the setting of the stars and indeed it is an oath if you could know most great; indeed it is a noble Quran in a Register well-protected, none touch it except the purified, a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

candidates.label: Deathbed helplessness with unseen angels nearer than onlookers
candidates.normLabel: deathbed helplessness with unseen angels nearer than onlookers
candidates.definition: In 56:83-87: Then why when the soul at death reaches the throat and you are at that time looking on and Our angels are nearer to him than you but you do not see; then why do you not if you are not to be recompensed bring it back if you should be truthful.

candidates.label: Threefold deathbed outcome matched to the three kinds
candidates.normLabel: threefold deathbed outcome matched to the three kinds
candidates.definition: In 56:88-95: And if the deceased was of those brought near then rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure; and if he was of the companions of the right then peace for you from the companions of the right; but if he was of the deniers astray then accommodation of scalding water and burning in Hellfire; indeed this is the true certainty.

candidates.label: The four paired names: First, Last, Ascendant, Intimate
candidates.normLabel: the four paired names: first, last, ascendant, intimate
candidates.definition: In 57:3: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is of all things Knowing.

candidates.label: Throne establishment with comprehensive knowledge and presence wherever they are
candidates.normLabel: throne establishment with comprehensive knowledge and presence wherever they are
candidates.definition: In 57:4: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne; He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are.

candidates.label: Spending as stewardship over what Allah made them successors in
candidates.normLabel: spending as stewardship over what allah made them successors in
candidates.definition: In 57:7: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors; for those who have believed among you and spent there will be a great reward.

candidates.label: Pre-conquest spenders and fighters ranked above later ones
candidates.normLabel: pre-conquest spenders and fighters ranked above later ones
candidates.definition: In 57:10: Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest and fought and those who did so after it; those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought, but to all Allah has promised the best.

candidates.label: The goodly loan multiplied into a noble reward
candidates.normLabel: the goodly loan multiplied into a noble reward
candidates.definition: In 57:11: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

candidates.label: Believers' light proceeding before them while hypocrites are walled off
candidates.normLabel: believers' light proceeding before them while hypocrites are walled off
candidates.definition: In 57:12-13: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women their light proceeding before them and on their right; the hypocrite men and women will say wait for us that we may acquire some of your light; it will be said go back behind you and seek light; and a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy but on the outside torment.

candidates.label: Hypocrisy diagnosed as self-affliction, doubt and deluding wishful thinking
candidates.normLabel: hypocrisy diagnosed as self-affliction, doubt and deluding wishful thinking
candidates.definition: In 57:14: They will say yes but you afflicted yourselves and awaited misfortune and doubted and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah, and the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.

candidates.label: Heart-humbling at remembrance against the hardening of earlier communities
candidates.normLabel: heart-humbling at remembrance against the hardening of earlier communities
candidates.definition: In 57:16: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth; and let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before and a long period passed over them so their hearts hardened.

candidates.label: Worldly life as boasting and competition likened to yellowing crops
candidates.normLabel: worldly life as boasting and competition likened to yellowing crops
candidates.definition: In 57:20: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children, like the example of a rain whose plant growth pleases the tillers then it dries and you see it turned yellow then it becomes scattered debris.

candidates.label: Disaster pre-written in a register so believers neither despair nor exult
candidates.normLabel: disaster pre-written in a register so believers neither despair nor exult
candidates.definition: In 57:22-23: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being, indeed that for Allah is easy, in order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult over what He has given you.

candidates.label: Scripture, balance and iron sent so people maintain justice
candidates.normLabel: scripture, balance and iron sent so people maintain justice
candidates.definition: In 57:25: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain their affairs in justice; and We sent down iron wherein is great military might and benefits for the people.

candidates.label: Monasticism innovated rather than prescribed and improperly observed
candidates.normLabel: monasticism innovated rather than prescribed and improperly observed
candidates.definition: In 57:27: And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except that they did so seeking the approval of Allah, but they did not observe it with due observance.

candidates.label: Double mercy, walking light and forgiveness for taqwa and belief
candidates.normLabel: double mercy, walking light and forgiveness for taqwa and belief
candidates.definition: In 57:28: O you who have believed fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will then give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you.

candidates.label: The pleading woman's complaint heard by Allah who hears the whole dialogue
candidates.normLabel: the pleading woman's complaint heard by allah who hears the whole dialogue
candidates.definition: In 58:1: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah; and Allah hears your dialogue, indeed Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

candidates.label: Zihar repudiated because mothers are only those who gave birth
candidates.normLabel: zihar repudiated because mothers are only those who gave birth
candidates.definition: In 58:2: Those who pronounce zihar among you to separate from their wives, they are not consequently their mothers; their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them; and indeed they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood, but indeed Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

candidates.label: Graduated expiation ladder for retracting zihar within Allah's limits
candidates.normLabel: graduated expiation ladder for retracting zihar within allah's limits
candidates.definition: In 58:3-4: Those who pronounce zihar and then wish to go back on what they said must free a slave before they touch one another; and he who does not find one then a fast for two months consecutively; and he who is unable then the feeding of sixty poor persons; those are the limits set by Allah.

candidates.label: Deeds enumerated by Allah though forgotten by their doers
candidates.normLabel: deeds enumerated by allah though forgotten by their doers
candidates.definition: In 58:6: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did; Allah had enumerated it while they forgot it, and Allah is over all things Witness.

candidates.label: Private-conversation formula establishing knowledge-based presence
candidates.normLabel: private-conversation formula establishing knowledge-based presence
candidates.definition: In 58:7: There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them, and no less than that and no more except that He is with them wherever they are.

candidates.label: Private counsel redirected from sin and aggression to righteousness and piety
candidates.normLabel: private counsel redirected from sin and aggression to righteousness and piety
candidates.definition: In 58:9: O you who have believed, when you converse privately do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety, and fear Allah to whom you will be gathered.

candidates.label: Satanic whispering meant to grieve believers yet powerless without permission
candidates.normLabel: satanic whispering meant to grieve believers yet powerless without permission
candidates.definition: In 58:10: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allah; and upon Allah let the believers rely.

candidates.label: Assembly courtesy answered by divine elevation of believers and the knowledgeable
candidates.normLabel: assembly courtesy answered by divine elevation of believers and the knowledgeable
candidates.definition: In 58:11: O you who have believed, when you are told space yourselves in assemblies then make space, Allah will make space for you; and when you are told arise then arise, Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge by degrees.

candidates.label: Charity before private consultation with concession and reaffirmed obligations
candidates.normLabel: charity before private consultation with concession and reaffirmed obligations
candidates.definition: In 58:12-13: When you wish to privately consult the Messenger present before your consultation a charity, that is better for you and purer, but if you find not the means then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful; have you feared to present charities, then when you do not and Allah has forgiven you then establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger.

candidates.label: False oaths used as cover to avert people from Allah's way
candidates.normLabel: false oaths used as cover to avert people from allah's way
candidates.definition: In 58:16: They took their false oaths as a cover so they averted people from the way of Allah, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

candidates.label: Satan's mastery producing forgetfulness of remembrance and the losing party
candidates.normLabel: satan's mastery producing forgetfulness of remembrance and the losing party
candidates.definition: In 58:19: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allah; those are the party of Satan; unquestionably the party of Satan they will be the losers.

candidates.label: Written decree that Allah and His messengers will surely overcome
candidates.normLabel: written decree that allah and his messengers will surely overcome
candidates.definition: In 58:21: Allah has written, I will surely overcome, I and My messengers; indeed Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

candidates.label: Loyalty overriding kinship with faith inscribed and mutual pleasure as the successful party
candidates.normLabel: loyalty overriding kinship with faith inscribed and mutual pleasure as the successful party
candidates.definition: In 58:22: You will not find a people who believe in Allah and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred; those He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him, and We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow wherein they abide eternally; Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him, those are the party of Allah, unquestionably the party of Allah they are the successful.

candidates.label: Fortress confidence shattered by an unperceived decree and cast terror
candidates.normLabel: fortress confidence shattered by an unperceived decree and cast terror
candidates.definition: In 59:2: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering; you did not think they would leave and they thought their fortresses would protect them from Allah, but the decree of Allah came upon them from where they had not expected and He cast terror into their hearts so they destroyed their houses by their own hands and the hands of the believers; so take warning, O people of vision.

candidates.label: Evacuation decreed in place of immediate worldly punishment
candidates.normLabel: evacuation decreed in place of immediate worldly punishment
candidates.definition: In 59:3: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation He would have punished them in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.

candidates.label: Fay' distributed to defined categories preventing wealth concentration
candidates.normLabel: fay' distributed to defined categories preventing wealth concentration
candidates.definition: In 59:7: And what Allah restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns is for Allah and for the Messenger and for his near relatives and orphans and the needy and the stranded traveler, so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you; and whatever the Messenger has given you take and what he has forbidden you refrain from.

candidates.label: Ansar preference for emigrants despite privation and protection from soul-stinginess
candidates.normLabel: ansar preference for emigrants despite privation and protection from soul-stinginess
candidates.definition: In 59:9: And also for those who were settled in al-Madinah and adopted the faith before them; they love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what the emigrants were given but give them preference over themselves even though they are in privation; and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul, it is those who will be the successful.

candidates.label: Later generations praying for predecessors and hearts free of rancour
candidates.normLabel: later generations praying for predecessors and hearts free of rancour
candidates.definition: In 59:10: And there is a share for those who came after them saying our Lord forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed; our Lord indeed You are Kind and Merciful.

candidates.label: Hypocrite promises of support exposed as lies by divine testimony
candidates.normLabel: hypocrite promises of support exposed as lies by divine testimony
candidates.definition: In 59:11-12: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy saying to their brothers who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture if you are expelled we will surely leave with you and if you are fought we will surely aid you, but Allah testifies that they are liars; if they are expelled they will not leave with them and if they are fought they will not aid them.

candidates.label: Apparent unity masking divided hearts with fear of believers exceeding fear of Allah
candidates.normLabel: apparent unity masking divided hearts with fear of believers exceeding fear of allah
candidates.definition: In 59:13-14: You are more fearful within their breasts than Allah, that is because they are a people who do not understand; they will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls, their violence among themselves is severe, you think they are together but their hearts are diverse.

candidates.label: Satan urging disbelief then disavowing the disbeliever
candidates.normLabel: satan urging disbelief then disavowing the disbeliever
candidates.definition: In 59:16-17: The hypocrites are like the example of Satan when he says to man disbelieve, but when he disbelieves he says indeed I am disassociated from you, indeed I fear Allah Lord of the worlds; so the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire abiding eternally therein.

candidates.label: Self-examination for tomorrow commanded under divine acquaintance
candidates.normLabel: self-examination for tomorrow commanded under divine acquaintance
candidates.definition: In 59:18: O you who have believed fear Allah, and let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow, and fear Allah; indeed Allah is Acquainted with what you do.

candidates.label: Forgetting Allah answered by being made to forget oneself
