candidates.normLabel: forgetting allah answered by being made to forget oneself
candidates.definition: In 59:19: And be not like those who forgot Allah so He made them forget themselves; those are the defiantly disobedient.

candidates.label: Mountain parable illustrating the Quran's weight against hardened hearts
candidates.normLabel: mountain parable illustrating the quran's weight against hardened hearts
candidates.definition: In 59:21: If We had sent down this Quran upon a mountain you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah; and these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

candidates.label: Closing divine-name sequence culminating in the best names
candidates.normLabel: closing divine-name sequence culminating in the best names
candidates.definition: In 59:22-24: He is Allah other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Entirely Merciful the Especially Merciful; He is Allah other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign the Pure the Perfection the Bestower of Faith the Overseer the Exalted in Might the Compeller the Superior; He is Allah the Creator the Inventor the Fashioner, to Him belong the best names.

candidates.label: Alliance with persecuting enemies forbidden despite concealed affection
candidates.normLabel: alliance with persecuting enemies forbidden despite concealed affection
candidates.definition: In 60:1: O you who have believed do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves only because you believe in Allah your Lord; you confide to them affection but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared.

candidates.label: Kinship and offspring useless before the Resurrection judgement
candidates.normLabel: kinship and offspring useless before the resurrection judgement
candidates.definition: In 60:3: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you; and Allah of what you do is Seeing.

candidates.label: Abrahamic pattern of disassociation with the filial forgiveness exception
candidates.normLabel: abrahamic pattern of disassociation with the filial forgiveness exception
candidates.definition: In 60:4: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him when they said to their people indeed we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allah, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allah alone, except for the saying of Abraham to his father I will surely ask forgiveness for you but I have not power to do for you anything against Allah.

candidates.label: Taught supplication against becoming an object of torment for disbelievers
candidates.normLabel: taught supplication against becoming an object of torment for disbelievers
candidates.definition: In 60:5: Our Lord make us not objects of torment for the disbelievers and forgive us our Lord; indeed it is You who is the Exalted in Might the Wise.

candidates.label: Affection between former enemies left open as divine possibility
candidates.normLabel: affection between former enemies left open as divine possibility
candidates.definition: In 60:7: Perhaps Allah will put between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them affection; and Allah is competent and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

candidates.label: Righteousness and justice permitted toward non-hostile non-believers
candidates.normLabel: righteousness and justice permitted toward non-hostile non-believers
candidates.definition: In 60:8: Allah does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them; indeed Allah loves those who act justly.

candidates.label: Alliance forbidden only with fighters, expellers and their assistants
candidates.normLabel: alliance forbidden only with fighters, expellers and their assistants
candidates.definition: In 60:9: Allah only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion that you make allies of them; and whoever makes allies of them then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

candidates.label: Examination of emigrant women with marriage dissolution and dower reimbursement
candidates.normLabel: examination of emigrant women with marriage dissolution and dower reimbursement
candidates.definition: In 60:10: O you who have believed when the believing women come to you as emigrants examine them, Allah is most knowing as to their faith; and if you know them to be believers then do not return them to the disbelievers, they are not lawful wives for them nor are they lawful husbands for them, but give the disbelievers what they have spent; and hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women but ask for what you have spent and let them ask for what they have spent; that is the judgement of Allah.

candidates.label: Six-part women's pledge accepted with prophetic istighfar
candidates.normLabel: six-part women's pledge accepted with prophetic istighfar
candidates.definition: In 60:12: O Prophet when the believing women come to you pledging that they will not associate anything with Allah nor steal nor commit unlawful sexual intercourse nor kill their children nor bring forth a slander they have invented nor disobey you in what is right, then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allah.

candidates.label: Despair of the Hereafter likened to despair of the grave-dwellers
candidates.normLabel: despair of the hereafter likened to despair of the grave-dwellers
candidates.definition: In 60:13: O you who have believed do not make allies of a people with whom Allah has become angry; they have despaired of the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of meeting the inhabitants of the graves.

candidates.label: Saying without doing named as greatly hateful in Allah's sight
candidates.normLabel: saying without doing named as greatly hateful in allah's sight
candidates.definition: In 61:2-3: O you who have believed why do you say what you do not do? Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

candidates.label: Firm ranks in Allah's cause likened to a joined structure as what He loves
candidates.normLabel: firm ranks in allah's cause likened to a joined structure as what he loves
candidates.definition: In 61:4: Indeed Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a single structure joined firmly.

candidates.label: Musa's complaint of harm from his own people despite known messengership
candidates.normLabel: musa's complaint of harm from his own people despite known messengership
candidates.definition: In 61:5: And when Moses said to his people O my people why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you? And when they deviated Allah caused their hearts to deviate.

candidates.label: Isa confirming Torah and naming Ahmad as the coming messenger
candidates.normLabel: isa confirming torah and naming ahmad as the coming messenger
candidates.definition: In 61:6: And when Jesus the son of Mary said O children of Israel indeed I am the messenger of Allah to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me whose name is Ahmad; but when he came to them with clear evidences they said this is obvious magic.

candidates.label: Supreme injustice named as fabrication against Allah during invitation to Islam
candidates.normLabel: supreme injustice named as fabrication against allah during invitation to islam
candidates.definition: In 61:7: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

candidates.label: Divine light perfected despite attempts to extinguish it with mouths
candidates.normLabel: divine light perfected despite attempts to extinguish it with mouths
candidates.definition: In 61:8: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths but Allah will perfect His light although the disbelievers dislike it.

candidates.label: The saving trade: belief and striving with wealth and lives
candidates.normLabel: the saving trade: belief and striving with wealth and lives
candidates.definition: In 61:10-11: O you who have believed shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment? It is that you believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives; that is best for you if you should know.

candidates.label: Great attainment: forgiveness, rivered gardens and pleasant dwellings
candidates.normLabel: great attainment: forgiveness, rivered gardens and pleasant dwellings
candidates.definition: In 61:12: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence; that is the great attainment.

candidates.label: Victory and imminent conquest as additional beloved favour
candidates.normLabel: victory and imminent conquest as additional beloved favour
candidates.definition: In 61:13: And another favour that you love, victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

candidates.label: Hawariyyun pledge of support as model for the believing community
candidates.normLabel: hawariyyun pledge of support as model for the believing community
candidates.definition: In 61:14: O you who have believed be supporters of Allah as when Jesus the son of Mary said to the disciples who are my supporters for Allah? The disciples said we are supporters of Allah; and a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved; so We supported those who believed against their enemy and they became dominant.

candidates.label: Four-name tasbih opening grounding the unlettered Messenger's commission
candidates.normLabel: four-name tasbih opening grounding the unlettered messenger's commission
candidates.definition: In 62:1-2: Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise; it is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom although they were before in clear error.

candidates.label: Mission extending beyond contemporaries framed entirely as divine bounty
candidates.normLabel: mission extending beyond contemporaries framed entirely as divine bounty
candidates.definition: In 62:3-4: And to others of them who have not yet joined them; and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise; that is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

candidates.label: Torah-bearers who failed to carry it likened to a book-laden donkey
candidates.normLabel: torah-bearers who failed to carry it likened to a book-laden donkey
candidates.definition: In 62:5: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes of books; wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah.

candidates.label: Exclusive-alliance claim tested by the death-wish challenge
candidates.normLabel: exclusive-alliance claim tested by the death-wish challenge
candidates.definition: In 62:6-7: Say O you who are Jews if you claim that you are allies of Allah excluding other people then wish for death if you should be truthful; but they will not wish for it ever because of what their hands have put forth.

candidates.label: Death fleeing futile with return to the Knower of unseen and witnessed
candidates.normLabel: death fleeing futile with return to the knower of unseen and witnessed
candidates.definition: In 62:8: Say indeed the death from which you flee, indeed it will meet you; then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed and He will inform you about what you used to do.

candidates.label: Jumu'ah obligation: leave trade for remembrance, disperse after prayer
candidates.normLabel: jumu'ah obligation: leave trade for remembrance, disperse after prayer
candidates.definition: In 62:9-10: O you who have believed when the call is made for prayer on the day of Jumu'ah then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade, that is better for you if you only knew; and when the prayer has been concluded disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah and remember Allah often that you may succeed.

candidates.label: Trade and diversion subordinated to what is with Allah as best provider
candidates.normLabel: trade and diversion subordinated to what is with allah as best provider
candidates.definition: In 62:11: But when they saw a transaction or a diversion they rushed to it and left you standing; say what is with Allah is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allah is the best of providers.

candidates.label: Verbal testimony exposed as lying by divine counter-testimony
candidates.normLabel: verbal testimony exposed as lying by divine counter-testimony
candidates.definition: In 63:1: When the hypocrites come to you O Muhammad they say we testify that you are the Messenger of Allah; and Allah knows that you are His Messenger and Allah testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

candidates.label: Oaths weaponised as cover to obstruct the divine way
candidates.normLabel: oaths weaponised as cover to obstruct the divine way
candidates.definition: In 63:2: They have taken their oaths as a cover so they averted people from the way of Allah; indeed it was evil that they were doing.

candidates.label: Belief then disbelief sealing hearts against understanding
candidates.normLabel: belief then disbelief sealing hearts against understanding
candidates.definition: In 63:3: That is because they believed and then they disbelieved so their hearts were sealed over and they do not understand.

candidates.label: Propped-timber exterior masking paranoia and enmity
candidates.normLabel: propped-timber exterior masking paranoia and enmity
candidates.definition: In 63:4: And when you see them their forms please you and if they speak you listen to their speech; they are as if they were pieces of wood propped up, they think every shout is against them; they are the enemy so beware of them.

candidates.label: Forgiveness permanently withheld after arrogant refusal
candidates.normLabel: forgiveness permanently withheld after arrogant refusal
candidates.definition: In 63:5-6: When it is said come the Messenger will ask forgiveness for you they turn their heads aside evading arrogantly; it is all the same whether you ask forgiveness for them or not, never will Allah forgive them, indeed Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient.

candidates.label: Economic blockade attempt exposed by divine treasury ownership
candidates.normLabel: economic blockade attempt exposed by divine treasury ownership
candidates.definition: In 63:7: They are the ones who say do not spend on those with the Messenger of Allah until they disband; and to Allah belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth but the hypocrites do not understand.

candidates.label: Honour belonging to Allah, His Messenger and believers alone
candidates.normLabel: honour belonging to allah, his messenger and believers alone
candidates.definition: In 63:8: They say if we return to al-Madinah the more honoured will surely expel the more humble; and to Allah belongs all honour and to His Messenger and to the believers but the hypocrites do not know.

candidates.label: Wealth and children as diversions from remembrance producing loss
candidates.normLabel: wealth and children as diversions from remembrance producing loss
candidates.definition: In 63:9: O you who have believed let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of Allah; and whoever does that then those are the losers.

candidates.label: Deathbed plea for delay to give charity declared impossible
candidates.normLabel: deathbed plea for delay to give charity declared impossible
candidates.definition: In 63:10-11: And spend from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says my Lord if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous; but never will Allah delay a soul when its time has come.

candidates.label: Creation producing both disbeliever and believer under divine sight
candidates.normLabel: creation producing both disbeliever and believer under divine sight
candidates.definition: In 64:2: It is He who created you and among you is the disbeliever and among you is the believer; and Allah of what you do is Seeing.

candidates.label: Earlier disbelievers rejecting human messengers and tasting consequences
candidates.normLabel: earlier disbelievers rejecting human messengers and tasting consequences
candidates.definition: In 64:5-6: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair and they will have a painful punishment; that is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences but they said shall human beings guide us and disbelieved and turned away.

candidates.label: Resurrection affirmed by oath and declared easy for Allah
candidates.normLabel: resurrection affirmed by oath and declared easy for allah
candidates.definition: In 64:7: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected; say yes by my Lord you will surely be resurrected then you will surely be informed of what you did and that for Allah is easy.

candidates.label: Day of Assembly named the Day of Deprivation (Taghabun)
candidates.normLabel: day of assembly named the day of deprivation (taghabun)
candidates.definition: In 64:9: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly, that is the Day of Deprivation.

candidates.label: No disaster striking except by Allah's permission with heart-guidance for believers
candidates.normLabel: no disaster striking except by allah's permission with heart-guidance for believers
candidates.definition: In 64:11: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah; and whoever believes in Allah He will guide his heart; and Allah is Knowing of all things.

candidates.label: Messenger's duty limited to clear notification when people turn away
candidates.normLabel: messenger's duty limited to clear notification when people turn away
candidates.definition: In 64:12: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away then upon Our Messenger is only the duty of clear notification.

candidates.label: Wives and children as potential enemies with pardon urged
candidates.normLabel: wives and children as potential enemies with pardon urged
candidates.definition: In 64:14: O you who have believed indeed among your wives and your children are enemies to you so beware of them; but if you pardon and overlook and forgive then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

candidates.label: Wealth and children as trial against great reward
candidates.normLabel: wealth and children as trial against great reward
candidates.definition: In 64:15: Your wealth and your children are but a trial and Allah has with Him a great reward.

candidates.label: Capacity-based taqwa with success for guarding against soul-stinginess
candidates.normLabel: capacity-based taqwa with success for guarding against soul-stinginess
candidates.definition: In 64:16: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend; it is better for your selves; and whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul it is those who will be the successful.

candidates.label: Goodly loan multiplied and forgiven by the Most Appreciative and Forbearing
candidates.normLabel: goodly loan multiplied and forgiven by the most appreciative and forbearing
candidates.definition: In 64:17: If you loan Allah a goodly loan He will multiply it for you and forgive you; and Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

candidates.label: Divorce at the waiting period's commencement with housing protection and limit-transgression warning
candidates.normLabel: divorce at the waiting period's commencement with housing protection and limit-transgression warning
candidates.definition: In 65:1: O Prophet when you divorce women divorce them for the commencement of their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period and fear Allah your Lord; do not turn them out of their houses nor should they leave during that period unless they are committing a clear immorality; and those are the limits set by Allah; and whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself.

candidates.label: Way out and unexpected provision for whoever fears Allah and relies upon Him
candidates.normLabel: way out and unexpected provision for whoever fears allah and relies upon him
candidates.definition: In 65:2-3: And whoever fears Allah He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect; and whoever relies upon Allah then He is sufficient for him; indeed Allah will accomplish His purpose.

candidates.label: Differentiated waiting periods for post-menopausal, non-menstruating and pregnant women
candidates.normLabel: differentiated waiting periods for post-menopausal, non-menstruating and pregnant women
candidates.definition: In 65:4: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women if you doubt then their period is three months and also for those who have not menstruated; and for those who are pregnant their term is until they give birth.

candidates.label: Capacity-based financial obligation with ease following hardship
candidates.normLabel: capacity-based financial obligation with ease following hardship
candidates.definition: In 65:7: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth and he whose provision is restricted let him spend from what Allah has given him; Allah does not charge a soul except according to what He has given it; Allah will bring about after hardship ease.

candidates.label: Insolent cities brought to severe account tasting the evil consequence of their affair
candidates.normLabel: insolent cities brought to severe account tasting the evil consequence of their affair
candidates.definition: In 65:8-9: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment; and it tasted the bad consequence of its affair and the outcome of its affair was loss.

candidates.label: Messenger reciting distinct verses bringing believers from darknesses into light
candidates.normLabel: messenger reciting distinct verses bringing believers from darknesses into light
candidates.definition: In 65:11: A Messenger reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light.

candidates.label: Seven heavens and earths with descending command demonstrating competence and comprehensive knowledge
candidates.normLabel: seven heavens and earths with descending command demonstrating competence and comprehensive knowledge
candidates.definition: In 65:12: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like of them; His command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

candidates.label: Self-prohibition of the lawful for spousal approval corrected under forgiveness
candidates.normLabel: self-prohibition of the lawful for spousal approval corrected under forgiveness
candidates.definition: In 66:1: O Prophet why do you prohibit yourself from what Allah has made lawful for you seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

candidates.label: Oath-dissolution ordained as legal relief under divine knowledge and wisdom
candidates.normLabel: oath-dissolution ordained as legal relief under divine knowledge and wisdom
candidates.definition: In 66:2: Allah has already ordained for you the dissolution of your oaths; and Allah is your protector and He is the Knowing the Wise.

candidates.label: Confidential disclosure breached and divinely revealed with partial confrontation
candidates.normLabel: confidential disclosure breached and divinely revealed with partial confrontation
candidates.definition: In 66:3: And when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement and when she informed another of it and Allah showed it to him he made known part of it and ignored a part; and when he informed her about it she said who told you this; he said I was informed by the Knowing the Acquainted.

candidates.label: Domestic opposition met by divine-angelic-believer protection network
candidates.normLabel: domestic opposition met by divine-angelic-believer protection network
candidates.definition: In 66:4: If you two repent to Allah it is best for your hearts have deviated; but if you cooperate against him then indeed Allah is his protector and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels moreover are his assistants.

candidates.label: Family protection from Fire fuelled by people and stones as believer duty
candidates.normLabel: family protection from fire fuelled by people and stones as believer duty
candidates.definition: In 66:6: O you who have believed protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones over which are angels harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

candidates.label: Sincere repentance removing misdeeds with light perfected on the Day of non-disgrace
candidates.normLabel: sincere repentance removing misdeeds with light perfected on the day of non-disgrace
candidates.definition: In 66:8: O you who have believed repent to Allah with sincere repentance; perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him; their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us indeed You are over all things competent.

candidates.label: Two disbelieving wives under righteous prophets availing nothing against Allah
candidates.normLabel: two disbelieving wives under righteous prophets availing nothing against allah
candidates.definition: In 66:10: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot; they were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all and it was said enter the Fire with those who enter.

candidates.label: Pharaoh's wife and Mary as believing-women exempla across tyranny and chastity
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh's wife and mary as believing-women exempla across tyranny and chastity
candidates.definition: In 66:11-12: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh when she said my Lord build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people; and Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity so We blew into her garment through Our angel and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

candidates.label: Death and life created as a test of best conduct
candidates.normLabel: death and life created as a test of best conduct
candidates.definition: In 67:2: He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed, and He is the Exalted in Might the Forgiving.

candidates.label: Seven layered heavens without inconsistency as cosmic sign
candidates.normLabel: seven layered heavens without inconsistency as cosmic sign
candidates.definition: In 67:3-4: He who created seven heavens in layers; you do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency; so return your vision to the sky do you see any breaks; then return your vision twice again, your vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

candidates.label: Hell's rage and keeper-interrogation exposing denial of the warner
candidates.normLabel: hell's rage and keeper-interrogation exposing denial of the warner
candidates.definition: In 67:7-9: When they are thrown into it they hear from it a dreadful inhaling while it boils up; it almost bursts with rage; every time a company is thrown into it its keepers ask them did there not come to you a warner; they will say yes a warner had come to us but we denied.

candidates.label: Regretful admission that listening or reasoning would have saved them
candidates.normLabel: regretful admission that listening or reasoning would have saved them
candidates.definition: In 67:10-11: And they will say if only we had been listening or reasoning we would not be among the companions of the Blaze; and they will admit their sin so it is alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

candidates.label: Fear of the Lord unseen earning forgiveness and great reward
candidates.normLabel: fear of the lord unseen earning forgiveness and great reward
candidates.definition: In 67:12: Indeed those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

candidates.label: Earth made tame for livelihood with provision from Him alone
candidates.normLabel: earth made tame for livelihood with provision from him alone
candidates.definition: In 67:15: It is He who made the earth tame for you so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision and to Him is the resurrection.

candidates.label: False security challenged through earthquake and stone-storm warnings
candidates.normLabel: false security challenged through earthquake and stone-storm warnings
candidates.definition: In 67:16-18: Do you feel secure that He who holds authority in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway; or do you feel secure that He who holds authority in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones; then you would know how severe was My warning; and already had those before them denied and how terrible was My reproach.

candidates.label: Birds held aloft by the Most Merciful as observable sign
candidates.normLabel: birds held aloft by the most merciful as observable sign
candidates.definition: In 67:19: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and sometimes folded in; none holds them aloft except the Most Merciful; indeed He is of all things Seeing.

candidates.label: Little gratitude despite hearing, vision and hearts
candidates.normLabel: little gratitude despite hearing, vision and hearts
candidates.definition: In 67:23: Say it is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

candidates.label: Knowledge of the Hour exclusive to Allah; Messenger only a clear warner
candidates.normLabel: knowledge of the hour exclusive to allah; messenger only a clear warner
candidates.definition: In 67:25-26: And they say when is this promise if you should be truthful; say the knowledge is only with Allah and I am only a clear warner.

candidates.label: Reliance on the Most Merciful as the believer's stance against disbeliever threats
candidates.normLabel: reliance on the most merciful as the believer's stance against disbeliever threats
candidates.definition: In 67:29: Say He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him and upon Him we have relied; and you will come to know who it is that is in clear error.

candidates.label: Water sinking as irreversible loss illustrating total dependence
candidates.normLabel: water sinking as irreversible loss illustrating total dependence
candidates.definition: In 67:30: Say have you considered if your water was to become sunken into the earth then who could bring you flowing water.

candidates.label: Pen-oath grounding prophetic sanity and great moral character
candidates.normLabel: pen-oath grounding prophetic sanity and great moral character
candidates.definition: In 68:1-4: Nun; by the pen and what they inscribe; you are not O Muhammad by the favor of your Lord a madman; and indeed for you is a reward uninterrupted; and indeed you are of a great moral character.

candidates.label: Detailed denier profile: swearer, scorner, gossip, preventer of good, cruel pretender
candidates.normLabel: detailed denier profile: swearer, scorner, gossip, preventer of good, cruel pretender
candidates.definition: In 68:10-15: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer, scorner going about with malicious gossip, a preventer of good transgressing and sinful, cruel moreover and an illegitimate pretender, because he is a possessor of wealth and children; when Our verses are recited to him he says legends of the former peoples.

candidates.label: Snout-branding as divine answer to arrogant dismissal of revelation
candidates.normLabel: snout-branding as divine answer to arrogant dismissal of revelation
candidates.definition: In 68:16: We will brand him upon the snout.

candidates.label: Garden-companions trial: oath without exception producing overnight destruction
candidates.normLabel: garden-companions trial: oath without exception producing overnight destruction
candidates.definition: In 68:17-20: Indeed We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden when they swore to cut its fruit in the early morning without making exception; so there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep and it became as though reaped.

candidates.label: Exclusion of the poor answered by total deprivation and collective repentance
candidates.normLabel: exclusion of the poor answered by total deprivation and collective repentance
candidates.definition: In 68:24-32: Saying there will surely not enter it today upon you any poor person; and they went early in determination assuming themselves able; but when they saw it they said indeed we are lost, rather we have been deprived; the most moderate said did I not say to you why do you not exalt Allah; they said exalted is our Lord indeed we were wrongdoers; then they approached one another blaming each other; they said O woe to us indeed we were transgressors; perhaps our Lord will substitute for us one better than it indeed we are toward our Lord desirous.

candidates.label: Shin uncovered with impossible prostation for those who refused when sound
candidates.normLabel: shin uncovered with impossible prostation for those who refused when sound
candidates.definition: In 68:42-43: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able; their eyes humbled humiliation will cover them and they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

candidates.label: Progressive divine leading from unknown directions during granted respite
candidates.normLabel: progressive divine leading from unknown directions during granted respite
candidates.definition: In 68:44-45: So leave Me O Muhammad with whoever denies the Quran; We will progressively lead them to punishment from where they do not know; and I will give them time indeed My plan is firm.

candidates.label: Yunus's distress and rescue as patience model for the Prophet
candidates.normLabel: yunus's distress and rescue as patience model for the prophet
candidates.definition: In 68:48-50: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord O Muhammad and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed; if not that a favor from his Lord overtook him he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured; and his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

candidates.label: Quran named a reminder to the worlds against charges of madness
candidates.normLabel: quran named a reminder to the worlds against charges of madness
candidates.definition: In 68:51-52: And indeed those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message and they say indeed he is mad; but it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

candidates.label: Thamud and Aad destroyed by blast and sustained violent wind
candidates.normLabel: thamud and aad destroyed by blast and sustained violent wind
candidates.definition: In 69:4-8: Thamud and Aad denied the Striking Calamity; so as for Thamud they were destroyed by the overpowering blast; and as for Aad they were destroyed by a screaming violent wind which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees; then do you see of them any remains.

candidates.label: Flood deliverance made a reminder for a conscious ear
candidates.normLabel: flood deliverance made a reminder for a conscious ear
candidates.definition: In 69:11-12: Indeed when the water overflowed We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship that We might make it for you a reminder and that a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

candidates.label: Single Horn blast levelling creation with eight bearing the Throne
candidates.normLabel: single horn blast levelling creation with eight bearing the throne
candidates.definition: In 69:13-17: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast and the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow then on that Day the Resurrection will occur; and the heaven will split open for that Day it is infirm; and the angels are at its edges and there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them that Day eight of them.

candidates.label: Right-hand record received with certainty-driven joy and elevated garden
candidates.normLabel: right-hand record received with certainty-driven joy and elevated garden
candidates.definition: In 69:19-24: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand he will say here read my record; indeed I was certain that I would be meeting my account; so he will be in a pleasant life in an elevated garden its fruit to be picked hanging near; eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past.

candidates.label: Left-hand record producing regret with wealth and authority失效
candidates.normLabel: left-hand record producing regret with wealth and authority失效
candidates.definition: In 69:25-29: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand he will say oh I wish I had not been given my record and had not known what is my account; I wish my death had been the decisive one; my wealth has not availed me; gone from me is my authority.

candidates.label: Disbelief and neglect of feeding the poor as joint grounds for the chain
candidates.normLabel: disbelief and neglect of feeding the poor as joint grounds for the chain
candidates.definition: In 69:30-34: Seize him and shackle him then into Hellfire drive him then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him; indeed he did not used to believe in Allah the Most Great nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

candidates.label: Seen-unseen oath establishing the Quran as a noble Messenger's word
candidates.normLabel: seen-unseen oath establishing the quran as a noble messenger's word
candidates.definition: In 69:38-43: So I swear by what you see and what you do not see; indeed the Quran is the word of a noble Messenger; and it is not the word of a poet little do you believe; nor the word of a soothsayer little do you remember; it is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

candidates.label: Fabrication counterfactual guaranteeing prophetic authenticity
candidates.normLabel: fabrication counterfactual guaranteeing prophetic authenticity
candidates.definition: In 69:44-47: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some false sayings We would have seized him by the right hand then We would have cut from him the aorta and there is no one of you who could prevent Us from him.

candidates.label: Quran as reminder for the righteous and truth of certainty
candidates.normLabel: quran as reminder for the righteous and truth of certainty
candidates.definition: In 69:48-52: And indeed the Quran is a reminder for the righteous; and indeed We know that among you are deniers; and indeed it will be a cause of regret upon the disbelievers; and indeed it is the truth of certainty; so exalt the name of your Lord the Most Great.

candidates.label: Angelic ascent during a Day measuring fifty thousand years
candidates.normLabel: angelic ascent during a day measuring fifty thousand years
candidates.definition: In 70:3-4: It is from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent; the angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

candidates.label: Gracious patience commanded against perceiving the reckoning as distant
candidates.normLabel: gracious patience commanded against perceiving the reckoning as distant
candidates.definition: In 70:5-7: So be patient with gracious patience; indeed they see it as distant but We see it as near.

candidates.label: Criminal wishing to ransom himself with kin and all humanity
candidates.normLabel: criminal wishing to ransom himself with kin and all humanity
candidates.definition: In 70:10-14: And no friend will ask anything of a friend; they will be shown each other; the criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children and his wife and his brother and his nearest kindred who shelter him and whoever is on earth entirely so then it could save him.

candidates.label: The Flame stripping exteriors and summoning the hoarding turncoat
candidates.normLabel: the flame stripping exteriors and summoning the hoarding turncoat
candidates.definition: In 70:15-18: No indeed it is the Flame of Hell, a remover of exteriors; it invites he who turned his back on truth and went away from obedience and collected wealth and hoarded.

candidates.label: Anxious human nature exempted by constancy in prayer
candidates.normLabel: anxious human nature exempted by constancy in prayer
candidates.definition: In 70:19-23: Indeed mankind was created anxious; when evil touches him impatient and when good touches him withholding; except the observers of prayer, those who are constant in their prayer.

candidates.label: A known right within wealth for the petitioner and the deprived
candidates.normLabel: a known right within wealth for the petitioner and the deprived
candidates.definition: In 70:24-25: And those within whose wealth is a known right for the petitioner and the deprived.

candidates.label: Chastity within lawful bounds with transgression named beyond it
candidates.normLabel: chastity within lawful bounds with transgression named beyond it
candidates.definition: In 70:29-31: And those who guard their private parts except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed they are not to be blamed; but whoever seeks beyond that then they are the transgressors.

candidates.label: Trusts, promises and upright testimony completing the virtue profile
candidates.normLabel: trusts, promises and upright testimony completing the virtue profile
candidates.definition: In 70:32-35: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive and those who are in their testimonies upright and those who carefully maintain their prayer; they will be in gardens, honored.

candidates.label: Garden aspiration refused with replacement oath by the Lord of risings
candidates.normLabel: garden aspiration refused with replacement oath by the lord of risings
candidates.definition: In 70:38-41: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure? No indeed We have created them from that which they know; so I swear by the Lord of all risings and settings that indeed We are able to replace them with better than them and We are not to be outdone.

candidates.label: Grave-emergence likened to hastening toward an erected idol
candidates.normLabel: grave-emergence likened to hastening toward an erected idol
candidates.definition: In 70:43-44: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were toward an erected idol hastening; their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them; that is the Day which they had been promised.

candidates.label: Noah's threefold message of worship, taqwa and obedience with undelayable term
candidates.normLabel: noah's threefold message of worship, taqwa and obedience with undelayable term
candidates.definition: In 71:2-4: He said O my people indeed I am to you a clear warner, saying worship Allah fear Him and obey me; Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term; indeed the time set by Allah when it comes will not be delayed if you only knew.

candidates.label: Escalating da'wah methods met with physical rejection postures
candidates.normLabel: escalating da'wah methods met with physical rejection postures
candidates.definition: In 71:5-9: My Lord indeed I invited my people night and day but my invitation increased them not except in flight; and indeed every time I invited them that You may forgive them they put their fingers in their ears covered themselves with their garments persisted and were arrogant with great arrogance; then I invited them publicly; then I announced to them and also confided to them secretly.

candidates.label: Istighfar linked to rain, wealth, children, gardens and rivers
candidates.normLabel: istighfar linked to rain, wealth, children, gardens and rivers
candidates.definition: In 71:10-12: Ask forgiveness of your Lord indeed He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver; He will send rain from the sky upon you in continuing showers and give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

candidates.label: Staged creation and layered heavens as grounds for attributing grandeur
candidates.normLabel: staged creation and layered heavens as grounds for attributing grandeur
candidates.definition: In 71:13-18: What is the matter with you that you do not attribute to Allah due grandeur while He has created you in stages; do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers and made the moon therein a reflected light and made the sun a burning lamp; and Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a progressive growth then He will return you into it and extract you another extraction.

candidates.label: Five named idols preserved through immense conspiracy
candidates.normLabel: five named idols preserved through immense conspiracy
candidates.definition: In 71:22-23: And they conspired an immense conspiracy and said never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa or Yaghuth and Yauq and Nasr.

candidates.label: Drowning followed by the Fire with no helpers besides Allah
candidates.normLabel: drowning followed by the fire with no helpers besides allah
candidates.definition: In 71:25: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire and they found not for themselves besides Allah any helpers.

candidates.label: Comprehensive supplication for self, parents, household and all believers
candidates.normLabel: comprehensive supplication for self, parents, household and all believers
candidates.definition: In 71:28: My Lord forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.

candidates.label: Jinn hearing the Quran, believing and embracing tawheed
candidates.normLabel: jinn hearing the quran, believing and embracing tawheed
candidates.definition: In 72:1-3: Say O Muhammad it has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said indeed we have heard an amazing Quran; it guides to the right course and we have believed in it and we will never associate with our Lord anyone; and that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord He has not taken a wife or a son.

candidates.label: Human-jinn refuge-seeking increasing burden rather than providing protection
candidates.normLabel: human-jinn refuge-seeking increasing burden rather than providing protection
candidates.definition: In 72:6: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn so they only increased them in burden.

candidates.label: Heaven sealed against eavesdropping with guards and flames
candidates.normLabel: heaven sealed against eavesdropping with guards and flames
candidates.definition: In 72:8-9: And we have sought to reach the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames; and we used to sit therein in positions for hearing but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

candidates.label: Jinn community internally divided between righteous and unjust
candidates.normLabel: jinn community internally divided between righteous and unjust
candidates.definition: In 72:11-15: And among us are the righteous and among us are others not so we were of divided ways; and we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth nor can we escape Him by flight; and when we heard the guidance we believed in it and whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden; and among us are Muslims in submission to Allah and among us are the unjust and whoever has become Muslim those have sought out the right course; but as for the unjust they will be for Hell firewood.

candidates.label: Istiqamah producing abundant provision as a divine test
candidates.normLabel: istiqamah producing abundant provision as a divine test
candidates.definition: In 72:16: And that if they had remained straight on the way We would have given them abundant provision.

candidates.label: Masjid purity: invocation belongs to Allah alone
candidates.normLabel: masjid purity: invocation belongs to allah alone
candidates.definition: In 72:18: And that the masjids are for Allah so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

candidates.label: Prophetic limitation: no harm, no guidance, no refuge besides Allah
candidates.normLabel: prophetic limitation: no harm, no guidance, no refuge besides allah
candidates.definition: In 72:21-23: Say indeed I do not possess for you the power of harm or right direction; say indeed there will never protect me from Allah anyone if I should disobey nor will I find in other than Him a refuge; but I have for you only notification from Allah and His messages.

candidates.label: Unseen disclosed only to approved messengers under observation
candidates.normLabel: unseen disclosed only to approved messengers under observation
candidates.definition: In 72:26-28: He is Knower of the unseen and He does not disclose His knowledge of the unseen to anyone except whom He has approved of messengers and indeed He sends before each messenger and behind him observers that he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

candidates.label: Night prayer with measured recitation preparing for the heavy word
candidates.normLabel: night prayer with measured recitation preparing for the heavy word
candidates.definition: In 73:2-5: Arise to pray the night except for a little; half of it or subtract from it a little or add to it and recite the Quran with measured recitation; indeed We will cast upon you a heavy word.

candidates.label: Night hours more effective for heart-tongue concurrence than daytime occupation
candidates.normLabel: night hours more effective for heart-tongue concurrence than daytime occupation
candidates.definition: In 73:6-7: Indeed the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence of heart and tongue and more suitable for words; indeed for you by day is prolonged occupation.

candidates.label: Complete devotion to the Lord of east and west as sole disposer
candidates.normLabel: complete devotion to the lord of east and west as sole disposer
candidates.definition: In 73:8-9: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with complete devotion; He is the Lord of the East and the West there is no deity except Him so take Him as Disposer of your affairs.

candidates.label: Gracious avoidance of deniers while leaving their matter to Allah
candidates.normLabel: gracious avoidance of deniers while leaving their matter to allah
candidates.definition: In 73:10-11: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance; and leave Me with the matter of the deniers those of ease in life and allow them respite a little.

candidates.label: Pharaoh parallel: messenger-witness met with disobedience and ruinous seizure
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh parallel: messenger-witness met with disobedience and ruinous seizure
candidates.definition: In 73:15-16: Indeed We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger; but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

candidates.label: Divine easing of night prayer due to illness, travel and fighting
candidates.normLabel: divine easing of night prayer due to illness, travel and fighting
candidates.definition: In 73:20: Indeed your Lord knows O Muhammad that you stand in prayer almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it and so do a group of those with you; and Allah determines the night and the day; He has known that you Muslims will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness so recite what is easy for you of the Quran; He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking something of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah; so recite what is easy from it.

candidates.label: Standing obligations reaffirmed after concession: prayer, zakah, goodly loan
candidates.normLabel: standing obligations reaffirmed after concession: prayer, zakah, goodly loan
candidates.definition: In 73:20: And establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan; and whatever good you put forward for yourselves you will find it with Allah; it is better and greater in reward; and seek forgiveness of Allah indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

candidates.label: Five-fold prophetic commission: arise, warn, glorify, purify, avoid impurity
candidates.normLabel: five-fold prophetic commission: arise, warn, glorify, purify, avoid impurity
candidates.definition: In 74:1-5: O you who covers himself with a garment; arise and warn; and your Lord glorify; and your clothing purify; and uncleanliness avoid.

candidates.label: Favour-conferring prohibited; patience for the Lord commanded instead
candidates.normLabel: favour-conferring prohibited; patience for the lord commanded instead
candidates.definition: In 74:6-7: And do not confer favor to acquire more; but for your Lord be patient.

candidates.label: Bounty recipient demanding more while obstinate toward verses
candidates.normLabel: bounty recipient demanding more while obstinate toward verses
candidates.definition: In 74:11-16: Leave Me with the one I created alone and to whom I granted extensive wealth and children present with him and spread everything before him easing his life; then he desires that I should add more; no indeed he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

candidates.label: Deliberation producing dismissal as magic or human speech, cursed twice
candidates.normLabel: deliberation producing dismissal as magic or human speech, cursed twice
candidates.definition: In 74:18-25: Indeed he thought and deliberated; so may he be destroyed for how he deliberated; then may he be destroyed for how he deliberated; then he considered again; then he frowned and scowled; then he turned back and was arrogant; and said this is not but magic imitated from others; this is not but the word of a human being.

candidates.label: Saqar leaving nothing unburned with nineteen angel-keepers as trial
candidates.normLabel: saqar leaving nothing unburned with nineteen angel-keepers as trial
candidates.definition: In 74:26-31: I will drive him into Saqar; and what can make you know what is Saqar; it lets nothing remain and leaves nothing unburned; blackening the skins; over it are nineteen angels; and We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels and We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve.

candidates.label: Criminal confession: no prayer, no feeding, vain discourse, denial until certainty
candidates.normLabel: criminal confession: no prayer, no feeding, vain discourse, denial until certainty
candidates.definition: In 74:42-47: Asking them what put you into Saqar; they will say we were not of those who prayed; nor did we used to feed the poor; and we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged in it; and we used to deny the Day of Recompense; until there came to us the certainty.

candidates.label: Intercession nullified after certainty arrives
candidates.normLabel: intercession nullified after certainty arrives
candidates.definition: In 74:48: So there will not benefit them the intercession of any intercessors.

candidates.label: Quran as reminder remembered only by Allah's will
candidates.normLabel: quran as reminder remembered only by allah's will
candidates.definition: In 74:54-56: No indeed the Quran is a reminder; then whoever wills will remember it; and they will not remember except that Allah wills; He is worthy of fear and adequate for granting forgiveness.

candidates.label: Bone reassembly and fingertip proportioning proving resurrection power
candidates.normLabel: bone reassembly and fingertip proportioning proving resurrection power
candidates.definition: In 75:3-4: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones? Yes We are able even to proportion his fingertips.

candidates.label: Reproaching soul sworn by alongside the Day of Resurrection
candidates.normLabel: reproaching soul sworn by alongside the day of resurrection
candidates.definition: In 75:1-2: I swear by the Day of Resurrection and I swear by the reproaching soul to the certainty of resurrection.

candidates.label: Cosmic dissolution producing the futile escape question
candidates.normLabel: cosmic dissolution producing the futile escape question
candidates.definition: In 75:7-12: So when vision is dazzled and the moon darkens and the sun and the moon are joined; man will say on that Day where is the place of escape; no there is no refuge; to your Lord that Day is the place of permanence.

candidates.label: Quran collection, recitation and clarification guaranteed by Allah
candidates.normLabel: quran collection, recitation and clarification guaranteed by allah
candidates.definition: In 75:16-19: Move not your tongue with it to hasten with recitation of the Quran; indeed upon Us is its collection in your heart and to make possible its recitation; so when We have recited it through Gabriel then follow its recitation; then upon Us is its clarification to you.

candidates.label: Radiant faces looking at their Lord versus contorted faces expecting backbreaking
candidates.normLabel: radiant faces looking at their lord versus contorted faces expecting backbreaking
candidates.definition: In 75:22-25: Some faces that Day will be radiant looking at their Lord; and some faces that Day will be contorted expecting that there will be done to them something backbreaking.

candidates.label: Deathbed sequence: collar bones, no cure, separation certainty, leg-wound
candidates.normLabel: deathbed sequence: collar bones, no cure, separation certainty, leg-wound
candidates.definition: In 75:26-30: No when the soul has reached the collar bones and it is said who will cure him; and the dying one is certain that it is the time of separation; and the leg is wound about the leg; to your Lord that Day will be the procession.

candidates.label: Denial, prayer neglect and swaggering pride earning repeated woe
candidates.normLabel: denial, prayer neglect and swaggering pride earning repeated woe
candidates.definition: In 75:31-35: And the disbeliever had not believed nor had he prayed; but instead he denied and turned away; and then he went to his people swaggering in pride; woe to you and woe; then woe to you and woe.

candidates.label: Embryological progression arguing resurrection ability
candidates.normLabel: embryological progression arguing resurrection ability
candidates.definition: In 75:36-40: Does man think that he will be left neglected; had he not been a sperm from semen emitted; then he was a clinging clot and Allah created his form and proportioned him; and made of him two mates the male and the female; is not that Creator able to give life to the dead.

candidates.label: Creation from sperm-drop mixture for trial with hearing and sight
candidates.normLabel: creation from sperm-drop mixture for trial with hearing and sight
candidates.definition: In 76:1-2: Has there not come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing even mentioned; indeed We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him and We made him hearing and seeing.

candidates.label: Guidance offered leaving humanity divided between gratitude and ingratitude
candidates.normLabel: guidance offered leaving humanity divided between gratitude and ingratitude
candidates.definition: In 76:3: Indeed We guided him to the way be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

candidates.label: Selfless feeding for Allah's countenance alone without expecting return
candidates.normLabel: selfless feeding for allah's countenance alone without expecting return
candidates.definition: In 76:8-10: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy the orphan and the captive; saying we feed you only for the countenance of Allah we wish not from you reward or gratitude; indeed We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful.

candidates.label: Kafur spring, Salsabeel fountain and eternal youths as Paradise provisions
candidates.normLabel: kafur spring, salsabeel fountain and eternal youths as paradise provisions
candidates.definition: In 76:5-6,17-19: Indeed the righteous will drink from a cup of wine whose mixture is of Kafur; a spring of which the servants of Allah will drink they will make it gush forth in force and abundance; and they will be given to drink a cup of wine whose mixture is of ginger from a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel; there will circulate among them young boys made eternal when you see them you would think them as beautiful as scattered pearls.

candidates.label: Earned reward declared after patient endurance
candidates.normLabel: earned reward declared after patient endurance
candidates.definition: In 76:22: And it will be said indeed this is for you a reward and your effort has been appreciated.

candidates.label: Progressive Quran revelation with patience and worship commands
candidates.normLabel: progressive quran revelation with patience and worship commands
candidates.definition: In 76:23-26: Indeed it is We who have sent down to you O Muhammad the Quran progressively; so be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful disbeliever; and mention the name of your Lord morning and evening; and during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long part of the night.

candidates.label: Human willing nested under divine will with knowledge and wisdom
candidates.normLabel: human willing nested under divine will with knowledge and wisdom
candidates.definition: In 76:29-31: Indeed this is a reminder so he who wills may take to his Lord a way; and you do not will except that Allah wills indeed Allah is ever Knowing and Wise; He admits whom He wills into His mercy but the wrongdoers He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

candidates.label: Five-fold oath by winds and angels guaranteeing the promised Day
candidates.normLabel: five-fold oath by winds and angels guaranteeing the promised day
candidates.definition: In 77:1-7: By those winds sent forth in gusts and the winds that blow violently and the winds that spread clouds and those angels who bring criterion and those angels who deliver a message as justification or warning; indeed what you are promised is to occur.

candidates.label: Cosmic dissolution sequence preceding the Day of Judgement
candidates.normLabel: cosmic dissolution sequence preceding the day of judgement
candidates.definition: In 77:8-14: So when the stars are obliterated and when the heaven is opened and when the mountains are blown away and when the messengers' time has come; for what Day was it postponed; for the Day of Judgement; and what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement.

candidates.label: Destruction of former and later peoples as the criminal-dealing pattern
candidates.normLabel: destruction of former and later peoples as the criminal-dealing pattern
candidates.definition: In 77:16-19: Did We not destroy the former peoples; then We will follow them with the later ones; thus do We deal with the criminals; woe that Day to the deniers.

candidates.label: Embryological creation from disdained liquid in firm lodging for known extent
candidates.normLabel: embryological creation from disdained liquid in firm lodging for known extent
candidates.definition: In 77:20-24: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained; and We placed it in a firm lodging; for a known extent; and We determined it and excellent are We to determine.

candidates.label: Earth as container for living and dead with mountains and sweet water
candidates.normLabel: earth as container for living and dead with mountains and sweet water
candidates.definition: In 77:25-28: Have We not made the earth a container of the living and the dead; and We placed therein lofty firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water; woe that Day to the deniers.

candidates.label: Three-columned smoke-shadow with fortress-sized sparks as punishment environment
candidates.normLabel: three-columned smoke-shadow with fortress-sized sparks as punishment environment
candidates.definition: In 77:29-34: Proceed to that which you used to deny; proceed to a shadow of smoke having three columns; no cool shade and availing not against the flame; indeed it throws sparks as huge as a fortress as if they were yellowish black camels.

candidates.label: Speechlessness and excuse-prohibition on the assembly Day
candidates.normLabel: speechlessness and excuse-prohibition on the assembly day
candidates.definition: In 77:35-37: This is a Day they will not speak; nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse; woe that Day to the deniers.

candidates.label: Righteous rewarded with shades, springs and desired fruits for their deeds
candidates.normLabel: righteous rewarded with shades, springs and desired fruits for their deeds
candidates.definition: In 77:41-44: Indeed the righteous will be among shades and springs and fruits from whatever they desire; being told eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do; indeed We thus reward the doers of good.

candidates.label: Closing challenge: no statement after the Quran warrants belief
candidates.normLabel: closing challenge: no statement after the quran warrants belief
candidates.definition: In 77:50: Then in what statement after the Quran will they believe.

candidates.label: Great news disputed but doubly certain to be known
candidates.normLabel: great news disputed but doubly certain to be known
candidates.definition: In 78:1-5: About what are they asking one another; about the great news; that over which they are in disagreement; no they are going to know; then no they are going to know.

candidates.label: Cosmic provisions: resting earth, stake-mountains, paired creation, sleep-night-day cycle
candidates.normLabel: cosmic provisions: resting earth, stake-mountains, paired creation, sleep-night-day cycle
candidates.definition: In 78:6-11: Have We not made the earth a resting place and the mountains as stakes; and We created you in pairs; and We made your sleep a means for rest; and We made the night as clothing; and We made the day for livelihood.

candidates.label: Rain-driven agriculture producing grain, vegetation and entwined gardens
candidates.normLabel: rain-driven agriculture producing grain, vegetation and entwined gardens
candidates.definition: In 78:14-16: And We sent down from the rain clouds pouring water that We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation and gardens of entwined growth.

candidates.label: Hell lying in wait as transgressors' unending return with scalding-purulence drink
candidates.normLabel: hell lying in wait as transgressors' unending return with scalding-purulence drink
candidates.definition: In 78:21-26: Indeed Hell has been lying in wait for the transgressors a place of return; in which they will remain for ages unending; they will not taste therein any coolness or drink except scalding water and foul purulence; an appropriate recompense.

candidates.label: Emphatic denial and unexpecting account met with enumerated writing
candidates.normLabel: emphatic denial and unexpecting account met with enumerated writing
candidates.definition: In 78:27-30: Indeed they were not expecting an account and denied Our verses with emphatic denial; but We have enumerated everything in writing; so taste the penalty and never will We increase you except in torment.

candidates.label: Righteous attainment: gardens, companions, full cup and pure speech as accounted gift
candidates.normLabel: righteous attainment: gardens, companions, full cup and pure speech as accounted gift
candidates.definition: In 78:31-36: Indeed for the righteous is attainment; gardens and grapevines and full-breasted companions of equal age and a full cup; no ill speech will they hear therein or falsehood; reward from your Lord a generous gift made due by account.

candidates.label: Spirit and angels in rows with restricted speech on the True Day
candidates.normLabel: spirit and angels in rows with restricted speech on the true day
candidates.definition: In 78:38-39: On the Day the Spirit and the angels will stand in row they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits and he has said what is correct; that is the True Day so whoever wills should take to his Lord a way of return.

candidates.label: Impending punishment producing self-observation and the dust-wish
candidates.normLabel: impending punishment producing self-observation and the dust-wish
candidates.definition: In 78:40: Indeed We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say oh I wish that I were dust.

candidates.label: Five-fold angelic oath grounding resurrection certainty
candidates.normLabel: five-fold angelic oath grounding resurrection certainty
candidates.definition: In 79:1-5: By those angels who extract with violence and those who remove with ease and those who glide as if swimming and those who race each other in a race and those who arrange each matter.

candidates.label: Twin blasts producing trembling hearts and humbled eyes
candidates.normLabel: twin blasts producing trembling hearts and humbled eyes
candidates.definition: In 79:6-9: On the Day the blast of the Horn will convulse creation there will follow it the subsequent one; hearts that Day will tremble; their eyes humbled.

candidates.label: Denial of resurrection from decayed bones answered by one-shout emergence
candidates.normLabel: denial of resurrection from decayed bones answered by one-shout emergence
candidates.definition: In 79:10-14: They are presently saying will we indeed be returned to our former state of life even if we should be decayed bones; they say that then would be a losing return; indeed it will be but one shout and suddenly they will be alert upon the earth's surface.

candidates.label: Moses commissioned in Tuwa with purification invitation and greatest sign
candidates.normLabel: moses commissioned in tuwa with purification invitation and greatest sign
candidates.definition: In 79:15-20: Has there reached you the story of Moses when his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa; go to Pharaoh indeed he has transgressed; and say to him would you purify yourself and let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear Him; and he showed him the greatest sign.

candidates.label: Pharaoh's false lordship claim answered by exemplary punishment
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh's false lordship claim answered by exemplary punishment
candidates.definition: In 79:21-26: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed then he turned his back striving and he gathered his people and called out and said I am your most exalted lord; so Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first transgression; indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear Allah.

candidates.label: Creation comparison: heaven-construction proving resurrection ability
candidates.normLabel: creation comparison: heaven-construction proving resurrection ability
candidates.definition: In 79:27-33: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it; He raised its ceiling and proportioned it and He darkened its night and extracted its brightness; and after that He spread the earth; He extracted from it its water and its pasture and the mountains He set firmly as provision for you and your grazing livestock.

candidates.label: Two refuges: Hellfire for transgressor, Paradise for self-restrainer
candidates.normLabel: two refuges: hellfire for transgressor, paradise for self-restrainer
candidates.definition: In 79:37-41: So as for he who transgressed and preferred the life of the world then indeed Hellfire will be his refuge; but as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from unlawful inclination then indeed Paradise will be his refuge.

candidates.label: Hour's timing with Allah alone; Prophet only a warner; time compression on arrival
candidates.normLabel: hour's timing with allah alone; prophet only a warner; time compression on arrival
candidates.definition: In 79:42-46: They ask you O Muhammad about the Hour when is its arrival; in what position are you that you should mention it; to your Lord is its finality; you are only a warner for those who fear it; it will be on the Day they see it as though they had not remained except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

candidates.label: Prophetic correction: blind seeker prioritised over self-sufficient elite
candidates.normLabel: prophetic correction: blind seeker prioritised over self-sufficient elite
candidates.definition: In 80:1-10: The Prophet frowned and turned away because there came to him the blind man interrupting; but what would make you perceive O Muhammad that perhaps he might be purified or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him; as for he who thinks himself without need to him you give attention and not upon you is any blame if he will not be purified; but as for he who came to you striving for knowledge while he fears Allah from him you are distracted.

candidates.label: Revelation as reminder in honoured sheets carried by noble angels
candidates.normLabel: revelation as reminder in honoured sheets carried by noble angels
candidates.definition: In 80:11-16: No indeed these verses are a reminder so whoever wills may remember it; recorded in honoured sheets exalted and purified carried by the hands of messenger-angels noble and dutiful.

candidates.label: Human ingratitude cursed despite creation-ease-death-resurrection arc
candidates.normLabel: human ingratitude cursed despite creation-ease-death-resurrection arc
candidates.definition: In 80:17-23: Cursed is man how disbelieving is he; from what substance did He create him; from a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him; then He eased the way for him; then He causes his death and provides a grave for him; then when He wills He will resurrect him; no man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

candidates.label: Agricultural provision chain as observable sign of divine sustenance
candidates.normLabel: agricultural provision chain as observable sign of divine sustenance
candidates.definition: In 80:24-32: Then let mankind look at his food; how We poured down water in torrents then We broke open the earth splitting it with sprouts and caused to grow within it grain and grapes and herbage and olive and palm trees and gardens of dense shrubbery and fruit and grass as enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

candidates.label: Deafening Blast producing flight from all kin and total self-preoccupation
candidates.normLabel: deafening blast producing flight from all kin and total self-preoccupation
candidates.definition: In 80:33-37: But when there comes the Deafening Blast on the Day a man will flee from his brother and his mother and his father and his wife and his children; for every man that Day will be a matter adequate for him.

candidates.label: Bright rejoicing faces versus dust-covered darkened faces marking belief status
candidates.normLabel: bright rejoicing faces versus dust-covered darkened faces marking belief status
candidates.definition: In 80:38-42: Some faces that Day will be bright laughing rejoicing at good news; and other faces that Day will have upon them dust blackness will cover them; those are the disbelievers the wicked ones.

candidates.label: Twelve-fold cosmic dissolution culminating in soul self-knowledge
candidates.normLabel: twelve-fold cosmic dissolution culminating in soul self-knowledge
candidates.definition: In 81:1-14: When the sun is wrapped up in darkness and when the stars fall dispersing and when the mountains are removed and when full-term she-camels are neglected and when the wild beasts are gathered and when the seas are filled with flame and when the souls are paired and when the girl who was buried alive is asked for what sin she was killed and when the pages are made public and when the sky is stripped away and when Hellfire is set ablaze and when Paradise is brought near; a soul will then know what it has brought with it.

candidates.label: Female infanticide subjected to divine interrogation
candidates.normLabel: female infanticide subjected to divine interrogation
candidates.definition: In 81:8-9: And when the girl who was buried alive is asked for what sin she was killed.

candidates.label: Star-night-dawn oaths establishing the noble messenger's conveyance
candidates.normLabel: star-night-dawn oaths establishing the noble messenger's conveyance
candidates.definition: In 81:15-21: So I swear by the retreating stars, those that run their courses and disappear, and by the night as it closes in and by the dawn when it breathes; indeed the Quran is a word conveyed by a noble messenger possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne secure in position, obeyed there in the heavens and trustworthy.

candidates.label: Prophetic sanity, direct Gabriel-vision and no withholding of unseen
candidates.normLabel: prophetic sanity, direct gabriel-vision and no withholding of unseen
candidates.definition: In 81:22-25: And your companion is not at all mad and he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon and Muhammad is not a withholder of knowledge of the unseen and the Quran is not the word of a devil expelled from the heavens.

candidates.label: Reminder to the worlds with human will nested under divine will
candidates.normLabel: reminder to the worlds with human will nested under divine will
candidates.definition: In 81:26-29: So where are you going; it is not except a reminder to the worlds for whoever wills among you to take a right course; and you do not will except that Allah wills, Lord of the worlds.

candidates.label: Four-fold dissolution ending in soul-knowledge of forwarded and withheld deeds
