candidates.normLabel: four-fold dissolution ending in soul-knowledge of forwarded and withheld deeds
candidates.definition: In 82:1-5: When the sky breaks apart and when the stars fall scattering and when the seas are erupted and when the contents of graves are scattered; a soul will then know what it has put forth and kept back.

candidates.label: Deception concerning the Generous Lord who created, proportioned and balanced
candidates.normLabel: deception concerning the generous lord who created, proportioned and balanced
candidates.definition: In 82:6-8: O mankind what has deceived you concerning your Lord the Generous who created you proportioned you and balanced you; in whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

candidates.label: Noble recording keepers appointed despite denial of Recompense
candidates.normLabel: noble recording keepers appointed despite denial of recompense
candidates.definition: In 82:9-12: No but you deny the Recompense; and indeed appointed over you are keepers noble and recording; they know whatever you do.

candidates.label: Righteous in pleasure versus wicked burning without absence
candidates.normLabel: righteous in pleasure versus wicked burning without absence
candidates.definition: In 82:13-16: Indeed the righteous will be in pleasure and indeed the wicked will be in Hellfire; they will enter to burn therein on the Day of Recompense and never therefrom will they be absent.

candidates.label: No soul possessing power for another; command entirely with Allah
candidates.normLabel: no soul possessing power for another; command entirely with allah
candidates.definition: In 82:17-19: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense; then what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense; it is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul power to do a thing and the command that Day is entirely with Allah.

candidates.label: Commercial fraud condemned: full measure taken, loss given
candidates.normLabel: commercial fraud condemned: full measure taken, loss given
candidates.definition: In 83:1-6: Woe to those who give less than due; who when they take a measure from people take in full but if they give by measure or by weight to them they cause loss; do they not think that they will be resurrected for a tremendous Day, the Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds.

candidates.label: Sijjeen as the inscribed register of the wicked
candidates.normLabel: sijjeen as the inscribed register of the wicked
candidates.definition: In 83:7-9: No indeed the record of the wicked is in sijjeen; and what can make you know what is sijjeen; it is a register inscribed.

candidates.label: Heart-stain from earnings producing partition from the Lord
candidates.normLabel: heart-stain from earnings producing partition from the lord
candidates.definition: In 83:14-17: No rather the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning; no indeed from their Lord that Day they will be partitioned; then indeed they will enter and burn in Hellfire; then it will be said this is what you used to deny.

candidates.label: Illiyyun witnessed by the near ones with sealed musk-finished wine
candidates.normLabel: illiyyun witnessed by the near ones with sealed musk-finished wine
candidates.definition: In 83:18-28: No indeed the record of the righteous is in illiyyun; and what can make you know what is illiyyun; it is a register inscribed which is witnessed by those brought near; indeed the righteous will be in pleasure on adorned couches observing; you will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure; they will be given to drink pure wine which was sealed, the last of it is musk so for this let the competitors compete; and its mixture is of Tasneem, a spring from which those near drink.

candidates.label: Criminal mockery of believers reversed on the Day
candidates.normLabel: criminal mockery of believers reversed on the day
candidates.definition: In 83:29-36: Indeed those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed and when they passed by them they would exchange derisive glances and when they returned to their people they would return jesting and when they saw them they would say indeed those are truly lost; but they had not been sent as guardians over them; so Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers on adorned couches observing; have the disbelievers not been rewarded this Day for what they used to do.

candidates.label: Sky and earth responding to their Lord as obligated at dissolution
candidates.normLabel: sky and earth responding to their lord as obligated at dissolution
candidates.definition: In 84:1-5: When the sky has split open and has responded to its Lord and was obligated to do so; and when the earth has been extended and has cast out that within it and relinquished it and has responded to its Lord and was obligated to do so.

candidates.label: Human life as exerted labour toward the Lord that will be met
candidates.normLabel: human life as exerted labour toward the lord that will be met
candidates.definition: In 84:6: O mankind indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with great exertion and will meet it.

candidates.label: Record position determining easy account or cry for destruction
candidates.normLabel: record position determining easy account or cry for destruction
candidates.definition: In 84:7-12: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand he will be judged with an easy account and return to his people in happiness; but as for he who is given his record behind his back he will cry out for destruction and enter to burn in a Blaze.

candidates.label: Assumption of no return corrected by the Lord's constant sight
candidates.normLabel: assumption of no return corrected by the lord's constant sight
candidates.definition: In 84:13-15: Indeed he had once been among his people in happiness; indeed he had thought he would never return to Allah; but yes indeed his Lord was ever of him Seeing.

candidates.label: Twilight-night-moon oaths establishing successive states
candidates.normLabel: twilight-night-moon oaths establishing successive states
candidates.definition: In 84:16-19: So I swear by the twilight glow and by the night and what it envelops and by the moon when it becomes full; that you will surely experience state after state.

candidates.label: Prostration refusal at recitation with uninterrupted reward for believers
candidates.normLabel: prostration refusal at recitation with uninterrupted reward for believers
candidates.definition: In 84:20-25: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe and when the Quran is recited to them they do not prostrate; but those who have disbelieved deny and Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves; so give them tidings of a painful punishment except for those who believe and do righteous deeds for them is a reward uninterrupted.

candidates.label: Companions of the trench cursed for burning believers
candidates.normLabel: companions of the trench cursed for burning believers
candidates.definition: In 85:4-7: Cursed were the companions of the trench containing the fire full of fuel; when they were sitting near it and they to what they were doing against the believers were witnesses.

candidates.label: Resentment grounded solely in belief in the Mighty Praiseworthy
candidates.normLabel: resentment grounded solely in belief in the mighty praiseworthy
candidates.definition: In 85:8-9: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah the Exalted in Might the Praiseworthy, to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and Allah over all things is Witness.

candidates.label: Unrepented torture of believers answered by Hell and the Burning Fire
candidates.normLabel: unrepented torture of believers answered by hell and the burning fire
candidates.definition: In 85:10: Indeed those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

candidates.label: Severe vengeance alongside origination, repetition, forgiveness and affection
candidates.normLabel: severe vengeance alongside origination, repetition, forgiveness and affection
candidates.definition: In 85:12-16: Indeed the vengeance of your Lord is severe; indeed it is He who originates creation and repeats; and He is the Forgiving the Affectionate, Honorable Owner of the Throne, Effecter of what He intends.

candidates.label: Pharaoh and Thamud as precedent with divine encompassment from behind
candidates.normLabel: pharaoh and thamud as precedent with divine encompassment from behind
candidates.definition: In 85:17-20: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers, those of Pharaoh and Thamud; but they who disbelieve are in persistent denial while Allah encompasses them from behind.

candidates.label: Honoured Quran inscribed in a Preserved Slate
candidates.normLabel: honoured quran inscribed in a preserved slate
candidates.definition: In 85:21-22: But this is an honored Quran inscribed in a Preserved Slate.

candidates.label: Night-comer oath resolving into the piercing star with universal soul-guardianship
candidates.normLabel: night-comer oath resolving into the piercing star with universal soul-guardianship
candidates.definition: In 86:1-4: By the sky and the night comer; and what can make you know what is the night comer; it is the piercing star; there is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

candidates.label: Creation from ejected fluid between backbone and ribs proving resurrection ability
candidates.normLabel: creation from ejected fluid between backbone and ribs proving resurrection ability
candidates.definition: In 86:5-8: So let man observe from what he was created; he was created from a fluid ejected emerging from between the backbone and the ribs; indeed Allah to return him to life is Able.

candidates.label: Secrets put on trial leaving man without power or helper
candidates.normLabel: secrets put on trial leaving man without power or helper
candidates.definition: In 86:9-10: The Day when secrets will be put on trial; then man will have no power or any helper.

candidates.label: Rain-returning sky and cracking earth establishing the Quran as decisive not amusement
candidates.normLabel: rain-returning sky and cracking earth establishing the quran as decisive not amusement
candidates.definition: In 86:11-14: By the sky which returns rain and by the earth which cracks open; indeed the Quran is a decisive statement and it is not amusement.

candidates.label: Human plotting answered by divine plotting with respite granted
candidates.normLabel: human plotting answered by divine plotting with respite granted
candidates.definition: In 86:15-17: Indeed they are planning a plan but I am planning a plan; so allow time for the disbelievers, leave them awhile.

candidates.label: Most High exalted as creator, proportioner, destiner and guide
candidates.normLabel: most high exalted as creator, proportioner, destiner and guide
candidates.definition: In 87:1-3: Exalt the name of your Lord the Most High who created and proportioned and who destined and then guided.

candidates.label: Pasture reduced to black stubble as a sign of transience
candidates.normLabel: pasture reduced to black stubble as a sign of transience
candidates.definition: In 87:4-5: And who brings out the pasture and then makes it black stubble.

candidates.label: Recitation preserved against forgetting with easing toward ease
candidates.normLabel: recitation preserved against forgetting with easing toward ease
candidates.definition: In 87:6-8: We will make you recite O Muhammad and you will not forget except what Allah should will; indeed He knows what is declared and what is hidden; and We will ease you toward ease.

candidates.label: Reminder benefiting the God-fearing while the wretched burns without death or life
candidates.normLabel: reminder benefiting the god-fearing while the wretched burns without death or life
candidates.definition: In 87:9-13: So remind if the reminder should benefit; he who fears Allah will be reminded but the wretched one will avoid it, he who will enter and burn in the greatest Fire neither dying therein nor living.

candidates.label: Success through purification, dhikr and prayer against worldly preference
candidates.normLabel: success through purification, dhikr and prayer against worldly preference
candidates.definition: In 87:14-17: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself and mentions the name of his Lord and prays; but you prefer the worldly life while the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

candidates.label: Teaching traced to the scriptures of Abraham and Moses
candidates.normLabel: teaching traced to the scriptures of abraham and moses
candidates.definition: In 87:18-19: Indeed this is in the former scriptures, the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

candidates.label: Overwhelming event producing humbled exhausted faces in intense Fire
candidates.normLabel: overwhelming event producing humbled exhausted faces in intense fire
candidates.definition: In 88:1-7: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming event; some faces that Day will be humbled working hard and exhausted; they will enter to burn in an intensely hot Fire; they will be given drink from a boiling spring; for them there will be no food except from a poisonous thorny plant which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

candidates.label: Pleased faces satisfied with effort in furnished elevated garden
candidates.normLabel: pleased faces satisfied with effort in furnished elevated garden
candidates.definition: In 88:8-16: Other faces that Day will show pleasure with their effort they are satisfied in an elevated garden wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech; within it is a flowing spring within it are couches raised high and cups put in place and cushions lined up and carpets spread around.

candidates.label: Four observational signs: camels, sky, mountains, earth
candidates.normLabel: four observational signs: camels, sky, mountains, earth
candidates.definition: In 88:17-20: Then do they not look at the camels how they are created and at the sky how it is raised and at the mountains how they are erected and at the earth how it is spread out.

candidates.label: Reminder-only role with turning-away answered by greatest punishment
candidates.normLabel: reminder-only role with turning-away answered by greatest punishment
candidates.definition: In 88:21-26: So remind O Muhammad you are only a reminder; you are not over them a controller; however he who turns away and disbelieves then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment; indeed to Us is their return then indeed upon Us is their account.

candidates.label: Dawn-night oaths sufficient for perception followed by destroyed civilisations
candidates.normLabel: dawn-night oaths sufficient for perception followed by destroyed civilisations
candidates.definition: In 89:1-14: By the dawn and by ten nights and by the even number and the odd and by the night when it passes; is there not in all that an oath sufficient for one of perception; have you not considered how your Lord dealt with Aad, Iram who had lofty pillars the likes of whom had never been created in the land, and Thamud who carved out the rocks in the valley, and Pharaoh owner of the stakes; all of whom oppressed within the lands and increased therein the corruption; so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment; indeed your Lord is in observation.

candidates.label: Human misreading of trial: generosity as honour, restriction as humiliation
candidates.normLabel: human misreading of trial: generosity as honour, restriction as humiliation
candidates.definition: In 89:15-16: And as for man when his Lord tries him and thus is generous to him and favors him he says my Lord has honored me; but when He tries him and restricts his provision he says my Lord has humiliated me.

candidates.label: Social failures: orphan neglected, poor unfed, inheritance devoured, wealth over-loved
candidates.normLabel: social failures: orphan neglected, poor unfed, inheritance devoured, wealth over-loved
candidates.definition: In 89:17-20: No but you do not honor the orphan and you do not encourage one another to feed the poor and you consume inheritance devouring it altogether and you love wealth with immense love.

candidates.label: Earth levelled, Lord arriving with ranks, Hell exposed, futile remembrance
candidates.normLabel: earth levelled, lord arriving with ranks, hell exposed, futile remembrance
candidates.definition: In 89:21-26: No when the earth has been leveled pounded and crushed and your Lord has come and the angels rank upon rank and brought within view that Day is Hell; that Day man will remember but what good to him will be the remembrance; he will say oh I wish I had sent ahead some good for my life; so on that Day none will punish as severely as His punishment and none will bind as severely as His binding of the evildoers.

candidates.label: Reassured soul commanded to return pleased and enter Paradise
candidates.normLabel: reassured soul commanded to return pleased and enter paradise
candidates.definition: In 89:27-30: To the righteous it will be said O reassured soul return to your Lord well-pleased and pleasing to Him and enter among My righteous servants and enter My Paradise.

candidates.label: Makkah-father oaths framing man's creation into hardship and arrogance
candidates.normLabel: makkah-father oaths framing man's creation into hardship and arrogance
candidates.definition: In 90:1-7: I swear by this city Makkah and you O Muhammad are free of restriction in this city and by the father and that which was born of him; We have certainly created man into hardship; does he think that never will anyone overcome him; he says I have spent wealth in abundance; does he think that no one has seen him.

candidates.label: Sensory gifts and two-way guidance contrasted with failure at the steep pass
candidates.normLabel: sensory gifts and two-way guidance contrasted with failure at the steep pass
candidates.definition: In 90:8-11: Have We not made for him two eyes and a tongue and two lips and have shown him the two ways; but he has not broken through the difficult pass.

candidates.label: Steep pass defined as emancipation, famine-feeding and faith-patience-compassion
candidates.normLabel: steep pass defined as emancipation, famine-feeding and faith-patience-compassion
candidates.definition: In 90:12-17: And what can make you know what is the difficult pass; it is the freeing of a slave or feeding on a day of severe hunger an orphan of near relationship or a needy person in misery; and then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

candidates.label: Right and left companionship determined by response to divine signs
candidates.normLabel: right and left companionship determined by response to divine signs
candidates.definition: In 90:18-20: Those are the companions of the right; but they who disbelieved in Our signs those are the companions of the left; over them will be fire closed in.

candidates.label: Cosmic and anthropological oaths culminating in soul-purification success
candidates.normLabel: cosmic and anthropological oaths culminating in soul-purification success
candidates.definition: In 91:1-10: By the sun and its brightness and by the moon when it follows it and by the day when it displays it and by the night when it covers it and by the sky and He who constructed it and by the earth and He who spread it and by the soul and He who proportioned it and inspired it with discernment of its wickedness and its righteousness; he has succeeded who purifies it and he has failed who instills it with corruption.

candidates.label: Moral inspiration embedded in the soul at creation
candidates.normLabel: moral inspiration embedded in the soul at creation
candidates.definition: In 91:7-8: And by the soul and He who proportioned it and inspired it with discernment of its wickedness and its righteousness.

candidates.label: Thamud's transgression: most wretched hamstringing the she-camel despite warning
candidates.normLabel: thamud's transgression: most wretched hamstringing the she-camel despite warning
candidates.definition: In 91:11-14: Thamud denied their prophet by reason of their transgression when the most wretched of them was sent forth and the messenger of Allah Salih said to them do not harm the she-camel of Allah or prevent her from her drink; but they denied him and hamstrung her so their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal upon all of them.

candidates.label: Divine fearlessness regarding the consequence of destruction
candidates.normLabel: divine fearlessness regarding the consequence of destruction
candidates.definition: In 91:15: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

candidates.label: Night-day-male-female oaths framing diverse efforts and opposing ease
candidates.normLabel: night-day-male-female oaths framing diverse efforts and opposing ease
candidates.definition: In 92:1-11: By the night when it covers and by the day when it appears and by He who created the male and female; indeed your efforts are diverse; as for he who gives and fears Allah and believes in the best reward We will ease him toward ease; but as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need and denies the best reward We will ease him toward difficulty; and what will his wealth avail him when he falls.

candidates.label: Guidance incumbent upon Allah with both realms belonging to Him
candidates.normLabel: guidance incumbent upon allah with both realms belonging to him
candidates.definition: In 92:12-13: Indeed incumbent upon Us is guidance and indeed to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first life.

candidates.label: Blazing Fire reserved for the denier-turner while the righteous avoids it
candidates.normLabel: blazing fire reserved for the denier-turner while the righteous avoids it
candidates.definition: In 92:14-17: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing; none will enter to burn therein except the most wretched one who had denied and turned away; but the righteous one will avoid it.

candidates.label: Sincere giving for purification seeking only the Lord's countenance ending in satisfaction
candidates.normLabel: sincere giving for purification seeking only the lord's countenance ending in satisfaction
candidates.definition: In 92:18-21: He who gives from his wealth to purify himself and not giving for anyone who has done him a favor to be rewarded but only seeking the countenance of his Lord Most High and he is going to be satisfied.

candidates.label: Morning-night oaths reassuring the Prophet against divine abandonment
candidates.normLabel: morning-night oaths reassuring the prophet against divine abandonment
candidates.definition: In 93:1-5: By the morning brightness and by the night when it covers with darkness; your Lord has not taken leave of you O Muhammad nor has He detested you; and the Hereafter is better for you than the first life; and your Lord is going to give you and you will be satisfied.

candidates.label: Three past favours: orphan-refuge, lost-guidance, poor-self-sufficiency
candidates.normLabel: three past favours: orphan-refuge, lost-guidance, poor-self-sufficiency
candidates.definition: In 93:6-8: Did He not find you an orphan and give you refuge; and He found you lost and guided you; and He found you poor and made you self-sufficient.

candidates.label: Ethical imperatives: orphan protection, petitioner reception, favour reporting
candidates.normLabel: ethical imperatives: orphan protection, petitioner reception, favour reporting
candidates.definition: In 93:9-11: So as for the orphan do not oppress him; and as for the petitioner do not repel him; but as for the favor of your Lord report it.

candidates.label: Breast expansion, burden removal and repute elevation as prophetic gifts
candidates.normLabel: breast expansion, burden removal and repute elevation as prophetic gifts
candidates.definition: In 94:1-4: Did We not expand for you O Muhammad your breast and We removed from you your burden which had weighed upon your back and raised high for you your repute.

candidates.label: Doubled hardship-ease declaration as universal comfort
candidates.normLabel: doubled hardship-ease declaration as universal comfort
candidates.definition: In 94:5-6: For indeed with hardship will be ease; indeed with hardship will be ease.

candidates.label: Post-duty worship and exclusive divine longing
candidates.normLabel: post-duty worship and exclusive divine longing
candidates.definition: In 94:7-8: So when you have finished your duties then stand up for worship and to your Lord direct your longing.

candidates.label: Fig-olive-Sinai-Makkah oaths framing creation in best stature and descent
candidates.normLabel: fig-olive-sinai-makkah oaths framing creation in best stature and descent
candidates.definition: In 95:1-5: By the fig and the olive and Mount Sinai and this secure city; We have certainly created man in the best of stature; then We return him to the lowest of the low.

candidates.label: Belief and righteous deeds as the exception securing uninterrupted reward
candidates.normLabel: belief and righteous deeds as the exception securing uninterrupted reward
candidates.definition: In 95:6: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

candidates.label: Recompense denial challenged with Allah as most just of judges
candidates.normLabel: recompense denial challenged with allah as most just of judges
candidates.definition: In 95:7-8: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense; is not Allah the most just of judges.

candidates.label: First revelation: recitation commanded in the Creator-Most Generous's name
candidates.normLabel: first revelation: recitation commanded in the creator-most generous's name
candidates.definition: In 96:1-5: Recite in the name of your Lord who created; created man from a clinging substance; recite and your Lord is the most Generous; who taught by the pen; taught man that which he knew not.

candidates.label: Human creation from alaq paired with pen-teaching as foundational gifts
candidates.normLabel: human creation from alaq paired with pen-teaching as foundational gifts
candidates.definition: In 96:2-5: Created man from a clinging substance; recite and your Lord is the most Generous who taught by the pen taught man that which he knew not.

candidates.label: Transgression from self-sufficiency corrected by return-to-Lord reminder
candidates.normLabel: transgression from self-sufficiency corrected by return-to-lord reminder
candidates.definition: In 96:6-8: No indeed man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient; indeed to your Lord is the return.

candidates.label: Prayer-forbidding opponent exposed: guidance denied, Allah sees
candidates.normLabel: prayer-forbidding opponent exposed: guidance denied, allah sees
candidates.definition: In 96:9-14: Have you seen the one who forbids a servant when he prays; have you seen if he is upon guidance or enjoins righteousness; have you seen if he denies and turns away; does he not know that Allah sees.

candidates.label: Lying forelock dragged, associates outmatched by Hell angels, prostration commanded
candidates.normLabel: lying forelock dragged, associates outmatched by hell angels, prostration commanded
candidates.definition: In 96:15-19: No if he does not desist We will surely drag him by the forelock a lying sinning forelock; then let him call his associates; We will call the angels of Hell; no do not obey him but prostrate and draw near to Allah.

candidates.label: Quran descended on the Night of Decree better than a thousand months
candidates.normLabel: quran descended on the night of decree better than a thousand months
candidates.definition: In 97:1-3: Indeed We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree; and what can make you know what is the Night of Decree; the Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

candidates.label: Angels and Spirit descending by permission for every matter in peace until dawn
candidates.normLabel: angels and spirit descending by permission for every matter in peace until dawn
candidates.definition: In 97:4-5: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter; peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

candidates.label: Clear evidence as Messenger reciting purified scriptures ending division
candidates.normLabel: clear evidence as messenger reciting purified scriptures ending division
candidates.definition: In 98:1-4: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted from misbelief until there came to them clear evidence; a Messenger from Allah reciting purified scriptures within which are correct writings; nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.

candidates.label: Correct religion defined as sincere worship, prayer and zakah
candidates.normLabel: correct religion defined as sincere worship, prayer and zakah
candidates.definition: In 98:5: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah being sincere to Him in religion inclining to truth and to establish prayer and to give zakah and that is the correct religion.

candidates.label: Worst versus best of creatures with mutual pleasure as reward apex
candidates.normLabel: worst versus best of creatures with mutual pleasure as reward apex
candidates.definition: In 98:6-8: Indeed they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell abiding eternally therein those are the worst of creatures; indeed they who have believed and done righteous deeds those are the best of creatures; their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide forever Allah being pleased with them and they with Him that is for whoever has feared his Lord.

candidates.label: Earth's final earthquake discharging burdens and reporting news by divine command
candidates.normLabel: earth's final earthquake discharging burdens and reporting news by divine command
candidates.definition: In 99:1-5: When the earth is shaken with its final earthquake and the earth discharges its burdens and man says what is wrong with it; that Day it will report its news because your Lord has commanded it.

candidates.label: Separated departure to witness deeds with atom-weight precision
candidates.normLabel: separated departure to witness deeds with atom-weight precision
candidates.definition: In 99:6-8: That Day the people will depart separated into categories to be shown the result of their deeds; so whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

candidates.label: War-horse oaths by panting racers, spark-strikers and dawn-chargers
candidates.normLabel: war-horse oaths by panting racers, spark-strikers and dawn-chargers
candidates.definition: In 100:1-5: By the racers panting and the producers of sparks when striking and the chargers at dawn stirring up thereby clouds of dust arriving thereby in the center collectively.

candidates.label: Self-witnessed ingratitude and intense wealth-love as human diagnosis
candidates.normLabel: self-witnessed ingratitude and intense wealth-love as human diagnosis
candidates.definition: In 100:6-8: Indeed mankind to his Lord is ungrateful and indeed he is to that a witness and indeed he is in love of wealth intense.

candidates.label: Graves scattered and breasts extracted with Lord fully Acquainted on that Day
candidates.normLabel: graves scattered and breasts extracted with lord fully acquainted on that day
candidates.definition: In 100:9-11: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered and that within the breasts is obtained; indeed their Lord with them that Day is fully Acquainted.

candidates.label: Striking Calamity triple-named with moth-people and wool-mountains similes
candidates.normLabel: striking calamity triple-named with moth-people and wool-mountains similes
candidates.definition: In 101:1-5: The Striking Calamity; what is the Striking Calamity; and what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity; it is the Day when people will be like moths dispersed and the mountains will be like wool fluffed up.

candidates.label: Scale-weight determining pleasant life or abyss refuge
candidates.normLabel: scale-weight determining pleasant life or abyss refuge
candidates.definition: In 101:6-9: Then as for one whose scales are heavy with good deeds he will be in a pleasant life; but as for one whose scales are light his refuge will be an abyss.

candidates.label: Abyss revealed as intensely hot Fire through rhetorical disclosure
candidates.normLabel: abyss revealed as intensely hot fire through rhetorical disclosure
candidates.definition: In 101:10-11: And what can make you know what that is; it is a Fire intensely hot.

candidates.label: Takathur diverting until graveyard visit with doubled knowing-warning
candidates.normLabel: takathur diverting until graveyard visit with doubled knowing-warning
candidates.definition: In 102:1-4: Competition in worldly increase diverts you until you visit the graveyards; no you are going to know; then no you are going to know.

candidates.label: Certainty-knowledge escalating to Hellfire vision and pleasure accountability
candidates.normLabel: certainty-knowledge escalating to hellfire vision and pleasure accountability
candidates.definition: In 102:5-8: No if you only knew with knowledge of certainty you would surely see the Hellfire then you would surely see it with the eye of certainty then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

candidates.label: Time-oath declaring universal human loss
candidates.normLabel: time-oath declaring universal human loss
candidates.definition: In 103:1-2: By time; indeed mankind is in loss.

candidates.label: Four-fold exception: belief, righteous deeds, mutual truth and patience counsel
candidates.normLabel: four-fold exception: belief, righteous deeds, mutual truth and patience counsel
candidates.definition: In 103:3: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

candidates.label: Scorner-mocker collecting wealth under immortality delusion
candidates.normLabel: scorner-mocker collecting wealth under immortality delusion
candidates.definition: In 104:1-3: Woe to every scorner and mocker who collects wealth and continuously counts it; he thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

candidates.label: Crusher revealed as Allah's fueled fire mounting at the hearts
candidates.normLabel: crusher revealed as allah's fueled fire mounting at the hearts
candidates.definition: In 104:4-7: No he will surely be thrown into the Crusher; and what can make you know what is the Crusher; it is the fire of Allah eternally fueled which mounts directed at the hearts.

candidates.label: Hellfire sealed in extended columns as total enclosure
candidates.normLabel: hellfire sealed in extended columns as total enclosure
candidates.definition: In 104:8-9: Indeed Hellfire will be closed down upon them in extended columns.

candidates.label: Elephant companions' plan frustrated by divine intervention
candidates.normLabel: elephant companions' plan frustrated by divine intervention
candidates.definition: In 105:1-2: Have you not considered O Muhammad how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant; did He not make their plan into misguidance.

candidates.label: Ababil birds with sijjil stones reducing army to eaten straw
candidates.normLabel: ababil birds with sijjil stones reducing army to eaten straw
candidates.definition: In 105:3-5: And He sent against them birds in flocks striking them with stones of hard clay and He made them like eaten straw.

candidates.label: Quraysh familiarisation through seasonal trade journeys
candidates.normLabel: quraysh familiarisation through seasonal trade journeys
candidates.definition: In 106:1-2: For the familiarisation of Quraysh, their accustomed winter and summer journeys.

candidates.label: Worship of the House's Lord grounded in provision and security
candidates.normLabel: worship of the house's lord grounded in provision and security
candidates.definition: In 106:3-4: So let them worship the Lord of this House who fed them against hunger and secured them against fear.

candidates.label: Recompense-denier identified by orphan-repulsion and poor-neglect
candidates.normLabel: recompense-denier identified by orphan-repulsion and poor-neglect
candidates.definition: In 107:1-3: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense; that is the one who repels the orphan and does not encourage feeding the poor.

candidates.label: Heedless show-prayer and withheld kindness earning woe
candidates.normLabel: heedless show-prayer and withheld kindness earning woe
candidates.definition: In 107:4-7: So woe to those who pray yet are heedless of their prayer, making a show of it and withholding small acts of kindness.

candidates.label: Kawthar granted with prayer and sacrifice commanded
candidates.normLabel: kawthar granted with prayer and sacrifice commanded
candidates.definition: In 108:1-2: Indeed We have granted you Al-Kawthar; so pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice.

candidates.label: Hater of the Prophet declared cut off from all good
candidates.normLabel: hater of the prophet declared cut off from all good
candidates.definition: In 108:3: Indeed your enemy is the one cut off.

candidates.label: Four-fold worship negation establishing absolute theological disavowal
candidates.normLabel: four-fold worship negation establishing absolute theological disavowal
candidates.definition: In 109:1-4: Say O disbelievers; I do not worship what you worship; nor are you worshippers of what I worship; nor am I a worshipper of what you have worshipped.

candidates.label: Religious separation declared: for you your religion, for me mine
candidates.normLabel: religious separation declared: for you your religion, for me mine
candidates.definition: In 109:5-6: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship; for you your religion and for me my religion.

candidates.label: Divine help and victory producing mass conversion to Allah's religion
candidates.normLabel: divine help and victory producing mass conversion to allah's religion
candidates.definition: In 110:1-2: When the help of Allah and victory come and you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes.

candidates.label: Victory answered with praise, forgiveness-seeking and Tawwab affirmation
candidates.normLabel: victory answered with praise, forgiveness-seeking and tawwab affirmation
candidates.definition: In 110:3: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.

candidates.label: Abu Lahab condemned: hands perishing, wealth futile, flaming Fire
candidates.normLabel: abu lahab condemned: hands perishing, wealth futile, flaming fire
candidates.definition: In 111:1-3: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish and may he perish; his wealth and what he gained will not avail him; he will enter a Fire that flames.

candidates.label: Wife as firewood-carrier with palm-fibre rope around her neck
candidates.normLabel: wife as firewood-carrier with palm-fibre rope around her neck
candidates.definition: In 111:4-5: And his wife the carrier of firewood; around her neck is a rope of palm fibre.

candidates.label: Allah as Ahad and Samad: absolute oneness and self-sufficiency
candidates.normLabel: allah as ahad and samad: absolute oneness and self-sufficiency
candidates.definition: In 112:1-2: Say He is Allah One; Allah the Eternal Refuge.

candidates.label: Negation of progeny and equivalence completing divine uniqueness
candidates.normLabel: negation of progeny and equivalence completing divine uniqueness
candidates.definition: In 112:3-4: He neither begets nor is begotten; and there is none equivalent to Him.

candidates.label: Refuge sought from created evil and settling darkness
candidates.normLabel: refuge sought from created evil and settling darkness
candidates.definition: In 113:1-3: Say I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created and from the evil of darkness when it settles.

candidates.label: Protection from knot-blowing sorcery and envious harm
candidates.normLabel: protection from knot-blowing sorcery and envious harm
candidates.definition: In 113:4-5: And from the evil of the blowers in knots and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

candidates.label: Triple divine title: Lord, Sovereign and God of mankind
candidates.normLabel: triple divine title: lord, sovereign and god of mankind
candidates.definition: In 114:1-3: Say I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind.

candidates.label: Retreating whisperer from jinn and humans targeting the heart
candidates.normLabel: retreating whisperer from jinn and humans targeting the heart
candidates.definition: In 114:4-6: From the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of mankind from among the jinn and mankind.
